title: 英语语法 · B2→C1 进阶课程
subtitle: 补牢基础，再用大约一年到一年半把语法用到 C1 的精度
scope: 面向已经通过 B2、觉得基础还不稳、准备 Cambridge C1 Advanced 的中文母语者。讲解用简体中文，例句和练习用英语。内容是本站原创，不是考试真题，也不代表等级认证。

levels.name: 模块 0 · 基础回顾
levels.description: 时态与体、冠词、可数性、介词、一致和中文母语者最常同时犯的错。

levels.name: 语法精度
levels.description: 从完成进行体、情态和条件，到从句、强调、愿望和非谓语。

levels.name: 篇章与用词
levels.description: 连接、名词化、省略、搭配、短语动词、构词和关键词转换。

plan.title: 从 B2 走到 C1 Advanced
plan.summary: 给已经通过 B2、觉得基础还不够牢、打算用大约 12 到 18 个月准备 Cambridge C1 Advanced 的中文母语者。先补时态、冠词和句子骨架，再把 C1 真正拉开差距的从句、情态、名词化和改写练稳。
audience: 你能读懂一般的英语文章，写作和说话也大致正确，但一到冠词、完成时、介词和长句，就会退回中文的语序。B2 证明你已经能用英语办事；C1 要的是在更长的文章和对话里，形式稳定、连接清楚、用词贴切。
这份计划不假设你从零开始，也不假设你的 B2 已经自动化。模块 0 用来把“会了但一快就错”的项目重新说清楚。后面的课默认你做过模块 0，或自检已经过关。
每天大约 10 分钟负责保持接触：读例句、做两道题、写一句自己的话。语法要进到写作和口语里，靠的是每周那一次较长的练习，而不是把 10 分钟无限加长。
plan.horizon: 同样四段路，有两种走法。基础漏洞多，就按大约 18 个月走，模块 0 可以占满两个月。基础只是偶尔失手，就按大约 12 个月走，模块 0 用四次周末长练习收束。考试日期一旦确定，从日期往回排第 4 段，不要把模考节奏留到最后两周。

phases.name: 阶段 0 · 基础回顾
phases.focus: 时态和体、冠词、可数与不可数、介词、主谓一致、基本从句，以及中文母语者最容易同时犯的那些错。这一段的目标不是“再背一遍”，而是让你在不翻译的情况下选对形式。
phases.check: 自检：做 m4 的综合课。首答正确如果明显低于八成，回到错的那一类，不要进入情态和条件句。

phases.name: 阶段 1 · 把 B2 的语法用到 C1 的精度
phases.when: 时态细微差别到动名词
phases.focus: 完成进行体、将来的几种说法、现在和过去的情态推测、混合条件与倒装条件、被动和 have/get something done、间接引语、关系从句和分词从句、倒装与强调、wish / if only / it's time、动名词和不定式。
phases.check: 自检：从错题复习里抽 10 道改写题，限时 15 分钟。关键词用上了，意思没偏，时态和冠词也站得住，这一段就可以收。

phases.name: 阶段 2 · 篇章、名词化和用词
phases.focus: 正式语域里的连接和标点、把动词句收成名词短语、省略和替代、搭配、短语动词，以及原创的构词和关键词转换。这些直接对应 Use of English 里最容易丢分的空，但练习全部是本站写的，不是真题。
phases.check: 自检：拿自己写的 150 词，划掉 although…but、because…so、缺冠词和中文话题句。改完再做 6 道构词或转换。

phases.name: 阶段 3 · 把语法交到四项技能里
phases.focus: 本站不再加新的语法点。你按公开的考试时长，自己安排阅读、写作、听力和口语。语法课负责的是：写作里形式稳定，口语里能用复杂句，听力里听得出情态和时态，阅读里看得懂名词化。
phases.check: 自检：完整计时一轮之后，只记录三类失误：形式错、连接错、任务没完成。下一周的 10 分钟只练出现过的那一类。

plan.dailyIntro: 工作日不要打开一整课。固定在同一时间做下面三小步，加起来大约 10 分钟。材料用当前这一课；如果错题复习里有题，优先做旧题。
daily: 出声读当前课里的 4 个例句
你能指出时态、冠词或从句，而不是只读懂中文
做 2 道题，错了只看提示，先不看答案
留下“会了 / 没会”的记录，不要为了绿勾去看答案
用今天的结构写一句自己的事
句子里有主语和动词，冠词和时态经得起你自己的检查清单
plan.weeklyIntro: 每周留出大约 80 分钟。可以一次做完，也可以拆成周六 50 分钟和周日 30 分钟。这一次才把整课的规则、练习和短文走完。
weekly: 只重做本周错题。先盖住解析，写完再对照。
完成一课的观察、规则和六道练习。
写 120–160 个词，用上本周三个结构。写完用检查清单过一遍。
把这段话讲出来，录 60–90 秒。只改一个最影响理解的问题。
weeklyNotes: 某一周如果只剩工作日的 10 分钟，不要用额外的选择题假装完成了长练习。下周把 80 分钟补上。阅读和听力的大量输入也不在这 10 分钟里，它们需要另找时间。
写作检查清单就四条：although 和 but 没有同时连接同一个对比；because 和 so 没有叠用；可数单数名词有冠词或限定词；时态和故事发生的时间一致，尤其不要在 yesterday、in 2019 这种明确过去时间旁边用现在完成时。

milestones.text: 能解释为什么不能说 I have seen him yesterday。
milestones.proof: 自检：不看笔记，各写一句一般过去和现在完成，并说出时间状语为什么不同。

milestones.text: 冠词和可数性：10 个空里自己做对大约 8 个。
milestones.proof: 自检：重做 m2 的填空。information、advice、a teacher、the 的已知对象，这四类不再靠感觉。

milestones.text: although…but 和 because…so 从自己的句子里消失。
milestones.proof: 自检：翻最近两篇草稿，这两种双连接一次都不再出现。

milestones.text: 能按证据强弱选用 must、can't、might，以及它们的过去形式。
milestones.proof: 自检：看一张没有文字说明的照片或一条新闻标题，用三句英语说出“几乎可以肯定 / 不可能 / 只是可能”。

milestones.text: 能写混合条件句，而不是把中文“如果当时……现在就……”翻成 if I was … I will …。
milestones.proof: 自检：写一句“过去的事影响现在”和一句“现在的性格影响过去的结果”。

milestones.text: 关系从句、分词从句和被动使役可以出现在同一段话里，而且主语不丢。
milestones.proof: 自检：用 Having finished…、the report written…、I had the figures checked 各写一句，读出来主语仍然清楚。

milestones.text: 能把一句动词堆得很满的话改成带名词化的句子。
milestones.proof: 自检：把 The committee refused to comment and so the decision was delayed 收成一句以 refusal 或 delay 为中心的话。

milestones.text: 构词先判断词性，再选前后缀；转换题只用关键词，不另起炉灶。
milestones.proof: 自检：m19 的两课限时做完。看过答案的题隔天重做，仍能写对。

milestones.text: 能不看提纲讲 90 秒，里面至少有一个你这半年新练会的复杂句。
milestones.proof: 自检：题目用“比较两张你自己拍的照片”或“谈一次你改变主意的经历”。录完听一遍，只标记语法崩掉的地方。

milestones.text: 按公开的试卷时长自己计时过一轮：阅读与语法、写作、听力、口语分开计。
milestones.proof: 自检：材料用你自己的文章、录音和写作题，不用未授权的真题。记下来的是失误类型，不是一个假装的分数。

examIntro: Cambridge C1 Advanced 分阅读与英语运用、写作、听力、口语四项。下面只说明各部分公开的任务类型，以及本课哪一段语法能帮上忙。具体题数、字数和时长以你考试当年的官方说明为准，这里不抄试卷，也不提供样题原文。
阅读与英语运用前四部分最依赖本课：选择填空看搭配和语篇，开放填空看冠词、介词、助动词和关系词，构词看词性，关键词转换看你能不能只改必要的形式。后四部分是阅读，本课不教答题技巧，只让句子本身变得读得懂、写得出。

modules.title: 时态与体：先把时间说清楚
modules.description: 中文靠时间词表达时间，动词本身几乎不变。英语要同时选“发生在哪一段”和“看成完成的一点，还是正在展开”。

lessons.title: 一般时与进行时
lessons.goal: 能判断一件事是习惯、事实、时间表，还是说话时正在进行，并写出对应形式。
lessons.exam: 阅读与运用的开放填空常在助动词上设空；写作叙述如果时态漂移，语言分会先掉。

notice.prompt: 两组句子说的都是“工作”。哪一句是习惯，哪一句被框在一段有限的时间里？

examples.en: I work from home.
examples.zh: 我在家工作：说的是常规，不是此刻这一下。

examples.en: I am working from home this week.
examples.zh: 这个星期我在家工作：进行体把动作放进一段有边界的时间。

notice.answer: 没有 be + -ing 的那句讲习惯或长期事实。加上 this week 之后，说话人把这件事限制在“这一阵”，所以用现在进行时。中文两个句子都可以说“在家工作”，英语必须把这个差别做进动词。

rules.title: 一般现在时：习惯、事实、时间表
rules.body: 一般现在时用来表示反复发生的事、现在仍然成立的事实，以及时刻表、日程上已经排好的将来。第三人称单数要加 -s。频率副词 usually、often、every day 是它的典型伙伴。它不表示“说话这一秒正在做”。

examples.en: I drink tea every morning.
Water boils at 100°C.
The train leaves at 7.
examples.zh: 时刻表上的离开，用一般现在时说出将来。

mistakes.wrong: I am work here.
mistakes.right: I work here.
mistakes.why: 不要把 be 和动词原形叠在一起。中文的“在”不一定等于 am / is / are。

mistakes.wrong: She work in a bank.
mistakes.right: She works in a bank.
mistakes.why: 第三人称单数的一般现在时，实义动词要加 -s。

rules.title: 现在进行时：此刻，或这一段有限的时间
rules.body: 现在进行时是 am / is / are + -ing。它表示说话时正在发生的事，也可以表示“这一周、这一阵”的临时安排，包括已经约好的近期将来。状态动词 know、like、believe、own 一般不用进行时，因为它们不是正在展开的动作。

examples.en: She is talking to a client right now.
I am reading a long report this month.
examples.zh: 这个月这一阵在读，不一定是这一秒。

examples.en: We are meeting the editor on Friday.
examples.zh: 已经安排好的近期将来。

table.caption: 现在进行时
headers: 不用于进行时的常见状态动词
rows: want 通常也不用进行时

mistakes.wrong: I am knowing the answer.
mistakes.right: I know the answer.
mistakes.why: know 是状态，不是可以“正在进行”的动作。

mistakes.wrong: He is usually taking the bus.
mistakes.right: He usually takes the bus.
mistakes.why: usually 指向习惯，优先用一般现在时。

rules.title: 一般过去时：把事情放进一段已经结束的时间
rules.body: 一般过去时表示在过去某一时刻或某一段已经结束的时间里发生的事。yesterday、last year、in 2019、when I was a child 都把时间关上了。规则动词加 -ed；不规则动词要单独记。否定和疑问用 did + 动词原形，动词本身不再变化。

examples.en: I visited Suzhou in 2019.
examples.zh: 2019 年已经结束，用一般过去时。

examples.en: She did not finish the draft yesterday.
examples.zh: did 已经承担过去，finish 用原形。

examples.en: Did they call you last night?
examples.zh: 疑问也由 did 标记过去。

mistakes.wrong: Did she went home?
mistakes.right: Did she go home?
mistakes.why: 有 did 之后，动词回到原形。

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I go to the office.
mistakes.right: Yesterday I went to the office.
mistakes.why: 时间在昨天，动词不能留在现在时。

rules.title: 过去进行时：过去某个点上正在展开的背景
rules.body: 过去进行时是 was / were + -ing。它常给一个被打断的背景：较长的动作正在进行，短的事件用一般过去时插进来。它也可以表示过去一段时间里的临时情况。

examples.en: I was cooking when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 电话响的那一刻，做饭正在进行。

examples.en: At 8 p.m. she was still writing.
examples.zh: 过去的一个时间点上，动作未完成。

examples.en: They were living in Nanjing that year.
examples.zh: 那一年这一段的临时情况。

mistakes.wrong: When I was a child, I was going to school every day.
mistakes.right: When I was a child, I went to school every day.
mistakes.why: every day 在一段已结束的生活里仍是习惯，用一般过去时。

mistakes.wrong: I cooked when she was arriving.
mistakes.right: I was cooking when she arrived.
mistakes.why: 较长的背景用进行时，短的到达用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: 你想说“我通常坐地铁上班”。哪一句符合这个习惯？
questions.answer: I usually take the metro to work.
questions.hint: usually 描写反复发生的事，先选时态，再检查动词有没有被 be 和原形叠在一起。
questions.explanation: 习惯用一般现在时。进行时会把动作说成“这一阵正在发生”。am take 则把两个形式叠错了。
options: I usually take the metro to work.
I am usually taking the metro to work.
I usually am take the metro to work.

questions.prompt: 星期五已经和编辑约好见面。哪一句最合适？
questions.answer: We are meeting the editor on Friday.
questions.hint: 这是已经安排的近期将来，不是过去，也不是列车时刻表那种不可更改的公示。
questions.explanation: 个人已经约好的安排常用现在进行时。were meeting 把事情放进了过去。时刻表才更常用一般现在时说出将来。
options: We meet the editor on Friday because the timetable says so.
We are meeting the editor on Friday.
We were meeting the editor on Friday.

questions.prompt: 填写动词的正确形式：She ______ (know) the answer, so she does not need to look it up.
questions.answer: knows
questions.hint: 状态动词用一般现在时，并注意第三人称。
questions.explanation: know 一般不用进行时。主语 she 是第三人称单数，所以是 knows。

questions.prompt: 昨天的电话是短动作，做饭是当时正在进行的背景。补全：I ______ (cook) when the phone ______ (ring).
questions.answer: was cooking, rang
questions.hint: 较长的背景用过去进行时，突然发生的短动作用一般过去时。
questions.explanation: 电话响的那一刻饭还在做，所以是 I was cooking when the phone rang。
accepted: was cooking when the phone rang

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: She walks to the office every day.
questions.hint: 关键词是动词 WALKS，用一般现在时说出习惯。
questions.explanation: 每天步行去办公室是习惯，用一般现在时：She walks to the office every day。
questions.source: Her journey to the office is on foot every day.
accepted: Every day she walks to the office.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: Yesterday I went to the library and studied for three hours.
questions.hint: yesterday 已经把时间关进过去。两个动词都要过去式，一段时间前面还缺 for。
questions.explanation: am go 把现在时的 be 和原形叠在一起，而且和 yesterday 冲突。study 也在昨天，所以 studied。three hours 是持续长度，英语要说 for three hours。
questions.stem: Yesterday I am go to the library and study three hours.

task.prompt: 用四句英语写你昨天的一个小时：一句习惯（你通常做什么）、一句当时正在做的事、一句突然发生的短动作、一句状态（你知道或喜欢什么）。
task.model: I usually review my notes after dinner. Yesterday at nine I was reading a short article when my brother called. I knew the answer, so I did not look it up.
rubric: 四句的时间关系互相不打架，习惯没有用进行时。
过去的背景和短动作分成了进行时和一般过去时。
状态动词没有写成 am knowing 或 am liking。

lessons.title: 完成体，以及不能和 yesterday 连用的原因
lessons.goal: 能区分“过去的事和现在还有联系”与“过去的事已经关在一段结束的时间里”，并正确使用 for / since。
lessons.exam: 开放填空和写作都常在 have 与过去分词上设坎。明确的过去时间一旦出现，现在完成时就不能硬上。

notice.prompt: 两句都提到“住在这里”。一句能回答“你住了多久”，另一句把时间关在一个已经结束的年份里。

examples.en: I have lived here for five years.
examples.zh: 到现在为止住了五年，这段时间还连着现在。

examples.en: I lived there in 2019.
examples.zh: 2019 年已经结束，只陈述那段过去。

notice.answer: have lived 是现在完成时：动作或状态从过去延续到现在，或结果现在还在。lived in 2019 是一般过去时，因为 2019 是关上的时间。中文都可以说“住过”，英语要看这段时间有没有被切断。

rules.title: 现在完成时：过去和现在还连着
rules.body: 现在完成时是 have / has + 过去分词。常见三种用法：从过去持续到现在；经历，但没说具体是哪一次；过去的动作留下了现在能看见的结果。它不和 yesterday、last week、in 2019、when I was six 这种明确而且已经结束的时间点连用。

examples.en: I have lost my keys.
examples.zh: 钥匙现在仍然不在，结果还在。

examples.en: She has visited Kyoto twice.
examples.zh: 经历，没有说出是哪一年。

examples.en: They have known each other since 2020.
examples.zh: 从 2020 年一直持续到现在。

table.caption: 现在完成时
rows: for, since, already, yet, ever, never

mistakes.wrong: I have seen him yesterday.
mistakes.right: I saw him yesterday.
mistakes.why: yesterday 是已经结束的时间，用一般过去时。

mistakes.wrong: I have lived here since five years.
mistakes.right: I have lived here for five years.
mistakes.why: for 接一段时间，since 接起点。

rules.title: for 是长度，since 是起点
rules.body: for 后面是一段时间：for five years、for two hours。since 后面是起点：since 2020、since Monday、since I graduated。中文的“了”两者都能盖住，所以要先问：后面那个词是一段长度，还是一个起点。

examples.en: She has worked here for a decade.
She has worked here since 2016.
I have been awake since the baby cried.
examples.zh: since 后面也可以是一个过去的起点小句。

mistakes.wrong: He has waited since two hours.
mistakes.right: He has waited for two hours.
mistakes.why: two hours 是长度，用 for。也可以说 has been waiting。

mistakes.wrong: I lived here since 2020 and I still live here.
mistakes.right: I have lived here since 2020.
mistakes.why: 既然现在还住着，就不要用一般过去时把这段生活说成已经结束。

rules.title: 过去完成时：比另一个过去更早
rules.body: 过去完成时是 had + 过去分词。它不是“更过去的装饰”，而是用来标明：在一个已经用一般过去时说出的时间之前，这件事已经完成。如果按时间顺序一句一句讲，而且没有必要强调“更早”，经常用一般过去时就够了。

examples.en: The train had left when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到达之前，火车已经开走。

examples.en: She realised she had forgotten the file.
examples.zh: 意识到是过去，忘记发生得更早。

examples.en: I had finished the report before he called.
examples.zh: 打电话之前，报告已经写完。

table.caption: 两个过去怎么排队
rows: The train had left when we arrived.
She realised she had forgotten it.
I finished the report and then he called.

rules.title: 现在完成进行时先露一个头
rules.body: have / has been + -ing 强调从过去持续到现在、而且常常还能看见过程或未完成。细节放在后面的课。这里先建立一个对比：I have read the book 强调书读完了；I have been reading the book 强调最近一直在读，不一定读完。

examples.en: I have written three emails.
I have been writing emails all morning.
examples.zh: 一上午都在写，过程还在眼前。

examples.en: My eyes are tired because I have been reading.
examples.zh: 现在的结果来自持续的过程。

questions.prompt: 哪一句不能说？
questions.answer: I have seen him yesterday.
questions.hint: 看时间状语有没有把过去的门关上。
questions.explanation: yesterday 是明确而且已经结束的时间，只能用一般过去时。recently 仍然连着现在，可以用现在完成时。
options: I saw him yesterday.
I have seen him recently.
I have seen him yesterday.

questions.prompt: “从 2018 年到现在一直在这家医院工作”，哪一句对？
questions.answer: She has worked here since 2018.
questions.hint: 现在还在这家医院，时间不能用一般过去时切断。2018 是起点。
questions.explanation: 持续到现在用现在完成时。since 接起点 2018。for 要接长度，不能接年份本身。
options: She worked here since 2018.
She has worked here since 2018.
She has worked here for 2018.

questions.prompt: 我们到站时火车已经开走了：The train ______ already ______ (leave) when we arrived.
questions.answer: had, left
questions.hint: 到达是过去，离开比它更早。
questions.explanation: had left 标出“在 arrived 之前已经完成”。already 可以放在 had 和 left 之间。

questions.prompt: 长度还是起点？I have lived in Chengdu ______ 2019.
questions.answer: since
questions.hint: 2019 是一个起点，不是“2019 这么长”。
questions.explanation: since 2019 表示从那一年开始，一直到现在。for 要说 for seven years 这种长度。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I have lived here for five years.
questions.hint: 起点在五年前，状态延续到现在。关键词 FOR 后面接长度。
questions.explanation: 现在完成时把“五年前开始、现在还在”收成一句。I have been living here for five years 也成立，更强调这段生活的过程。
questions.source: I started living here five years ago, and I still live here.
accepted: I have been living here for five years.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: I finished my homework yesterday, and I have been very tired for two days.
questions.hint: 拆开两个时间：yesterday 跟一般过去时，two days 是长度。
questions.explanation: yesterday 不能和现在完成时连用，所以第一小句用 finished。two days 是一段时间，用 for，不用 since。
questions.stem: I have finished my homework yesterday and I have been very tired since two days.

task.prompt: 写三句你自己的时间线：一句用 for 或 since 说到现在，一句用明确的过去年份，一句用过去完成时说明“在另一件过去的事之前”。
task.model: I have studied English for many years. I took an important exam in 2022. I had reviewed the grammar before the exam started.
rubric: 持续到现在的那句用了现在完成时，而且 for / since 没有用反。
有明确年份或昨天的那句用了一般过去时。
过去完成时确实比另一个过去更早，而不是随便加上 had。

modules.title: 冠词与名词的数
modules.description: 中文没有冠词，名词也不强制标复数。英语的可数单数几乎总要一个限定词，不可数名词则不能加 a 或直接加 -s。

lessons.title: a、an、the 和零冠词
lessons.goal: 能根据“听众知不知道是哪一个”以及名词是泛指还是特指，选择 a / an、the 或零冠词。
lessons.exam: 开放填空几乎每次都会考冠词。写作里可数单数名词光秃秃地出现，是中文母语者最明显的痕迹之一。

notice.prompt: 同样是“老师”。一句在介绍身份，一句在指双方都知道的那一位。

examples.en: She is a teacher.
examples.zh: 身份：教师这一类里的一员。

examples.en: The teacher is in the classroom.
examples.zh: 双方都知道说的是哪一位老师。

notice.answer: a 把一个人放进某一类。the 用来指已经确定的那一个：刚才说过、眼前唯一，或双方心里都有数。中文“她是老师”不必说“一个”，英语的可数单数名词不能光着出现。

rules.title: a / an：可数单数，听众还不知道是哪一个
rules.body: 第一次提到某一类中的一个，或说明职业、身份，用 a / an。an 看发音，不看字母：an hour、an MBA，因为开头是元音；a university、a European city，因为开头是 /j/。

examples.en: I need a quiet room.
examples.zh: 众多房间里的一间，尚未指定。

examples.en: He is an engineer.
It takes an hour, not a hour.
examples.zh: hour 的 h 不发音。

mistakes.wrong: She is teacher.
mistakes.right: She is a teacher.
mistakes.why: 职业是可数单数，要有 a。

mistakes.wrong: He gave me a advice.
mistakes.right: He gave me some advice.
mistakes.why: advice 不可数，不能加 a。

rules.title: the：双方能确定是哪一个
rules.body: the 不表示“翻译成‘这个’才用”。只要说话人和听者能确定是哪一个，就用 the：上文刚提到、世上独一、最高级和序数、被后置定语限定到只剩一个。

examples.en: I bought a lamp. The lamp is too bright.
The sun was already up.
examples.zh: 世上的太阳，听者不会问哪一个。

examples.en: The report on your desk is mine.
examples.zh: on your desk 把它限定成那一份。

mistakes.wrong: I go to school by the bus.
mistakes.right: I go to school by bus.
mistakes.why: by bus / by train 说交通方式，不用 the。

mistakes.wrong: She plays the football.
mistakes.right: She plays football.
mistakes.why: 球类运动通常零冠词；乐器才说 play the piano。

rules.title: 零冠词：复数或不可数名词泛指
rules.body: 说一整类事物，复数名词和不可数名词用零冠词：Books are expensive. Water is essential. 一旦加上范围，变成特定的那些，就要 the：the books on that shelf、the water in this glass。三餐、大多数国家名、语言名通常也是零冠词。

examples.en: Life in a big city is noisy.
Children need sleep.
examples.zh: 孩子这一类，不是特定的几个。

examples.en: She speaks Mandarin and studies in China.
examples.zh: 语言名和国家名通常不加 the。

table.caption: 加 the 的地名只记这一小撮
rows: the United Kingdom, the United States
the Yangtze, the Pacific, the Alps

rules.title: 学校、医院：目的和建筑物不是同一个冠词
rules.body: go to school / hospital / prison / university 强调去那里的用途：上学、看病、服刑、读大学。go to the school 则是去那栋建筑，比如家长去学校开会。这个差别中文都说“去学校”。

examples.en: The children go to school at eight.
I went to the school to meet the principal.
She was taken to hospital.
examples.zh: 英式英语里去医院看病可以零冠词。美式常说 to the hospital。

mistakes.wrong: My brother is at the university studying law.
mistakes.right: My brother is at university studying law.
mistakes.why: 在英式英语里，求学本身常用零冠词。若强调那一所校园，才用 the。

mistakes.wrong: Open the light, please.
mistakes.right: Turn on the light, please.
mistakes.why: 灯用 turn on / turn off，不用 open / close。

questions.prompt: 第一次告诉别人你的职业，哪一句对？
questions.answer: I am a teacher.
questions.hint: 职业是可数单数。听众还不知道你是“哪一位特定的老师”时，不要用 the。
questions.explanation: a teacher 表示职业类别中的一员。光秃秃的 teacher 缺少限定词。the teacher 要双方都知道是哪一位。
options: I am teacher.
I am a teacher.
I am the teacher of the world.

questions.prompt: hour 前面用哪一个？
questions.answer: an hour
questions.hint: 看第一个音，不看字母 h。
questions.explanation: hour 以元音开头，所以 an hour。不是任何时候都用 the。
options: a hour
an hour
the hour, always

questions.prompt: 把整句写出来：她弹钢琴，但不打篮球。
questions.answer: She plays the piano, but she does not play basketball.
questions.hint: 乐器通常有 the，球类通常没有。
questions.explanation: play the piano，play basketball。球类运动用零冠词。
accepted: She plays the piano but she does not play basketball.
She plays the piano, but she doesn't play basketball.

questions.prompt: 泛指水：______ water is essential, but ______ water in this bottle is warm. 两个空分别填什么？用 a / the / zero 回答。
questions.answer: zero, the
questions.hint: 第一空说的是水这一类，第二空被 in this bottle 限定了。
questions.explanation: 泛指不可数名词用零冠词。瓶子里的那些水是特定的，用 the。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: She is a teacher.
questions.hint: 职业要用 a + 可数单数名词。
questions.explanation: 关键词是名词 TEACHER，句子要变成身份判断，所以是 She is a teacher。
questions.source: She teaches. That is her job.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: I usually go to school by bus, and I am a student.
questions.hint: 上学这个目的、交通方式、职业，三处冠词都要重看。
questions.explanation: 去上学是 go to school，乘公共汽车是 by bus。student 是可数单数职业，前面要 a。
questions.stem: I usually go to the school by the bus, and I am student.

task.prompt: 写四句：你的职业、你怎么去上课或上班、一件你第二次提到的物品、一种你泛指的东西（如茶或书）。
task.model: I am an engineer. I go to work by train. I bought a notebook yesterday, and the notebook is already full. Tea keeps me awake.
rubric: 职业有 a 或 an，而且 an 按发音选择。
交通方式没有多余的 the。
第二次提到的物品用了 the，泛指的不可数或复数没有乱加 a。

lessons.title: 可数、不可数与量词
lessons.goal: 能判断一个名词能不能加 a、能不能直接加复数，并选用 some、any、much、many、a piece of 这类量的说法。
lessons.exam: 构词和开放填空都会在名词的数上设空。information、advice、feedback 这一组几乎是中文母语者的固定失分点。

notice.prompt: 两句都想说“一些信息”。只有一句的名词形式是英语允许的。

examples.en: She gave me some information.
examples.zh: information 不可数，前面用量词 some。

examples.en: The news is encouraging.
examples.zh: news 以 s 结尾，动词却用单数 is。

notice.answer: 有些名词在中文里可以“一条、一则”地数，在英语里却是不可数的一整团：information、advice、furniture、luggage、homework、research、equipment、knowledge、progress。要数的时候，数外面的量词：a piece of advice、two pieces of luggage。

rules.title: 可数名词才能直接有复数和 a
rules.body: 可数名词有单复数：a book / books。不可数名词没有复数形式，也不能直接加 a。要表示数量，就加单位：a piece of furniture、an item of news、a loaf of bread。有些名词两种都是，意思不同：hair 满头头发不可数，a hair 一根头发可数。

examples.en: The furniture is new.
examples.zh: 家具作为整体，动词用单数。

examples.en: I need a new piece of furniture.
There is a hair in the soup.

table.caption: 先整组记住，不要临时加 -s
rows: a piece of furniture, two items of luggage

mistakes.wrong: These informations are useful.
mistakes.right: This information is useful.
mistakes.why: information 没有复数，动词用 is。

mistakes.wrong: She gave me an advice.
mistakes.right: She gave me a piece of advice.
mistakes.why: advice 不可数，不能加 an。

rules.title: some、any、much、many
rules.body: some 多用于肯定句，any 多用于否定句和疑问句，两者都能接不可数或复数。much 接不可数，many 接复数。口语里人们更常说 a lot of。a few 修饰可数，表示“有几个”；a little 修饰不可数，表示“有一点”。few / little 不加 a 时，语气是“少到几乎没有”。

examples.en: There are many reasons, but not much time.
examples.zh: reasons 可数，time 这里不可数。

examples.en: Do you have any luggage?
I have a little experience and a few contacts.

mistakes.wrong: How many homeworks do you have?
mistakes.right: How much homework do you have?
mistakes.why: homework 不可数，用 much。

mistakes.wrong: There are much people outside.
mistakes.right: There are many people outside.
mistakes.why: people 是复数，用 many。

rules.title: 看起来像复数、实际上要单独记的词
rules.body: news、mathematics、economics 作学科时用单数动词。people 表示“人们”时是复数，不能说 a people 来指一个人；一个人是 a person。police 也按复数：The police are investigating。the number of + 复数名词，动词用单数；a number of + 复数名词，动词用复数。

examples.en: The news is on at seven.
The police are outside.
The number of applicants is small, but a number of them are excellent.
examples.zh: the number 看 number，a number of 看后面的人。

rules.title: there is 和 there are 看真正的主语
rules.body: there 不是主语。后面第一个名词决定动词：There is a book on the desk. There are two books. 中文“有”不分这个。离动词最近的名词如果是不可数或单数，就用 is，即使后面还跟着一串别的东西：There is a pen and two pencils 在慎重的写法里也可以改成 There are two pencils and a pen，把复数放前面。

examples.en: There is some milk in the fridge.
There are a few eggs left.
There is not enough evidence.
examples.zh: evidence 不可数，否定用 is not。

questions.prompt: 哪一句可以交给老师？
questions.answer: Could you give me some advice?
questions.hint: advice 不能加 a，也不能加 -s。
questions.explanation: advice 不可数。some advice 或 a piece of advice 都可以。advices 不是标准说法。
options: Could you give me an advice?
Could you give me some advice?
Could you give me advices?

questions.prompt: 哪一句的动词对？
questions.answer: The number of errors is small.
questions.hint: 先找真正决定动词的那个词：news、police，还是 number。
questions.explanation: the number of 后面虽然是复数名词，动词跟 number，用 is。news 用 is，police 用 are。
options: The news are surprising.
The police is coming.
The number of errors is small.

questions.prompt: 一件行李：a ______ of luggage.
questions.answer: piece
questions.hint: luggage 本身不可数，把可数的单位加在外面。item 也可以。
questions.explanation: a piece of luggage 或 an item of luggage。

questions.prompt: 几乎没有时间，语气偏少：We have ______ time. 用 little 或 a little。
questions.answer: little
questions.hint: 没有 a 的 little 表示少得不够。
questions.explanation: little time 强调时间少到成问题。a little time 是“还有一点”。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: Someone gave me two useful pieces of information.
questions.hint: information 不变形，数 pieces。
questions.explanation: 两则信息是 two pieces of information。told me two informations 不成立。
questions.source: Someone told me two useful facts, but English will not let me pluralise information.
accepted: Someone told me two useful pieces of information.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: The feedback is useful and there is a lot of progress.
questions.hint: feedback 和 progress 都不可数。
questions.explanation: 两个名词都没有复数。feedback 用 is。progress 不能用 many，要用 a lot of 或 much，there 后面用 is。
questions.stem: The feedbacks are useful and there are many progress.

task.prompt: 写一段 40 词左右的近况，里面要出现 advice 或 information、一个 a piece of、以及 there is 或 there are。内容用你自己的学习。
task.model: There is a piece of advice I keep on my desk: do a little grammar every day. The information in my notebook is more useful than long feedbacks I never reread. I have made some progress.
rubric: advice、information、feedback、progress、homework 这一组没有被加上 -s。
量词用在不可数名词外面。
there 后面的动词和真正的名词一致。

modules.title: 介词、一致和句子骨架
modules.description: 中文的介词少，而且话题可以先扔出来再补评论。英语的介词和动词绑在一起，一个句子也必须有能做主语的成分。

lessons.title: 介词：少加、多加、用错
lessons.goal: 能处理最容易从中文直接搬过来的一组介词：discuss、marry、arrive、depend、look forward to。
lessons.exam: 开放填空的介词空不考冷僻词，就考这些高频搭配。多写一个 about 或 of，句子就会露出中文的底。

notice.prompt: 两句都想说“讨论这个计划”。动词本身已经包含“讨论某事”，其中一句多放了一个介词。

examples.en: We discussed the plan.
examples.zh: discuss 直接接讨论的内容。

examples.en: It depends on the weather.
examples.zh: depend 不能单独站住，要 on。

notice.answer: 有的动词在中文里常跟着“关于、和、到”，英语里这些词已经包含在动词里，不能再加：discuss the plan，不是 discuss about。反过来，有的动词必须有介词：depend on、listen to、wait for。要一个一个记，不能按中文的介词去翻译。

rules.title: 不要多加的那一组
rules.body: discuss something、enter the room、marry someone、approach the city、leave Beijing、return the book。这些动词直接接宾语。return 已经有“回”的意思，不必再说 return back。repeat 也通常不必再加 again，除非你故意强调“又一次”。

examples.en: They discussed the budget for an hour.
She married her colleague in May.
He returned to Shanghai last night.
examples.zh: 回到某地是 return to。return back 多余。

mistakes.wrong: Let us discuss about the date.
mistakes.right: Let us discuss the date.
mistakes.why: discuss 直接接内容。要说“关于”时，换动词 talk about。

mistakes.wrong: She married with a doctor.
mistakes.right: She married a doctor.
mistakes.why: marry 接人。可以说 be married to someone。

mistakes.wrong: Please return back the form.
mistakes.right: Please return the form.
mistakes.why: return 已含“还回去”。

rules.title: 不能省的那一组
rules.body: depend on、insist on、listen to、wait for、belong to、apologise to someone for something、arrive in a city / arrive at a building、be good at、be interested in、be responsible for。介词是动词或形容词的一部分，换掉就不是这个意思。

examples.en: The decision depends on the data.
We arrived in Lisbon at noon and at the hotel an hour later.
examples.zh: 大城市、国家用 in，具体地点用 at。

examples.en: She apologised to the client for the delay.
examples.zh: 向谁用 to，为了什么用 for。

table.caption: 到达和擅长
rows: arrive in a country or city
arrive at a building or event

mistakes.wrong: The result depends of the sample.
mistakes.right: The result depends on the sample.
mistakes.why: depend 的介词是 on。

mistakes.wrong: He arrived to the airport.
mistakes.right: He arrived at the airport.
mistakes.why: arrive 不和 to 搭配。

rules.title: to 有时是介词，后面是 -ing
rules.body: look forward to、be used to、object to 里面的 to 是介词，不是不定式符号。后面接名词或动名词：I look forward to hearing from you。中文“期待听到”很容易写成 look forward to hear。

examples.en: I look forward to meeting you.
She is used to getting up early.
They object to changing the date.

mistakes.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
mistakes.right: I look forward to hearing from you.
mistakes.why: 这里的 to 是介词。

mistakes.wrong: I am used to get up early.
mistakes.right: I am used to getting up early.
mistakes.why: be used to 表示习惯，后面是 -ing。used to get up 才是“过去常常”。

rules.title: 时间、地点里最容易混的 in / on / at
rules.body: at 用于钟点、at night、at the weekend（英式）。on 用于具体某一天和 on Monday morning。in 用于月、年、季节、in the morning。地点上，at 是点，in 是范围里面，on 是表面或线上。

examples.en: The meeting is at 9 on Monday in March.
examples.zh: 钟点、日期、月份各用一个。

examples.en: The keys are on the desk in the office.
examples.zh: 表面用 on，空间里面用 in。

examples.en: She lives in Nanjing.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的介词是对的？
questions.answer: The outcome depends on the sample size.
questions.hint: 三个动词各有自己的习惯，不要从中文“关于、到”去猜。
questions.explanation: depend on 是固定搭配。discuss 不加 about，arrive 不加 to。
options: We should discuss about the risks.
The outcome depends on the sample size.
They arrived to the station late.

questions.prompt: look forward to 后面接什么？
questions.answer: hearing from you
questions.hint: 先判断这个 to 是不定式还是介词。
questions.explanation: look forward to 的 to 是介词，后面用动名词 hearing。
options: hear from you
hearing from you
heard from you

questions.prompt: 她很擅长解释复杂的句子：She is good ______ explaining complicated sentences.
questions.answer: at
questions.hint: good 后面的介词不是 in，也不是 for。
questions.explanation: be good at something / at doing something。

questions.prompt: 向客户为延误道歉：She apologised ______ the client ______ the delay. 两个介词按顺序写。
questions.answer: to, for
questions.hint: 人前面一个介词，原因前面另一个。
questions.explanation: apologise to somebody for something。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I look forward to receiving your reply.
questions.hint: 关键词要带动 look forward to，而且 to 后面是 -ing。
questions.explanation: 期待收到回信用 look forward to receiving。hear 的版本是 look forward to hearing from you。
questions.source: I cannot wait to receive your reply.
accepted: I am looking forward to receiving your reply.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: We discussed the plan and then we arrived home in the evening.
questions.hint: discuss、arrive home、evening 三处各有一个习惯说法。
questions.explanation: discuss 直接接 plan。home 是副词性的地点，arrived home 不加 to。晚上用 in the evening。
questions.stem: We discussed about the plan and then we arrived to home at evening.

task.prompt: 写三句和你的一周有关的话，分别用上 depend on、arrive in 或 arrive at、look forward to。
task.model: My timetable depends on the project. I arrive at the library at eight. I look forward to finishing the chapter this weekend.
rubric: depend 后面是 on，discuss 没有多余的 about。
arrive 的介词和地点的大小匹配，home 没有加 to。
look forward to 后面是 -ing，不是动词原形。

lessons.title: 主谓一致、形式主语和从句怎么连
lessons.goal: 能让动词跟真正的主语一致，用 it 顶住“重要的是……”，并且不再把 although 和 but 叠在一起。
lessons.exam: 写作的语言分很看句子能不能站住。话题先抛出来、连接词成对出现，是中文结构直接搬进英语的典型样子。

notice.prompt: 中文可以把话题放在前面，再评论：“这件事，我觉得很难。”英语的这一句如果没有真正的主语，动词就无处可去。

examples.en: This problem is difficult.
examples.zh: 主语是 this problem，句子完整。

examples.en: It is difficult to explain this problem.
examples.zh: it 占据主语位置，真正的内容在后面。

notice.answer: 英语的普通陈述句需要一个主语。中文允许省略，也允许“话题 + 评论”。It is important to rest 里的 it 没有具体所指，它的工作是把主语的位置填上。although 已经把让步关系说完，后面不能再来一个 but。

rules.title: 动词跟着真正的主语，不跟着最近的装饰
rules.body: 主语如果是动名词或不定式，动词用单数：Reading these reports takes time。either / neither / each / every 在慎重的写法里接单数动词。together with、as well as 不改变前面主语的单复数。

examples.en: Understanding the question takes longer than answering it.
examples.zh: 动名词短语作主语，用 takes。

examples.en: Neither of the options is ideal.
examples.zh: neither of 在正式写法里用单数。

examples.en: The editor, as well as the reviewers, has signed.
examples.zh: 真正的主语仍是 the editor。

mistakes.wrong: Every student have a laptop.
mistakes.right: Every student has a laptop.
mistakes.why: every 后面的名词和动词都按单数。

mistakes.wrong: The results of the test is ready.
mistakes.right: The results of the test are ready.
mistakes.why: 主语是 results，不是 test。

rules.title: 用 it 填上主语的位置
rules.body: It is important / easy / possible / clear + to do 或 that 从句。中文“重要的是休息”可以直接开头，英语不行。同样，天气、时间和距离也用 it：It is cold. It is six o'clock. It is a long way。

examples.en: It is essential to read the question twice.
examples.zh: it 占位，to read 才是真正要说的事。

examples.en: It is clear that the sample was too small.
It takes twenty minutes to get there.
examples.zh: 时间和距离的 it 也不翻译成“它”。

mistakes.wrong: Is important to sleep.
mistakes.right: It is important to sleep.
mistakes.why: 不能把 is 放在句首来代替主语。

mistakes.wrong: This book, I like it very much.
mistakes.right: I like this book.
mistakes.why: 不要先扔话题再补一句。英语直接让 book 做宾语。

rules.title: although 和 but、because 和 so，只能留一个
rules.body: although / even though / though 是从属连词，but 是并列连词。一组对比里只用一个。because 和 so 也一样。可以写成 Although he was tired, he finished，或 He was tired, but he finished。两个都留下，句子就有了两个连词、却没有正确的连接。

examples.en: Although the data is limited, the pattern is clear.
examples.zh: although 开头，主句前不要 but。

examples.en: The data is limited, but the pattern is clear.
examples.zh: 改用 but，就要拿掉 although。

examples.en: Because the road was closed, we walked.
examples.zh: because 小句之后，主句不再加 so。

mistakes.wrong: Although it was late, but we continued.
mistakes.right: Although it was late, we continued.
mistakes.why: but 必须删掉，或改写整句。

mistakes.wrong: Because it rained, so the match stopped.
mistakes.right: Because it rained, the match stopped.
mistakes.why: so 和 because 二选一。

rules.title: 一个英语句子先找主语和限定动词
rules.body: 限定动词是能体现时态、能做谓语的那个。I reading a book 没有限定动词，因为 reading 只是分词。正确的是 I am reading 或 I read。从句也一样：如果 although 后面要接句子，里面仍要有自己的主语和动词，不能只丢一个名词。

examples.en: Although she was tired, she continued.
examples.zh: 两个小句各有主语和动词。

examples.en: I find it hard to start.
examples.zh: find 是限定动词，to start 不是句子。

examples.en: The idea that he proposed is new.
examples.zh: proposed 在从句里，主句动词是 is。

table.caption: 先切成小句
rows: 不是限定动词，不能单独当谓语

questions.prompt: 哪一句是完整而且自然的英语？
questions.answer: Although the room was noisy, she concentrated.
questions.hint: although 和 but 只能留一个。despite 后面不接完整句子。
questions.explanation: 第二句让步关系只用了 although。第一句叠了 but。despite 要接名词或 -ing，不能直接接 the room was noisy；那样要说 despite the noise。
options: Although the room was noisy, but she concentrated.
Although the room was noisy, she concentrated.
Despite the room was noisy, she concentrated.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的一致是对的？
questions.answer: Neither of the drafts is ready.
questions.hint: 看主语的核心，不看最近的复数名词。
questions.explanation: neither of 在这种正式句子里用 is。understanding 作主语要用 takes。every answer 用 has。
options: Understanding these charts take time.
Every answer have been checked.
Neither of the drafts is ready.

questions.prompt: 把主语补上：______ is difficult to hear the difference.
questions.answer: It
questions.hint: 中文可以没有这个字，英语的 is 前面需要位置。
questions.explanation: It is difficult to … 是固定的占位结构。

questions.prompt: 因为路封了，比赛停了。只保留一个连词：______ the road was closed, the match stopped.
questions.answer: Because
questions.hint: 句末没有 so，所以句首用 because。
questions.explanation: Because the road was closed, the match stopped. 如果想用 so，要写成 The road was closed, so the match stopped。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: Although the experiment failed, the team still learned from it.
questions.hint: although 放在让步小句前，主句不要再加 but。
questions.explanation: 两句合成一个让步句。The team still learned from it although the experiment failed 也可以。
questions.source: The experiment failed. The team still learned from it.
accepted: The team still learned from the experiment although it failed.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: I think this problem is difficult. Because the data set is small, we need more time.
questions.hint: 先取消话题句，再拆开 because 和 so。
questions.explanation: 英语不把 this problem 扔在句首再另起评论。because 和 so 只能留一个。data 在这里如果要说“数据集”，用 data set；单说 data 时动词常用单数，但“太少”更自然的是 limited 或 small sample。
questions.stem: This problem, I think it is very difficult, because the data is small, so we need more time.

task.prompt: 用 although 写一句你最近遇到的困难，用 It is difficult to 再写一句，用 every 或 neither 写一句。三句都关于你自己的学习。
task.model: Although the article was long, I finished it. It is difficult to notice missing articles. Neither of my last two drafts is free of tense errors.
rubric: although 没有和 but 同时出现。
It is … to … 有形式主语。
every 或 neither 的动词是单数。

modules.title: 基础回顾自检
modules.description: 把前面的漏洞放在同一句话里。中文母语者很少一次只错一种，自检要能在一句里同时看见时态、冠词和连接。

lessons.title: 中文母语者高频错误对照
lessons.goal: 能认出并改正一组反复出现的中式英语：缺冠词、动词形式叠用、介词多余、话题句、very 修饰动词。
lessons.exam: 这一课不引入新形式。它对应写作里语言分被集中扣掉的那些痕迹，也对应开放填空里的功能词。

notice.prompt: 同一件生活小事，一句是按中文词序排出来的，一句是英语自己的骨架。

examples.en: I very like this book.
I really like this book.
examples.zh: really 可以修饰动词，very much 放在后面也行。

notice.answer: very 修饰形容词和副词：very tired、very quickly。它不修饰动词。喜欢的程度用 really like 或 like very much。类似的直接翻译还有 open the light、close the computer 表示关机、people is、he suggest me to go。

rules.title: 程度和开关：词不能按中文对号入座
rules.body: very like、very enjoy 不成立。open / close 用于门、窗、盒子和眼睛；电器和灯用 turn on / turn off 或 switch on / off。say 后面不接人，tell 才接人：tell me，say that …，speak English，talk to someone。

examples.en: I like the course very much.
examples.zh: 程度放在动词短语后面。

examples.en: Please turn off the light.
She told me the news and then said that she had to leave.

mistakes.wrong: He said me the truth.
mistakes.right: He told me the truth.
mistakes.why: say 不直接接人。

mistakes.wrong: Please open the light.
mistakes.right: Please turn on the light.
mistakes.why: 灯用 turn on。

rules.title: 动词形式不要叠两层
rules.body: 一个谓语位置只留一个限定动词。am go、can to do、suggest to do、hope going 都是把两种形式叠在一起。情态动词后面是原形：can go、must leave。suggest 接 -ing，或 suggest that someone do；不接 to，也不接 suggest someone to do。

examples.en: She can drive.
examples.zh: 情态动词后用原形，没有 to。

examples.en: I suggest leaving early.
I hope to leave early.

mistakes.wrong: He suggested me to apply.
mistakes.right: He suggested that I apply.
mistakes.why: 不能说 suggest someone to do。也可以说 suggested applying。

mistakes.wrong: She can to speak German.
mistakes.right: She can speak German.
mistakes.why: can 后面不加 to。

rules.title: 话题先扔出来，英语接不住
rules.body: This book, I like it 要把 book 放进句子里当宾语或主语。My hometown, it is small 直接说 My hometown is small。多余的 it 往往说明前面的名词并没有真正进入句子。

examples.en: I like this book.
My hometown is small but lively.
examples.zh: hometown 做主语，不必再加 it is。

examples.en: As for the budget, we can discuss it tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果真的要先提话题，用 as for，而且主句仍然完整。

mistakes.wrong: The meeting, we postponed it.
mistakes.right: We postponed the meeting.
mistakes.why: 先写主语和动词。

mistakes.wrong: In my opinion, I think it is good.
mistakes.right: I think it is good.
mistakes.why: in my opinion 和 I think 留一个就够。

rules.title: 对照表：一句里常常不止一个错
rules.body: 改句子时按固定顺序看：时间状语决定时态；可数单数有没有限定词；介词是多了还是少了；连接词是不是成对出现；最后才看用词像不像中文。一次只改你看见的第一处，第二处还会留下。

examples.en: Yesterday she finished a report.
examples.zh: 过去时间 + 过去式 + 可数单数的 a。

examples.en: Although she was tired, she finished it.
She is good at writing and looks forward to publishing it.
examples.zh: at 和 to 后面都是 -ing。

table.caption: 修改顺序
rows: 这段时间有没有被 yesterday、in 2019 关上？
可数单数有没有 a / the / 物主代词？
这个动词是多加了 about，还是少了 on？
although 和 but 是不是都在？

questions.prompt: 哪一句自然？
questions.answer: I really like early mornings.
questions.hint: very 不能站在动词前面当程度。
questions.explanation: really like 或 like … very much 才修饰动词。am very like 把 be 和动词叠在一起，而且 very 仍然没有修饰对。
options: I very like early mornings.
I really like early mornings.
I am very like early mornings.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的“说”用对了？
questions.answer: She told me to wait.
questions.hint: 后面有人，而且是“叫我等待”。
questions.explanation: tell someone to do something。say 不接人加不定式，speak 也不这样用。
options: She said me to wait.
She told me to wait.
She spoke me to wait.

questions.prompt: 情态动词后面：You must ______ (to submit / submit) the form today. 填动词。
questions.answer: submit
questions.hint: must 后面是原形，没有 to。
questions.explanation: must submit。to submit 会和情态动词叠在一起。

questions.prompt: 建议：I suggest ______ (leave) before the rush hour.
questions.answer: leaving
questions.hint: suggest 后面这一格是 -ing，不是 to leave。
questions.explanation: suggest leaving。另一种完整写法是 suggest that we leave。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: Please turn on the light.
questions.hint: 灯和电器用 turn on。
questions.explanation: open the light 是按中文“开灯”对出来的。英语是 turn on the light。
questions.source: Please switch the light to the open position.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: My teacher told me that I really like grammar, but I must practise more.
questions.hint: 人物重复、said me、very like、must to，四处都要动。
questions.explanation: my teacher 已经是主语，不能再加 he。告诉某人是 told me。really like 或 like grammar very much。must 后面直接加 practise。英式动词拼写 practise，美式 practice 作动词也可接受。
questions.stem: My teacher he said me that I very like grammar but I must to practise more.
accepted: My teacher told me that I like grammar very much, but I must practice more.

task.prompt: 从你最近的一段中文思路里译三句英语，然后用修改顺序自查：时间、名词、介词、连接。把自查时改过的地方留在草稿里。
task.model: I went to the library yesterday. It is difficult to start, but I finished a chapter. I look forward to discussing it with my teacher.
rubric: 没有 very + 动词，也没有 open the light 这类直译。
没有多余的话题主语。
你确实改过至少一处，并在句子里留得通顺。

lessons.title: 基础关卡：把模块 0 放进同一段话
lessons.goal: 能在短文长度里同时守住时态、冠词、名词的数、介词和连接，作为进入后面课程的自检。
lessons.exam: 这是阶段 0 的关卡。阅读与运用不会一次只考一个点；你自己的段落也不会。过关再进入情态和条件句。

notice.prompt: 读这一小段，数一数有几处你会停下来。

examples.en: Yesterday I have received an information.
examples.zh: 时间和名词的数都出了问题。

examples.en: Yesterday I received some information.
examples.zh: 过去的时间用一般过去时，information 不可数。

notice.answer: 一句里可以同时错两种。改的时候按模块 0 的顺序：先时态，再名词和冠词，再介词，再连接。这一课的练习都是综合的，用来决定你要不要回到 m1–m3。

rules.title: 关卡怎么打分才诚实
rules.body: 六道题都先自己做，不要打开参考答案。首答对了四题或更少，就回到对应的课：时态回 m1，冠词和名词回 m2，介词和句子骨架回 m3。对了五题，只复习错的那一课。六题全对，也请在一周后再做一次错题复习，因为首答正确不等于已经稳定。

examples.en: I saw her yesterday.
examples.zh: 明确的过去，一般过去时。

examples.en: She gave me a piece of advice.
Although it was hard, I continued.

rules.title: 一段话里的时间只能有一条线
rules.body: 如果故事发生在昨天，背景用过去进行时，事件用一般过去时，更早的用过去完成时。不要突然跳到现在完成时，除非你明确地评论现在的结果，并且不再使用 yesterday。

examples.en: I was reading when the lights went out.
I had saved the file, so nothing was lost.
I have been more careful since then.
examples.zh: since then 把时间重新连到现在，这是新的一句，不是 yesterday 的一部分。

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I have lost my keys, so I was late.
mistakes.right: Yesterday I lost my keys, so I was late.
mistakes.why: yesterday 把时间关上，用一般过去时。现在的结果另起一句才可以用现在完成时。

mistakes.wrong: I have been lived here since 2019.
mistakes.right: I have lived here since 2019.
mistakes.why: 完成体不要再叠 been，除非是 have been living。

rules.title: 名词短语先装完整再往下写
rules.body: 可数单数：a / the / 物主代词之一必须出现。不可数：不加 a、不加复数。特指的那一个用 the，第一次出现的一个用 a。写完一句就检查名词，不要等整段写完。

examples.en: I opened a window. The window faces the street.
examples.zh: 第一次 a，第二次 the。

examples.en: Research takes time.
The people in my group are helpful.

rules.title: 读出声，听主语和动词
rules.body: 把草稿读出来。凡是你不得不在动词前补一个“它”或者在名词前犹豫的地方，多半就是缺主语或然冠词。although 开头的句子，读到逗号时检查后半句有没有 but。

examples.en: It is worth reading the footnote.
Because the file was damaged, we started again.
We arrived in Chengdu on Friday.
examples.zh: 城市用 in，日子用 on。

questions.prompt: 选出没有错误的一句。
questions.answer: Although I was tired, I finished the report yesterday.
questions.hint: 先看 although 和 but，再看 yesterday 允许哪种时态。
questions.explanation: although 不能和 but 连用。yesterday 要用一般过去时 finished，不能用 have finished。
options: Although I was tired, but I finished the report yesterday.
Although I was tired, I finished the report yesterday.
Although I was tired, I have finished the report yesterday.

questions.prompt: 选出没有错误的一句。
questions.answer: She gave me some advice about the research.
questions.hint: advice 和 research 在这种泛指里都不可数。
questions.explanation: some advice 正确。an advice 和 advices 都不成立。research 作为活动也不要加复数。
options: She gave me an advice about the research.
She gave me some advice about the research.
She gave me some advices about the researches.

questions.prompt: 综合填空，写出所缺的两个词：We arrived ______ Shanghai ______ Monday.
questions.answer: in, on
questions.hint: 城市一个介词，星期一个介词。
questions.explanation: arrive in a city，on Monday。

questions.prompt: 把动词写成正确形式：Neither of the answers ______ (be) acceptable.
questions.answer: is
questions.hint: neither of 在这种句子里用单数。
questions.explanation: is。口语里能听到 are，但正式写作用 is。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I have been learning the piano since five years ago.
questions.hint: 从五年前持续到现在。since 可以接 five years ago 这个起点。
questions.explanation: I have been learning the piano for five years 更常见。既然关键词是 SINCE，就用 since I started 或 since five years ago。
questions.source: I started to learn the piano five years ago, and I still learn it.
accepted: I have learned the piano since five years ago.
I have been learning the piano since I started five years ago.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: Yesterday I discussed some important information with my manager. Although he was busy, he gave me a piece of advice.
questions.hint: 时态、discuss、冠词、information、although/but、advice，全部挤在一句里。
questions.explanation: yesterday 用 discussed。discuss 不加 about。information 不可数，前面用 some，important 前面不是 a。although 和 but 留一个。advice 要说 a piece of advice。
questions.stem: Yesterday I have discussed about a important information with my manager, and although he was busy, but he gave me an advice.

task.prompt: 写 80–100 词，讲一件昨天发生、而且现在还有影响的事。写完用四步清单自查，并把你改过的两处留在草稿下面。
task.model: Yesterday I was writing a summary when I noticed a gap in the data. I had collected the figures in the morning, but one column was missing. I discussed the problem with my manager. Although she was busy, she gave me a piece of advice. I have been more careful since then.
rubric: 昨天的叙述没有和现在完成时混在同一个时间状语里。
冠词、不可数名词和介词经得起四步清单。
although 或 because 没有和 but、so 叠用。

modules.title: 时态再往前走
modules.description: 模块 0 只把大门关上。这一模块处理完成和进行叠在一起时的差别，以及英语用来说将来的四种常见办法。

lessons.title: 现在完成、现在完成进行和一般过去
lessons.goal: 能根据“完成的结果”还是“还看得到的过程”选择 have done 或 have been doing，并在有明确过去时间时退回一般过去时。
lessons.exam: 写作叙述和开放填空都会在 have been 上设空。选错不会让句子完全看不懂，但会把“做完了”说成“还在做”。

notice.prompt: 两句都和阅读有关。一句强调成果，一句强调过程还在眼前。

examples.en: I have read the report.
examples.zh: 报告读完了，成果可以拿来用。

examples.en: I have been reading the report.
examples.zh: 最近一直在读，不一定读完，过程是重点。

notice.answer: have read 把这件事看成一个完成的结果。have been reading 把镜头停在持续的过程上。如果加上 this morning 而早上已经过去，并且你要强调“当时做了”，才改用一般过去时。

rules.title: 完成进行时强调过程、持续和未完
rules.body: have / has been + -ing 用来表示从过去延续到现在的动作，常常带有“还没结束”或“刚刚还在进行，所以现在能看见痕迹”。它和 for / since 很合得来。状态动词仍然很少用：不说 have been knowing。

examples.en: I have been waiting for an hour.
examples.zh: 等这个动作持续了一小时，而且多半还在等。

examples.en: She has been writing her thesis since March.
examples.zh: 从三月写到现在，过程未完。

examples.en: Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?
examples.zh: 现在的痕迹来自刚刚持续的动作。

table.caption: 结果还是过程
rows: I have been writing all day.

rules.title: 有明确的完成数量时，优先用完成时
rules.body: 句子里如果有明确的次数或完成的件数，现在完成时更合适，因为进行体和“数得清的成品”相冲突。I have been writing four emails 听起来像四封都没写完。

examples.en: I have sent four emails.
I have been sending emails all morning.
examples.zh: 一上午都在发，不强调件数。

examples.en: She has visited the lab three times.

mistakes.wrong: I have been finishing the book three times.
mistakes.right: I have finished the book three times.
mistakes.why: 次数说明每一次都完成了。

mistakes.wrong: I have read this article all morning.
mistakes.right: I have been reading this article all morning.
mistakes.why: all morning 强调持续的过程。

rules.title: 过去时间门一关，就离开现在完成
rules.body: this morning 要看现在是不是还在上午。如果已经是下午，而你只是陈述上午发生的事，用一般过去时。this week 如果这周还没过完，可以用现在完成。in the morning 作为习惯仍是一般现在时。

examples.en: I have written two pages this morning.
I wrote two pages this morning.
examples.zh: 现在已经是下午，上午被关上了。

examples.en: We have had three meetings this week.

rules.title: used to 和 would：过去的习惯，不是完成体
rules.body: used to 表示过去常常、现在不再这样。would 也可以表示过去的习惯，但通常不用于状态：不说 would live，可以说 used to live。不要和 be used to -ing（习惯于）混在一起，那是后面非谓语课的内容。

examples.en: I used to walk to work. Now I cycle.
On Sundays she would call her parents.
I used to know that street well.
examples.zh: 过去的状态用 used to，不用 would。

mistakes.wrong: I was used to walk to school.
mistakes.right: I used to walk to school.
mistakes.why: 过去常常是 used to + 原形，没有 was。

mistakes.wrong: I have been lived here for years.
mistakes.right: I have lived here for years.
mistakes.why: 完成体不要再叠一个 been，除非是进行体 have been living。

questions.prompt: 你要强调“一上午都在写，还没写完”。哪一句对？
questions.answer: I have been writing all morning.
questions.hint: 过程持续到现在，用完成进行时。
questions.explanation: have been writing 同时有“持续”和“连着现在”。have written 更像已经写完。第三句把现在进行和 yesterday 硬拼，不成立。
options: I have written all morning.
I have been writing all morning.
I am writing all morning yesterday.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的数量和时态匹配？
questions.answer: I have sent twelve reports.
questions.hint: 十二份是数得清的成品。
questions.explanation: 明确的完成数量用 have sent。进行体不适合拿来清点已经完成的件数。
options: I have been sending twelve reports.
I have sent twelve reports.
I have sent twelve reports all morning and they are unfinished.

questions.prompt: 你的眼睛红了。刚刚是不是一直在看屏幕？Your eyes are red. ______ you ______ (look) at a screen?
questions.answer: Have, been looking
questions.hint: 现在的痕迹，问刚刚持续的动作。
questions.explanation: Have you been looking at a screen? 用完成进行时。

questions.prompt: 过去的习惯、现在不这样了：I ______ (use) to forget the article. Now I check.
questions.answer: used
questions.hint: used to + 原形，没有 be。
questions.explanation: I used to forget。否定是 did not use to forget。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I have been repairing the bike since noon.
questions.hint: 关键词 BEEN 要出现在 have been repairing 里。
questions.explanation: 从中午持续到现在，用现在完成进行时。for several hours 也可以，但原句给的是起点 noon。
questions.source: I started repairing the bike at noon, and I am still repairing it.
accepted: I have been repairing the bike since noon, and I still am.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: I wrote three reports yesterday, and I used to do them quickly.
questions.hint: 昨天的件数离开现在完成；过去常常不要 was used to。
questions.explanation: yesterday 加上三份完成的报告，用 wrote。used to do 才是过去的习惯。was used to doing 才会是“习惯于”，而且 doing 也不能换成 do。
questions.stem: I have been written three reports yesterday and I was used to do them quickly.

task.prompt: 写两句对照：一句用 have done 说出你最近完成的数量，一句用 have been doing 说出你这周还在进行的事。再加一句 used to。
task.model: I have finished two problem sets. I have been reading a novel about cities since Sunday. I used to leave all my reading until Sunday night.
rubric: 数量用了现在完成时，过程用了完成进行时。
没有把 yesterday 和 have been 放在一起。
used to 后面是原形，没有 was。

lessons.title: 将来：will、be going to、现在进行和时刻表
lessons.goal: 能按“临时决定、已有证据、已经安排、时刻表”四种情况选择说将来的方式。
lessons.exam: 听力里的计划和写作里的预测都靠这个差别。中文一个“会”盖住了这四种。

notice.prompt: 两句都是将来。一句是说话这一刻才决定的，一句是早就看出来的。

examples.en: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
Look at those clouds. It is going to rain.
examples.zh: 眼前已有证据，用 be going to。

notice.answer: will 常用于说话时刚刚做出的决定、承诺和单纯的预测。be going to 用于说话前已经有的打算，或根据眼前证据做出的判断。已经写进日程的个人安排用现在进行时。列车和课表用一般现在时。

rules.title: will：当下的决定、承诺、看法
rules.body: 电话响了你才说 I will get it，这是临时决定。I will help you 是承诺。I think she will agree 是观点式的预测，眼前并没有一块乌云当证据。否定是 will not / won't。

examples.en: That bag looks heavy. I will carry it.
examples.zh: 看到的这一刻才决定帮忙。

examples.en: I will send the file tonight.
I expect the committee will agree.

mistakes.wrong: I will to send it tonight.
mistakes.right: I will send it tonight.
mistakes.why: will 后面是原形，没有 to。

mistakes.wrong: The phone is ringing. I am going to answer it — I have just decided.
mistakes.right: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
mistakes.why: 说话这一刻才做出的决定用 will，不用 be going to。

rules.title: be going to：早有打算，或证据就在眼前
rules.body: I am going to learn Spanish next year 表示这个打算在说话前就有了。Those clouds mean it is going to rain 是有迹象的预测。不要每句将来都用 be going to，它比 will 更“早就如此”。

examples.en: I am going to retake the practice test in June.
She is going to have a baby.
Be careful. That pile is going to fall.

rules.title: 现在进行时和一般现在时也能说将来
rules.body: I am meeting Lin at four 是约好的安排。The course starts on 3 May 是项目或时刻表，个人改不了。不要用现在进行时说自然规律的将来：不说 The sun is rising at 6 tomorrow 来当时刻表，说 The sun rises at 6。

examples.en: We are having dinner with them on Saturday.
The registration closes on Friday.
examples.zh: 官方截止日期，像时刻表。

examples.en: The train leaves at 18:40.

rules.title: 时间状语从句里不用 will
rules.body: when、after、as soon as、until 引导的时间从句，即使用来谈将来，也用一般现在时。will 留在主句。If it rains, we will stay in 里的 if 也一样，这和条件句课相连。

examples.en: I will call you when I arrive.
As soon as she finishes, we will leave.
Wait here until the bell rings.

mistakes.wrong: I will phone you when I will arrive.
mistakes.right: I will phone you when I arrive.
mistakes.why: 时间从句里用现在时表示将来。

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, I will stay in.
mistakes.right: If it rains, I will stay in.
mistakes.why: 真实条件的 if 从句同样不用 will。

questions.prompt: 门铃响了，你这才决定去开门。你说：
questions.answer: I will open it.
questions.hint: 决定发生在说话这一刻。
questions.explanation: 临时决定用 will。be going to 更像事先的打算。
options: I am going to open it, as I planned yesterday.
I will open it.
I open it every future.

questions.prompt: 课表上写着五月开学。哪一句合适？
questions.answer: The term starts on 3 May.
questions.hint: 官方日程像列车时刻表。
questions.explanation: 时刻表用一般现在时。will to start 多了 to。第一项不是干净的英语。
options: The term is going to start on 3 May, as a personal intention.
The term starts on 3 May.
The term will to start on 3 May.

questions.prompt: 时间从句：I will review the notes after I ______ (get) home.
questions.answer: get
questions.hint: after 从句谈将来，仍用现在时。
questions.explanation: after I get home，主句才用 will review。

questions.prompt: 乌云压过来了：It ______ (go) to rain.
questions.answer: is going
questions.hint: 眼前有证据。
questions.explanation: It is going to rain。主语 it，be 用 is。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I am going to apply for the course in March.
questions.hint: 打算在说话之前就有了，用 be going to。
questions.explanation: 关键词 GOING 放进 am going to apply。I am going to apply 表示已经有的计划。
questions.source: The plan already exists: I apply for the course in March.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: When I arrive, I will call you.
questions.hint: 时间从句不能有 will；说话这一刻的决定也不是 going to。
questions.explanation: when I arrive 用现在时。临时决定用 will call。后半句的解释可以删掉，因为它和 going to 的“早已打算”矛盾。
questions.stem: When I will arrive, I am going to call you, because I decided it at this very moment.

task.prompt: 写四句你的下周：一句临时才想到的承诺，一句早已有的计划，一句已经约好的见面，一句课程或交通的时刻。
task.model: I will send you the article tonight. I am going to reorganise my notes next week. I am meeting my tutor on Wednesday. The seminar starts at 10.
rubric: will 用在当下的决定或承诺。
be going to 是事先的打算。
约好的事用现在进行时，时刻用一般现在时。

modules.title: 情态动词：现在
modules.description: 情态动词表达的是说话人的判断，不是动作本身。证据有多硬，就选多硬的词。

lessons.title: 推测：must、can't、may、might、could
lessons.goal: 能按证据强弱选择现在的推测，并分清 can't 是“不可能”，不是 must not 的简单反义。
lessons.exam: 听力要听出说话人有多确定。写作里用 must 说出一个其实只是可能的判断，会被看成推理过满。

notice.prompt: 灯亮着，包在椅子上。两句判断的硬度不一样。

examples.en: She must be in the office.
examples.zh: 证据很强，几乎可以肯定。

examples.en: She might be in the office.

notice.answer: must 是根据证据做出的强判断。might 和 may 把判断松开。can't 是强判断的反面：证据说明这件事不可能。must not 更常用来表示禁止，不要拿它代替 can't 做推测。

rules.title: 证据越硬，词越满
rules.body: 从强到弱可以排成：must、should（按理说）、may / might / could。could 在推测里不等于 can 的过去式，它表示“有这个可能”。can 表示理论上可能：Noise can be a problem，不是“我猜现在有噪音”。

examples.en: The lights are on. She must be upstairs.
She may be upstairs, but I have not checked.
Applications can take a month.
examples.zh: 一般情况可能如此，不是对眼前这一份的推测。

mistakes.wrong: He must not be at home — the lights are off, so it is impossible.
mistakes.right: He can't be at home. The lights are off.
mistakes.why: “不可能”用 can't。must not 容易被听成禁止。

mistakes.wrong: She can be in the lab right now, I suppose.
mistakes.right: She could be in the lab right now.
mistakes.why: 对眼前这一次的猜测用 could / might，不用 can。

rules.title: must 做推测时，否定不是 must not
rules.body: The signature must be genuine 的反面是 The signature can't be genuine。must not smoke 是禁止。两个 must 共用一个词形，靠语境分开。写作时如果要说“我几乎肯定不是”，用 can't。

examples.en: This figure must be wrong. It is ten times too large.
This figure can't be right.
Visitors must not enter the lab alone.

rules.title: may 和 might 几乎同样不确定
rules.body: 在当下的推测里，might 不一定比 may 更过去，也不一定更礼貌，它只是略松一点。两者后面都是原形。不要说 may to be。疑问句里问可能性，常用 could：Could this be the right file?

examples.en: This may be the file we need.
This might be the wrong version.
Could the error be in the formula?

mistakes.wrong: She may to be delayed.
mistakes.right: She may be delayed.
mistakes.why: 情态动词后不加 to。

mistakes.wrong: It can be true, because I am not sure.
mistakes.right: It might be true.
mistakes.why: 没有把握的一次判断，不用 can。

rules.title: 推测的是状态还是动作，后面的动词要跟着变
rules.body: 对现在状态：must be tired。对正在进行的动作：must be working。对经常的习惯：must work late，表示“一定是常常加班”。be + -ing 把推测放进“此刻正在”。

examples.en: He must be exhausted.
She must be reviewing the data right now.
They can't be waiting outside. The street is empty.

questions.prompt: 灯全黑，车也不在。哪一句是“几乎不可能在家”？
questions.answer: He can't be at home.
questions.hint: 强判断的否定用 can't。
questions.explanation: can't be 表示根据证据不可能。must not 更像禁止。may not 只是“也许不”，和 certain 矛盾。
options: He must not be at home.
He can't be at home.
He may not be at home, so I am certain.

questions.prompt: 哪一句是对“此刻正在”的推测？
questions.answer: She must be meeting the client now.
questions.hint: now 加上正在进行，用 must be + -ing。
questions.explanation: must be meeting 推测此刻的动作。must to be 多了 to。第一项说的是长期职业，不是这一刻。
options: She must work late every night, as a habit.
She must be meeting the client now.
She must to be in a meeting.

questions.prompt: 按理说这班车这个点该到了，但你并不确定：The bus ______ be here by now.
questions.answer: should
questions.hint: 比 might 更有根据，又没有 must 那么满。
questions.explanation: should be here 表示按时刻表按理该到。如果完全确定，才用 must。

questions.prompt: 一般可能性，不是对眼前的猜测：Winter evenings ______ be very long in the north.
questions.answer: can
questions.hint: 理论上、一般情况会如此，用 can。
questions.explanation: can be 表示有这种可能，是泛指规律，不是 must 那种当场判断。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: The file must be the old one.
questions.hint: 证据很硬，用 must be。
questions.explanation: 日期对不上，所以几乎可以肯定是旧文件：must be。否定才会变成 can't be the latest one。
questions.source: I am almost certain that the file is the old one. The date is wrong.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: He can't be the author. The style is completely different.
questions.hint: “不可能”不要用 must not。
questions.explanation: must not 会被理解成禁止。证据表明不可能时用 can't be。
questions.stem: He must not be the author because the style is completely different, so it is impossible.

task.prompt: 看你身边的一个现象（灯、空座位、未读消息），写三句：几乎肯定、不可能、只是可能。
task.model: The lamp is on, so my neighbour must be at home. She can't be asleep. She might be reading.
rubric: must、can't、might 或 may 各用了一次，硬度没有用反。
没有 must not 来表示不可能。
情态动词后面是原形或 be + -ing，没有 to。

lessons.title: 义务、建议和没有必要
lessons.goal: 能区分 must、have to、should、ought to、had better 和 needn't 的力度，并知道哪些是说话人的态度，哪些是外部规定。
lessons.exam: 写作提出建议时，must 常常过重。口语里 had better 也比中文“最好”更带警告。

notice.prompt: 两句都是“必须交”。一句来自制度，一句是说话人自己的坚持。

examples.en: You have to submit the form by Friday.
examples.zh: 外部规定：截止日期就在那里。

examples.en: You must read the footnote.
examples.zh: 说话人认为这很必要，语气硬。

notice.answer: have to 把义务放在外部：法律、学校、截止时间。must 更多是说话人自己的权威。给同级或老师提建议时，should 通常够用。needn't 表示没有必要，不是禁止。

rules.title: must 和 have to
rules.body: 在肯定句里两者都表示必须，have to 更常用于客观要求。疑问句问对方的义务，常用 Do I have to …? 否定要分开：must not 是禁止；don't have to 是没有必要。这个否定差别比肯定句更重要。

examples.en: You must not share the password.
You do not have to come early.
Do I have to sign both pages?

mistakes.wrong: You must not wear a tie. It is optional.
mistakes.right: You do not have to wear a tie.
mistakes.why: 可选的事用 don't have to，不是 must not。

mistakes.wrong: You don't have to smoke here.
mistakes.right: You must not smoke here.
mistakes.why: 如果是禁止，用 must not。

rules.title: should、ought to、had better
rules.body: should 和 ought to 是建议或按理该做，力度低于 must。ought to 后面仍然有 to。had better 带一点“不然会吃亏”的警告，后面是原形，没有 to：You had better leave now。它不是过去时，尽管里面有 had。

examples.en: You should check the units.
You ought to tell her yourself.
examples.zh: 和 should 接近，稍正式。

examples.en: You had better save the file.
examples.zh: 警告：现在不存，可能丢失。

mistakes.wrong: You had better to leave.
mistakes.right: You had better leave.
mistakes.why: had better 后不加 to。

mistakes.wrong: You should to review the chart.
mistakes.right: You should review the chart.
mistakes.why: should 后是原形。

rules.title: needn't 和 don't need to
rules.body: 现在没有必要，可以用 needn't 或 don't need to。need 作情态动词时，否定是 need not，后面原形：You needn't wait。need 作实义动词时，是 don't need to wait。两者现在都可以用。不要把 needn't 理解成 must not。

examples.en: You needn't explain the whole theory.
You do not need to print the slides.
You must not skip the safety step.

rules.title: 给读者建议时把力度降下来
rules.body: C1 的议论文里，The government must 可以用于你认为责无旁贷的事，但连续三个 must 会显得只有命令、没有分析。可以换成 should、need to、it is essential that。对读者本人，you might consider 比 you must 留有余地。

examples.en: The city should invest in the quieter option.
It is essential that the sample be large enough.
examples.zh: 正式的必要，用动词原形，下一模块会再练。

examples.en: Readers need to see the limitation.
examples.zh: 必要，但不是 must not 那种禁令。

questions.prompt: 领带可戴可不戴。你该说：
questions.answer: You do not have to wear a tie.
questions.hint: 没有义务，不是禁止。
questions.explanation: don't have to 表示不必。must not 是不准戴。had better 后不加 to。
options: You must not wear a tie.
You do not have to wear a tie.
You had better to wear a tie or not.

questions.prompt: 哪一句带有“不然会有麻烦”的警告？
questions.answer: You had better leave before the doors lock.
questions.hint: had better 比 should 更像警告。
questions.explanation: 门要锁上，所以 had better leave。needn't 是没有必要，和危险的警告相反。
options: You should maybe leave.
You had better leave before the doors lock.
You needn't leave, it is dangerous.

questions.prompt: 禁止拍照：Visitors ______ not take photographs.
questions.answer: must
questions.hint: 这里是规定，不是推测。
questions.explanation: must not 表示不准。如果只是不必，用 need not。

questions.prompt: 不必打印：You ______ print the appendix. 用 need 的情态否定，一个词。
questions.answer: needn't
questions.hint: 情态动词 need 的否定，后面还能接原形。
questions.explanation: You needn't print。don't need to print 是两个词以上，如果题目要一个词，用 needn't。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: You do not have to reply today.
questions.hint: 没有必要用 do not have to，不要写成 must not。
questions.explanation: don't have to reply 表示今天不必回。You needn't reply today 也对，但关键词是 HAVE。
questions.source: It is not necessary for you to reply today.
accepted: You don't have to reply today.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: You do not have to bring a pen. The office will lend you one.
questions.hint: 可选不是禁止。
questions.explanation: 办公室会借，所以是不必带，don't have to 或 needn't。must not bring 会变成不准带笔。
questions.stem: You must not bring a pen because the office will lend you one, so it is optional.

task.prompt: 给一个即将参加讨论的朋友写三句建议：一句禁止，一句不必，一句 had better。
task.model: You must not interrupt the speaker. You do not have to prepare slides. You had better read the abstract before you go.
rubric: must not 真的是禁止。
不必用了 don't have to 或 needn't，没有用 must not。
had better 后面是原形。

modules.title: 情态动词：过去
modules.description: 把上一课的判断挪到过去，形式变成情态动词 + have + 过去分词。中文仍然只说“当时一定”，英语要把 have 做出来。

lessons.title: 对过去的推测：must have、can't have、might have
lessons.goal: 能用 must have done 表示“当时几乎可以肯定发生了”，并用 can't have done 表示“当时不可能”。
lessons.exam: 关键词转换经常把“当时一定已经……”收成 must have。听力里的责备和推测也靠 have 后面的分词。

notice.prompt: 结果已经在眼前：路是干的。两句都在解释过去的天气，硬度不同。

examples.en: It must have rained. The road is wet.
examples.zh: 湿路面支持“下过雨”这个强判断。

examples.en: It can't have rained. The road is dry.
examples.zh: 干路面几乎排除了下雨。

notice.answer: 对过去的推测是情态动词 + have + 过去分词。must have 几乎肯定发生过。can't have 几乎肯定没发生。might have 只是有过这种可能。证据写在旁边，读者才知道你不是在乱猜。

rules.title: 结构永远是情态动词 + have + 过去分词
rules.body: 不管是 must、can't、might 还是 could，只要推测的是过去，后面就是 have done，不是 have do，也不是 had done。have 在这里是不定式，不随主语变化：She must have left，不是 must has left。

examples.en: She must have left early. Her coat is gone.
examples.zh: 几乎可以肯定已经走了。

examples.en: He can't have seen the email. He asked the same question.
They might have taken the earlier train.

table.caption: 过去的推测
rows: must have been / must have done
can't have been / can't have done

mistakes.wrong: She must has forgotten.
mistakes.right: She must have forgotten.
mistakes.why: must 后面是 have，不是 has。

mistakes.wrong: He must have went home.
mistakes.right: He must have gone home.
mistakes.why: have 后面是过去分词 gone。

rules.title: could have 既是可能，也常带着“本来可以却没有”
rules.body: 如果只是过去的可能性，could have 和 might have 接近：She could have missed the bus。如果语境是批评或遗憾，could have 表示本来做得到却没做：You could have told me。下一课的 should have 把“该做而没做”说得更明确。

examples.en: The noise could have been the printer.
You could have warned me.
examples.zh: 你本来可以提醒，但没有。

examples.en: I might have left the file at home.
examples.zh: 我可能落在家里了，尚未证实。

rules.title: 推测进行中的过去：must have been doing
rules.body: 如果判断的是过去某个时刻正在做的事，用 must have been + -ing。She must have been working at midnight 表示午夜时她正在工作，而不只是“她工作过”。

examples.en: The lights were on at midnight. She must have been working.
He can't have been listening. He asked me to repeat everything.
They might have been waiting on the other platform.

mistakes.wrong: She must have been work late.
mistakes.right: She must have been working late.
mistakes.why: -ing 不能省。

mistakes.wrong: It must rained.
mistakes.right: It must have rained.
mistakes.why: 不能省掉 have。

rules.title: 先写证据，再下判断
rules.body: C1 的写作不喜欢没有根据的 must have。可以先给事实：The road is dry, so it can't have rained。口语里也可以先抛结论，但你自己要知道证据是什么。没有证据时，把 must 降成 might。

examples.en: The seat is warm, so someone must have just left.
I am not sure. She might have forgotten.
Given the empty inbox, he can't have received it.
examples.zh: given 引出依据，是正式写法。

questions.prompt: 包还在椅子上，人不见了。哪一句合理？
questions.answer: She must have left her bag.
questions.hint: 过去的强判断要有 have 和过去分词。
questions.explanation: must have left。must has 和 must left 都少了正确的完成结构。
options: She must have left her bag.
She must has left her bag.
She must left her bag.

questions.prompt: 路面是干的。哪一句对？
questions.answer: It can't have rained.
questions.hint: 干路面排除下雨。
questions.explanation: 不可能下过雨用 can't have rained。must have rained 和干路面矛盾。must not have 不是做过去推测的常用否定。
options: It must not have rained.
It can't have rained.
It must have rained because the road is dry.

questions.prompt: 午夜灯还亮着，她当时应该正在工作：She must ______ ______ (work) at midnight.
questions.answer: have been working
questions.hint: 过去某个时刻正在进行。
questions.explanation: must have been working。

questions.prompt: 你本来可以早说。补全：You ______ have told me earlier.
questions.answer: could
questions.hint: 批评“本来可以”时，could have 很常见。should 更像本该。
questions.explanation: could have told。如果强调义务，should have told 也可以，但“本来能够说”用 could。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: They must have taken the early train.
questions.hint: 过去的强判断：must have + 过去分词。
questions.explanation: 站台空了，所以几乎可以肯定赶上了早班。They must have caught the early train 也可以。
questions.source: I am almost sure that they took the early train. The platform was empty.
accepted: They must have caught the early train.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: He must have gone already. His desk is clear.
questions.hint: have 不变形，go 的过去分词是 gone。
questions.explanation: must have gone。has 和 went 都不能用在这个结构里。
questions.stem: He must has went already, because his desk is clear, so it is certain.

task.prompt: 用你这周的一个真实结果写三句过去推测：must have、can't have、might have。每句旁边用中文注明证据，英文句子本身也要带上证据。
task.model: My notes are complete, so I must have saved them. I can't have deleted the file. I might have moved it into the wrong folder.
rubric: 三个结构都是情态动词 + have + 过去分词。
can't have 用来否定，不是 must not have。
句子里能看出证据，而不是空口判断。

lessons.title: should have、needn't have 和 didn't need to
lessons.goal: 能区分“该做却没做”“做了但其实不必”和“当时没有必要（往往就没做）”。
lessons.exam: 这是转换题里很稳的一组。中文“本来不必”和“当时不用”常常合成一句，英语要看事情到底做了没有。

notice.prompt: 两句都有 need。一句暗示白做了，一句只说当时没有这个必要。

examples.en: I needn't have printed the slides. Nobody used them.
I did not need to print the slides, so I left them on the screen.

notice.answer: should have done 表示过去该做而没做，常带遗憾或责备。shouldn't have done 表示做了不该做的。needn't have done 明确表示做了，但没有必要。didn't need to 只说没有义务，做没做要看后文；如果后文没说，读者通常以为没做。

rules.title: should have：本该
rules.body: should have + 过去分词把义务放进过去。You should have checked the date 意味着你没核对。should not have sent 意味着你发了，而且不该发。它不是 must have 那种推测。

examples.en: I should have started earlier.
You should not have replied in anger.
The report should have included the sample size.

mistakes.wrong: You should have check the date.
mistakes.right: You should have checked the date.
mistakes.why: have 后面是过去分词。

mistakes.wrong: I should have gone, and I did go — so should have is the wrong choice.
mistakes.right: I went, as I needed to.
mistakes.why: 如果做了而且做得对，不要用 should have。

rules.title: needn't have：白做了
rules.body: needn't have done 包含两个信息：做了；不必做。I needn't have brought an umbrella 意味着伞带了，却没用上。没有“做了”这个意思时，不要用它。

examples.en: You needn't have waited. I have a key.
We needn't have booked. The room was empty.
She needn't have apologised.

rules.title: didn't need to：当时没有这个必要
rules.body: did not need to + 原形不强制表示事情做了。I did not need to get up early, so I stayed in bed 明确没做。I did not need to get up early, but I did 明确做了。单独一句 I didn't need to hurry 通常理解成没必要，而且多半没着急。

examples.en: I did not need to open a new file, so I used the old one.
I did not need to cook, but I cooked anyway.
examples.zh: 没必要，但还是做了。后文必须写明。

examples.en: There was a bus, so we did not need to walk.

table.caption: 做了没有
rows: 不必做；做没做看上下文

rules.title: could have 和 should have 的责备不一样
rules.body: could have 侧重能力或选择：你当时有条件做。should have 侧重义务或明智：你当时应该做。You could have asked 是“你本来问得了”。You should have asked 是“你该问”。

examples.en: You could have used the online map.
You should have used a larger sample.
I should have listened, and I could have asked her to repeat it.
examples.zh: 义务和可能性可以同时出现。

questions.prompt: 伞带了，天却一直晴。你说：
questions.answer: I needn't have brought an umbrella.
questions.hint: 做了，而且白做。
questions.explanation: needn't have brought 同时表示“带了”和“不必带”。must have 只是推测，不表示后悔。
options: I didn't need to bring an umbrella, so I left it at home.
I needn't have brought an umbrella.
I must have brought an umbrella because the sky was clear.

questions.prompt: 报告里没有样本量，而这是本该有的。哪一句对？
questions.answer: The report should have included the sample size.
questions.hint: 本该有、实际上没有，用 should have。
questions.explanation: should have included 表示缺失。needn't have 会变成“写了但不必写”，和“里面没有”矛盾。
options: The report needn't have included the sample size.
The report should have included the sample size.
The report didn't need to include the sample size, which is a pity.

questions.prompt: 你不该在生气时回复：You ______ not have replied so angrily.
questions.answer: should
questions.hint: 做了不该做的事。
questions.explanation: should not have replied。could not have 会变成“没能回复”，意思相反。

questions.prompt: 当时没必要早起，于是我继续睡。I ______ not ______ to get up early, so I stayed in bed.
questions.answer: did, need
questions.hint: 这里要强调后来没做，用 did not need to。
questions.explanation: did not need to get up。如果写成 needn't have got up，就表示你其实起来了。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I needn't have printed the slides.
questions.hint: 打印已经发生，所以用 needn't have，不用 didn't need to。
questions.explanation: needn't have printed 正好包住“印了但不必”。
questions.source: It was unnecessary for me to print the slides, but I printed them.
accepted: I need not have printed the slides.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: You needn't have waited for me. Thank you for waiting.
questions.hint: 人已经等了，所以不能用 should have。
questions.explanation: should have waited 表示对方没有等。既要感谢又要说不必等，用 Thank you for waiting. You needn't have。
questions.stem: You should have waited for me. Thank you for waiting even though it was unnecessary.

task.prompt: 写三句你自己的小事：本该做却没做、做了但不必、当时没必要所以没做。
task.model: I should have labelled the chart. I needn't have copied the whole table. I did not need to stay late, so I went home.
rubric: should have 对应的事其实没做。
needn't have 对应的事做了。
did not need to 没有被用来表示“白做了”。

modules.title: 条件句
modules.description: if 后面用什么时态，不表示句子“在过去或现在”，而表示说话人觉得这件事有多真实。

lessons.title: 从零类到第三类
lessons.goal: 能按“总是如此、真实的将来、与现在相反、与过去相反”选择 if 从句和主句的形式。
lessons.exam: 转换题和写作里的假设都从这里来。中文“如果”不改变动词，英语每升一级不真实，时态就往过去退一格。

notice.prompt: 两句都用 if。一句是真的可能下雨，一句是在想象另一种现在。

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay in.
examples.zh: 将来有可能下雨，用一般现在时 + will。

examples.en: If it rained more often here, the city would be greener.
examples.zh: 和眼前的事实相反，用过去式 + would。

notice.answer: 零类讲规律，第一类讲真实的将来，第二类把现在或将来说成不真实，第三类把过去说成没发生过。时态是距离现实的标记，不是时间本身。所以第二类的 if I were you 用的是过去形式，说的却是现在。

rules.title: 零类和第一类：仍然真实
rules.body: 零类：If you heat ice, it melts。从句和主句都是一般现在时，讲规律。第一类：If I see her, I will tell her。从句现在时，主句 will。不要在 if 里再加 will。unless 近似 if ... not，但不是处处能替换，尤其当句子里已经有否定时要小心。

examples.en: If water reaches 100°C, it boils.
If the bus is late, I will walk.
Unless you hurry, you will miss the start.
examples.zh: unless 这里等于 if you do not hurry。

rules.title: 第二类：和现在或将来的事实相反
rules.body: If I had more time, I would read the footnotes 意味着我现在时间不多。if 从句用一般过去时，be 在正式写法里用 were：If I were you。主句用 would / could / might + 原形。不要把 would 放进 if。

examples.en: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
If she were here, she would disagree.
examples.zh: 她现在不在。正式语体用 were。

examples.en: If we left now, we might still arrive.
examples.zh: 现在离开是假设，不是过去的离开。

mistakes.wrong: If I would have time, I would help.
mistakes.right: If I had time, I would help.
mistakes.why: would 不放在 if 从句里。

mistakes.wrong: If I was you, I will refuse.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I would refuse.
mistakes.why: were 加 would，不是 will。

rules.title: 第三类：和过去的事实相反
rules.body: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train 意味着当时没早走，也没赶上。if 用 had done，主句用 would have done。could have、might have 用来降低把握。这是写作里谈“当时要是……就好了”的基本句。

examples.en: If they had checked the units, the result would have been different.
If I had known, I would have waited.
She might have agreed if you had asked her yourself.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
mistakes.right: If I had known, I would have told you.
mistakes.why: if 从句用 had known，不是 would have known。

mistakes.wrong: If I had known, I will tell you.
mistakes.right: If I had known, I would have told you.
mistakes.why: 过去的不真实，主句也要 have。

rules.title: would 是结果，不是 if 里的装饰
rules.body: 中文母语者常在两个小句都加上 would 或 will。记住：if 负责假设的距离，主句负责结果。第一类主句 will，第二类 would，第三类 would have。if 本身保持“退一格”的形式，不再加 will / would。

examples.en: If you ask, people will help.
If you asked, people would help.
If you had asked, people would have helped.

questions.prompt: 冰加热会融化。这是规律。哪一句对？
questions.answer: If you heat ice, it melts.
questions.hint: 规律用零类，两边都是一般现在时。
questions.explanation: 零类不用 will，也不必退到 would。第二类会把融化说成不真实的想象。
options: If you heat ice, it melts.
If you will heat ice, it will melt as a law.
If you heated ice, it would always melt in scientific fact.

questions.prompt: 你实际上时间不够。哪一句对？
questions.answer: If I had more time, I would read it.
questions.hint: 和现在事实相反，用第二类。
questions.explanation: had 加 would。if 里不要 would have。第一类会把“时间不够”说成真的可能有时间。
options: If I have more time, I will read it — but this presents it as real.
If I had more time, I would read it.
If I would have more time, I would read it.

questions.prompt: 第三类主句：If she had revised the chart, the tutor ______ (notice) the error.
questions.answer: would have noticed
questions.hint: 过去没发生的修改，结果也用 would have。
questions.explanation: would have noticed。might have noticed 把把握降低，也可以。

questions.prompt: 正式的“如果我是你”：If I ______ you, I would wait.
questions.answer: were
questions.hint: 正式语体里 be 用 were。
questions.explanation: If I were you。口语里 If I was you 能听到，正式写作用 were。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: If I had set an alarm, I would not have missed the talk.
questions.hint: 和过去事实相反，if 用 had，主句用 would have。
questions.explanation: 第三类条件句。If I had set an alarm, I would have arrived on time 也符合原意。
questions.source: I did not set an alarm, so I missed the talk.
accepted: If I had set an alarm, I would have caught the talk.
Had I set an alarm, I would not have missed the talk.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: If I had had more time yesterday, I would have finished the chapter.
questions.hint: 昨天的不真实是第三类。had had 虽然看起来怪，但是 have 的过去完成。
questions.explanation: if 从句用 had had more time，主句用 would have finished。would have more time 和 will finished 都不是英语的条件结构。
questions.stem: If I would have more time yesterday, I will finished the chapter.

task.prompt: 用零类、第一类、第二类、第三类各写一句，内容都来自你的学习或生活。写完在每句后面用中文标明它是真实还是相反。
task.model: If I review in the morning, I remember more. If I finish early tonight, I will go for a walk. If I had a quieter room, I would read more. If I had labelled the file, I would not have lost it.
rubric: 四类的 if 和主句配对，没有在 if 里加 would。
第二类说的是现在，第三类说的是过去。
were 或过去式没有和 will 搭配。

lessons.title: 混合条件，以及 Were、Had、Should 倒装
lessons.goal: 能写“过去的原因、现在的结果”，并能把 if 省掉，改成 Were / Had / Should 开头的正式倒装。
lessons.exam: C1 写作里的混合条件比单一类型更能说明因果。倒装是语域升高的一种方式，口语里要少用。

notice.prompt: 原因在过去，结果在现在。时态因此不能整句都停在第三类。

examples.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.zh: 过去没学医，所以现在不是医生。

examples.en: Had I studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.zh: 同一句话，拿掉 if，把 had 提前。

notice.answer: 混合条件让两个时间各用各的形式。过去的 if 用 had done，现在的结果用 would do，常常加 now 或 today 帮读者看见时间。倒装是同一结构的正式变体：Had I known、Were she here、Should you need help。

rules.title: 混合：过去的假设，现在的结果
rules.body: If I had saved the file, I would not be rewriting it now。if 是第三类的 had done，主句是第二类的 would do。now、today、still 帮助读者看到结果在现在。不要两边都写成 would have，否则结果也被关进过去。

examples.en: If she had taken the job, she would live in Lisbon now.
examples.zh: 过去的决定，现在的居住地。

examples.en: If we had left earlier, we would be there by now.
examples.zh: 过去没早走，现在还没到。

examples.en: If I had kept a backup, I would not be worried today.
examples.zh: 过去的疏忽，现在的情绪。

mistakes.wrong: If I had studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
mistakes.right: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
mistakes.why: now 要的是现在的结果，用 would be。

mistakes.wrong: If I studied medicine years ago, I would be a doctor now.
mistakes.right: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
mistakes.why: 多年前的反事实用 had studied，不是一般过去。

rules.title: 另一种混合：现在的状态，过去的结果
rules.body: If I were more organised, I would have finished yesterday。if 用第二类，因为“有条理”说的是性格，主句用 would have，因为完成发生在昨天。用的时候问自己：哪个小句是持续的状态，哪个是过去的一件事。

examples.en: If she were more careful, she would not have missed the typo.
examples.zh: 性格是现在的，疏漏是过去的。

examples.en: If I knew the city, I would have walked.
If he were not so cautious, he would have agreed yesterday.

rules.title: 倒装：Had、Were、Should 放在句首
rules.body: 正式写法可以把 if 去掉。Had I known, I would have called。Were she here, she would object。Should you need help, call me。Should 这种倒装比 if you should 更客气，常出现在信里，表示“假如您需要”。过去式的实义动词不能这样倒装：不说 Knew I the answer。

examples.en: Had I seen the note, I would have replied.
examples.zh: 等于 If I had seen the note。

examples.en: Were the data public, we could check them.
examples.zh: 等于 If the data were public。

examples.en: Should you have any questions, please write.

mistakes.wrong: Had I would have known, I would call.
mistakes.right: Had I known, I would have called.
mistakes.why: 提前的是 had，不是 would have。

mistakes.wrong: Would I know, I would tell you.
mistakes.right: If I knew, I would tell you.
mistakes.why: would 不能拿到句首代替 if。

rules.title: but for、otherwise、provided
rules.body: but for the map, we would have got lost 等于 if we had not had the map。otherwise 接在事实后面，后面常用 would 或 would have。provided / as long as 仍是真实条件，后面用现在时：You can quote the table provided you cite the source。这些是 if 的邻居，不是新的时态系统。

examples.en: But for her notes, I would have failed the task.
I forgot to save. Otherwise I would not be rewriting this.
You may leave early provided the work is done.

mistakes.wrong: But for the map, we will not get lost yesterday.
mistakes.right: But for the map, we would have got lost.
mistakes.why: but for 谈过去的反事实时，主句用 would have。

mistakes.wrong: Provided you will cite the source, you can quote it.
mistakes.right: Provided you cite the source, you can quote it.
mistakes.why: provided 后面用现在时。

questions.prompt: 你当时没保存，所以现在还在重写。哪一句对？
questions.answer: If I had saved the file, I would not be rewriting it now.
questions.hint: 原因在过去，结果在现在。
questions.explanation: had saved 配 would not be rewriting now。这是混合条件。第三项把两个时间都关进过去，又在 if 里用了 would have。
options: If I had saved the file, I would not be rewriting it now.
If I saved the file, I will not rewrite it now.
If I would have saved the file, I would not have been rewriting now only in the past.

questions.prompt: 哪一个倒装是合法的？
questions.answer: Had I known the answer, I would have told you.
questions.hint: 只有 had、were、should 能提前。
questions.explanation: Had I known 等于 If I had known。实义动词 knew 和 would 不能这样倒装。
options: Knew I the answer, I would tell you.
Had I known the answer, I would have told you.
Would I know the answer, I told you.

questions.prompt: 礼貌的书信：______ you need a copy, I will send one.
questions.answer: Should
questions.hint: 把 should 提前，表示假如您需要。
questions.explanation: Should you need a copy。If you need 更普通，但这一空要的是倒装。

questions.prompt: 没有那张地图的话：______ the map, we would have got lost.
questions.answer: But for
questions.hint: but for + 名词，后面接 would have。
questions.explanation: But for the map。Without the map 也可以，但标准答案用 But for。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: If I were more organised, I would not have missed the deadline yesterday.
questions.hint: 性格用 were，昨天的结果用 would have。
