questions.explanation: 这是“现在的状态 + 过去的结果”。If I were more organised, I would not have missed the deadline。
questions.source: I am disorganised. That is why I missed the deadline yesterday.
accepted: Were I more organised, I would not have missed the deadline yesterday.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
questions.hint: 过去的假设用 had studied，现在的身份用 would be。
questions.explanation: 混合条件不要在 if 里放 would，也不要把 now 的结果写成 would have been。Had I studied medicine, I would be a doctor now 是正式变体。
questions.stem: If I would study medicine, I would have been a doctor now.

task.prompt: 写一句“过去的选择影响现在”的混合条件，再把它改成 Had 开头的倒装。两句意思相同。
task.model: If I had kept a vocabulary notebook, I would remember more words now. Had I kept a vocabulary notebook, I would remember more words now.
rubric: if 从句是 had done，主句是 would 加现在的结果。
倒装没有留下 if，也没有把 would 提前。
两句的事实含义一致：这件事过去没发生。

modules.title: 被动与使役
modules.description: 被动把承受者放到主语位置。have / get something done 则表示这件事是别人替你做的。中文常常都不改变动词。

lessons.title: 各时态的被动，以及 by 什么时候留
lessons.goal: 能把主动句改成对应时态的被动，并判断施事者该不该出现。
lessons.exam: 转换题经常只给一个词，比如 WAS 或 BEEN，要求你把宾语变成主语。写作里滥用 by 会让句子又长又空。

notice.prompt: 两句信息一样。一句让作者做主语，一句让报告做主语。

examples.en: Maya wrote the report.
examples.zh: 施事者是新信息，放在主语位置。

examples.en: The report was written by Maya.
examples.zh: 报告才是这句话的话题。

notice.answer: 被动是 be + 过去分词，时态体现在 be 上。不知道、不重要或不愿说出谁做的，就不要加 by。by 只在施事者本身是新闻时才留。

rules.title: 时态放在 be 上，分词保持不变
rules.body: 一般现在 is written，现在进行 is being written，现在完成 has been written，一般过去 was written，过去进行 was being written，情态 must be written。不要写成 is wrote，也不要漏掉 been。

examples.en: The data are checked every Friday.
The data are being checked now.
The data have been checked.

table.caption: 被动的 be
rows: am / is / are + 过去分词
am / is / are being + 过去分词
have / has been + 过去分词
must / can / should be + 过去分词

mistakes.wrong: The window was broke.
mistakes.right: The window was broken.
mistakes.why: 被动要用过去分词 broken，不是过去式 broke。

mistakes.wrong: The report has written.
mistakes.right: The report has been written.
mistakes.why: 完成被动不能省 been。

rules.title: by 不是被动的 obligatory 尾巴
rules.body: The building was designed in 1930 通常不必说 by an architect，因为听者已经知道是人设计的。The building was designed by the city's youngest architect 里，by 后面才是重点。汉语“被”有时带不如意，英语被动是中性的，论文里非常常见。

examples.en: English is spoken in the office.
The novel was written by a nurse.
Mistakes were made.

rules.title: 有些动词带两个宾语，被动可以有两种主语
rules.body: They offered her a grant 可以变成 She was offered a grant 或 A grant was offered to her。人做主语通常更自然。explain、describe、say 不能把人直接变成主语：不说 I was explained the rule，要说 The rule was explained to me。

examples.en: She was offered a grant.
A grant was offered to her.
examples.zh: 事物做主语时，人放到 to 后面。

examples.en: The rule was explained to me.

mistakes.wrong: I was explained the problem.
mistakes.right: The problem was explained to me.
mistakes.why: explain 的人要用 to。

mistakes.wrong: I was said that the train was late.
mistakes.right: It was said that the train was late.
mistakes.why: say 的被动常用 It was said that，不以人做主语。

rules.title: get + 过去分词更口语，也常带意外
rules.body: The window got broken 比 was broken 更口语，而且常暗示倒霉或不希望发生。写作论文用 be。get married、get dressed、get lost 已经像固定短语，口语和书面都能见到。

examples.en: My draft got deleted.
They got married in May.
The sample was contaminated.
examples.zh: 正式叙述用 was，不用 got。

questions.prompt: 报告已经写完，谁写的不重要。哪一句合适？
questions.answer: The report has been written.
questions.hint: 完成被动要有 been 和过去分词。
questions.explanation: has been written。has written 是主动，wrote 不是分词。
options: The report has been written.
The report has written.
The report has been wrote.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的 by 留得有理由？
questions.answer: The vaccine was developed by a publicly funded lab.
questions.hint: by 后面必须是新的、值得说的信息。
questions.explanation: 实验室的性质是新闻。people 和 someone 几乎不增加信息。
options: Tea is drunk by people.
The vaccine was developed by a publicly funded lab.
The door was opened by someone.

questions.prompt: 此刻正在被核对：The figures ______ ______ ______ (check) at the moment.
questions.answer: are being checked
questions.hint: 现在进行被动：are being + 过去分词。
questions.explanation: are being checked。不要写成 are checked 如果要强调此刻。

questions.prompt: 规则被解释给我：The rule was explained ______ me.
questions.answer: to
questions.hint: explain 的对象要用 to。
questions.explanation: explained to me。不能说 I was explained the rule。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: The roof is being repaired at the moment.
questions.hint: 进行被动，施事者不重要就去掉。
questions.explanation: is being repaired。关键词 BEING 就在这个结构里。
questions.source: Someone is repairing the roof at the moment.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: The delay was explained to me, and the email was written.
questions.hint: explain 不能以人做这种被动主语；wrote 不是分词。
questions.explanation: The delay was explained to me。email 用 was written。someone 没有信息，可以删去 by someone。
questions.stem: I was explained the delay and the email was wrote by someone.

task.prompt: 把你这周的三件小事改成被动：一件完成，一件正在发生，一件不必说出是谁做的。
task.model: My notes have been reorganised. The kitchen is being painted. The window was left open.
rubric: be 的时态和主动句原来的时态一致。
过去分词没有写成过去式。
没有为了被动而硬加 by someone。

lessons.title: have / get something done，以及 make、let、get
lessons.goal: 能区分“自己做完了”和“请别人做”，并正确使用 make / let 加原形、get 加 to。
lessons.exam: have something done 是转换题的常客。它和过去完成时 I had done 只差一个宾语的位置，中文都可能说成“我弄好了”。

notice.prompt: 两句都有 had repaired。宾语的位置决定是谁修的。

examples.en: I had repaired the bike before noon.
examples.zh: 过去完成时：修车的人是我，而且发生在中午之前。

examples.en: I had the bike repaired before noon.
examples.zh: 使役：我安排别人在中午之前把车修好。

notice.answer: have + 宾语 + 过去分词表示这件事由别人完成，往往是你安排的。get + 宾语 + 过去分词意思接近，更口语。make 和 let 后面是人加动词原形；get 后面的人要加 to。

rules.title: have / get something done
rules.body: I had my laptop repaired 不是我修的，是我送去修的。I got my hair cut 同理。时态在 have / get 上：I am having the locks changed，I have had the locks changed。不要和 I have changed the locks（我自己换了）混淆。

examples.en: We had the contract checked by a lawyer.
examples.zh: 律师检查的，不是我们自己。

examples.en: She is having her eyes tested.
I got the figures updated.
examples.zh: 口语里 get 代替 have。

table.caption: 谁做的
rows: 我，而且比另一个过去更早

mistakes.wrong: I had repaired my hair yesterday at the salon.
mistakes.right: I had my hair cut at the salon.
mistakes.why: 沙龙里是别人剪的，用 had my hair cut。

mistakes.wrong: I have cut my hair at the barber every month, meaning the barber cuts it.
mistakes.right: I have my hair cut every month.
mistakes.why: 习惯性请别人做，用 have something done。

rules.title: make、let、get 后面的人
rules.body: make someone do、let someone do，动词是原形，没有 to。get someone to do 要有 to，表示说服或设法让对方做。在被动里，make 会把 to 请回来：I was made to wait。

examples.en: The noise made me lose my place.
Let me finish the sentence.
I got the librarian to renew the book.

mistakes.wrong: She made me to repeat it.
mistakes.right: She made me repeat it.
mistakes.why: make 后不加 to。

mistakes.wrong: I was made wait.
mistakes.right: I was made to wait.
mistakes.why: make 的被动要把 to 加回来。

mistakes.wrong: We got him explain the chart.
mistakes.right: We got him to explain the chart.
mistakes.why: get someone 后面是 to do。

rules.title: have someone do：让某人做，人还在句子里
rules.body: I had the technician check the cable 是人做宾语，动词原形。I had the cable checked 是物做宾语，过去分词。一个是“派某人去做”，一个是“把某事做掉”。

examples.en: I had my colleague read the draft.
I had the draft read by a colleague.
examples.zh: 草稿被读，分词 read，这里 read 的过去分词同形。

examples.en: She had them reprint the poster.

rules.title: 不是所有“让”都用 let
rules.body: let 是允许。make 是迫使。get 是设法做到。allow 比 let 正式，而且要 to：allow someone to do。写作里 The rules allow students to resit 比 let 更合适。

examples.en: The library lets readers borrow six books.
The rules allow readers to borrow six books.
The deadline made us cut a section.

questions.prompt: 车是修理店修的。哪一句对？
questions.answer: I had the bike repaired at the shop.
questions.hint: 物做宾语时，后面是过去分词。
questions.explanation: had the bike repaired 是使役。had repaired the bike 是你自己修，而且是过去完成。repair 用原形则不构成这个结构。
options: I had repaired the bike at the shop.
I had the bike repaired at the shop.
I had the bike repair at the shop.

questions.prompt: 被动句里的 make，哪一句对？
questions.answer: I was made to wait for an hour.
questions.hint: 主动没有 to，被动要把 to 请回来。
questions.explanation: was made to wait。waiting 和省掉 to 都不对。
options: I was made wait for an hour.
I was made to wait for an hour.
I was made waiting for an hour.

questions.prompt: 说服图书管理员续借：I got the librarian ______ (renew) the loan.
questions.answer: to renew
questions.hint: get someone 后面是 to + 原形。
questions.explanation: got the librarian to renew。如果是 make，才不用 to。

questions.prompt: 每个月请人剪头发：I ______ my hair ______ every month. 用 have 的一般现在时。
questions.answer: have, cut
questions.hint: 习惯性的使役。
questions.explanation: I have my hair cut。主语 I，have 不变形。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I had the printer checked this morning.
questions.hint: have something done，时态用过去的 had。
questions.explanation: I had the printer checked。I had a technician check the printer 是另一种合法结构，关键词 HAD 两者都有。
questions.source: A technician checked the printer for me this morning.
accepted: I had a technician check the printer this morning.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: She made me rewrite the paragraph, and I had my laptop repaired at the shop.
questions.hint: make 不加 to；店里修电脑是 had something done。
questions.explanation: made me rewrite。had my laptop repaired 才表示别人修的。had repaired my laptop 会变成她自己在到店之前已经修好了。
questions.stem: She made me to rewrite the paragraph and I had repaired my laptop at the shop.

task.prompt: 写三句：一件你请别人做成的事，一件你让某人做的事（have someone do 或 get someone to do），一件规则允许或迫使你做的事。
task.model: I had my watch repaired. I got my brother to read the draft. The word limit made me cut a paragraph.
rubric: have something done 的宾语是物，后面是过去分词。
get 后面有 to，make 或 let 后面没有。
没有把 had repaired 误当成“请人修”。

modules.title: 间接引语
modules.description: 转述不是把原话的时态原样搬进 that 从句。引述动词若在过去，后面的时态通常往后退一格。

lessons.title: 陈述句的时态后移和时间词
lessons.goal: 当引述动词是过去时，能把现在时退到过去时，并改掉 tomorrow、here 这类指示词。
lessons.exam: 写作概述别人的观点、听力里的转述，都要用这一套。如果情况现在仍然成立，后移可以不做，但你要有意识地选择。

notice.prompt: 原话是现在时。引述动词是 said。从句里的时态退了一步。

examples.en: “I am tired.” → She said she was tired.
“I finished it yesterday.” → She said she had finished it the day before.
examples.zh: 过去时退到过去完成，yesterday 也要改。

notice.answer: 后移是因为引述的立场在过去。现在时变过去时，过去时和现在完成变过去完成，will 变 would，can 变 could。时间词和地点词跟着引述者的立场改：tomorrow 变 the next day，here 变 there。

rules.title: 时态往后退一格
rules.body: am / is → was，are → were，现在完成和一般过去 → had done，will → would，can → could，may → might。must 做义务时常保留，或改成 had to。如果引述的是仍然成立的事实，可以不后移：She said that water boils at 100°C。

examples.en: He said he was busy.
He said he had missed the train.
examples.zh: 原话 I missed the train。

examples.en: She said she would call.

mistakes.wrong: She said she is tired yesterday and the state is over.
mistakes.right: She said she was tired.
mistakes.why: 引述过去的暂时状态，要后移。

mistakes.wrong: He said he will come the next day.
mistakes.right: He said he would come the next day.
mistakes.why: will 在 said 之后通常变成 would。

rules.title: 时间、地点、指示词一起搬
rules.body: today → that day，tomorrow → the next day / the following day，yesterday → the day before，next week → the following week，ago → before / earlier，now → then，here → there，this → that。如果引述就发生在同一天、同一个房间，这些词可以不改。

examples.en: She said she had sent it two days earlier.
examples.zh: 原话 I sent it two days ago。

examples.en: He said he would see me the next day.
examples.zh: 原话 I will see you tomorrow。

examples.en: They said the meeting was that day.
examples.zh: 原话 The meeting is today，而且日子已经不是今天。

mistakes.wrong: She said she would finish it tomorrow, reported a week later.
mistakes.right: She said she would finish it the next day.
mistakes.why: 离开了原来的“明天”，指示词要改。

mistakes.wrong: He said he has seen the film yesterday.
mistakes.right: He said he had seen the film the day before.
mistakes.why: yesterday 既不能和 has seen 连用，转述时也要变成 the day before。

rules.title: 仍然为真，可以不后移
rules.body: She said that the earth orbits the sun 不必改成 orbited。He said he is ill 也可以，如果你想强调他现在还病着。这是选择，不是必须。不确定时，后移总是安全的。不要在同一篇里毫无理由地一会儿后移、一会儿不后移。

examples.en: The lecturer said that demand affects price.
examples.zh: 规律仍然成立，可以保持现在时。

examples.en: She said she loves the city, and she still lives there.
She said she loved that flat, but she has moved.

rules.title: that 可以省，但长句里留着更清楚
rules.body: She said (that) she was tired。两个从句叠在一起时，留着 that，读者才知道从哪里开始是引语。不要写成 She said me that。say 不接人，tell 才接：She told me that she was tired。

examples.en: She told me that the file was ready.
She said that the file was ready.
She said the file was ready and that I could collect it.
examples.zh: 第二处留下 that，结构更清楚。

mistakes.wrong: She said me that she was ready.
mistakes.right: She told me that she was ready.
mistakes.why: say 不接间接宾语。

mistakes.wrong: She told that she was ready.
mistakes.right: She said that she was ready.
mistakes.why: tell 后面缺了人。

questions.prompt: 原话：“I have lost my key.” 昨天她说的。哪一句合适？
questions.answer: She said she had lost her key.
questions.hint: said 是过去，现在完成后移为过去完成。
questions.explanation: had lost。has lost yesterday 本身就不成立。said me 要改成 told me。
options: She said she has lost her key yesterday.
She said she had lost her key.
She said me she lost her key.

questions.prompt: 原话是今天早上在同一个房间说的：“I will stay here.” 哪一句保留了现场？
questions.answer: She said she would stay here.
questions.hint: will 要后移；人还在这里，here 可以不改。
questions.explanation: would stay here。如果转述时已经换了地方，才把 here 改成 there。第一句的 will 没有后移。
options: She said she will stay here.
She said she would stay here.
She said she would stay there next week only.

questions.prompt: 原话 “I can swim.”：He said he ______ swim.
questions.answer: could
questions.hint: can 在 said 之后通常变成 could。
questions.explanation: could。如果强调他现在仍然会，而且你要突出这一点，可以保留 can，但标准后移是 could。

questions.prompt: 原话 “I met her yesterday.”：She said she had met her the ______ before.
questions.answer: day
questions.hint: yesterday 在转述里变成 the day before。
questions.explanation: the day before。the previous day 也可以。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: She said she would send the draft the following day.
questions.hint: will 变 would，tomorrow 变 the following day。
questions.explanation: 关键词 FOLLOWING 用在 the following day。the next day 意思相同，但没有这个关键词。
questions.source: “I will send the draft tomorrow,” she said.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: He told me that he would finish it the next day.
questions.hint: 如果原话是 I will finish it tomorrow，三处都要改。若原话真的是 yesterday，时态也不该是 will。
questions.explanation: told me，would finish，the next day。said me 和 will … yesterday 都不能留。这里按最常见的原话 I will finish it tomorrow 来改。
questions.stem: He said me that he will finish it yesterday.

task.prompt: 把你今天听到或读到的两句现在时的话，用 She said / He told me 转述。至少改一处时间词。
task.model: My tutor said she was free the next day. She told me that I could send the draft that night.
rubric: 引述动词是过去时，从句后移了。
say 和 tell 的用法没有混。
tomorrow 或 tonight 没有原样留在已经错位的时间里。

lessons.title: 转述疑问、祈使和建议
lessons.goal: 能把疑问句的词序改回陈述句，把祈使句改成 tell someone to，把 suggest 接进 -ing 或 that。
lessons.exam: 疑问词序是这一课的主要失分点。转述之后不再用助动词提前，也不再加问号。

notice.prompt: 直接问句要把助动词提前。转述进去之后，词序回到陈述句。

examples.en: “Where do you live?” → She asked where I lived.
examples.zh: do 消失，词序是 where I lived。

examples.en: “Don't open it.” → He told me not to open it.
examples.zh: 否定的祈使，not 放在 to 前面。

notice.answer: 转述疑问用 ask。有疑问词就保留疑问词，后面用陈述词序。没有疑问词，用 if 或 whether。祈使句用 tell / ask someone (not) to。suggest、recommend 不要接 someone to。

rules.title: 疑问词加陈述词序
rules.body: She asked where I lived，不是 where did I live，也不是 where I did live。时态同样后移。who、what、which 如果本来就是主语，词序本来就是陈述式：She asked who had called。

examples.en: He asked what I wanted.
examples.zh: 原话 What do you want?

examples.en: She asked why the sample was small.
examples.zh: why 后面是主语 + 动词。

examples.en: They asked who had taken the key.
examples.zh: who 是主语，没有助动词提前的问题。

mistakes.wrong: She asked where did I live.
mistakes.right: She asked where I lived.
mistakes.why: 转述疑问不用疑问词序。

mistakes.wrong: She asked me where was the file.
mistakes.right: She asked me where the file was.
mistakes.why: was 回到主语后面。

rules.title: 没有疑问词，用 if 或 whether
rules.body: “Are you ready?” → She asked if I was ready。whether 和 if 在转述里通常都可以。whether 后面更容易接 or not。不要再加 that：不说 asked that if。

examples.en: He asked if I had seen the note.
examples.zh: 原话 Have you seen the note?

examples.en: She asked whether the room was free.
I asked whether or not we should wait.
examples.zh: or not 和 whether 更搭配。

table.caption: 三种原话
rows: asked if / whether I was ready

rules.title: 祈使句变成 to 不定式
rules.body: tell someone to do、ask someone to do、order someone to do。否定是 not to do，not 在 to 前面。Let's go → She suggested going，或 She suggested that we go。不要说 She told let's go。

examples.en: She told me to bring a pen.
She told me not to be late.
He asked us to sit down.

mistakes.wrong: She told me don't be late.
mistakes.right: She told me not to be late.
mistakes.why: 否定放在 to 前，不保留 don't。

mistakes.wrong: She suggested me to leave.
mistakes.right: She suggested that I leave.
mistakes.why: suggest 不接 someone to。

rules.title: 建议、承诺和拒绝有自己的动词
rules.body: suggest doing、recommend that someone do、promise to do、refuse to do、offer to do、apologise for doing。选对动词，后面的形式就跟着走。不要一律塞进 said that。

examples.en: She suggested starting again.
He promised to send the file.
They refused to sign.
I apologised for arriving late.

questions.prompt: 原话：“Where is the station?” 哪一句对？
questions.answer: She asked where the station was.
questions.hint: 转述后用陈述词序，不加 that。
questions.explanation: where the station was。was 放在主语后面。that where 叠了两个连接词。
options: She asked where was the station.
She asked where the station was.
She asked that where the station was.

questions.prompt: 原话：“Don't touch it.” 哪一句对？
questions.answer: He told me not to touch it.
questions.hint: not 在 to 前面。
questions.explanation: not to touch。不要保留 don't，也不要在 to 后面接 -ing。
options: He told me don't touch it.
He told me not to touch it.
He told me to not touching it.

questions.prompt: 原话 “Did you see the film?”：She asked ______ I had seen the film.
questions.answer: if
questions.hint: 没有疑问词的问句用 if 或 whether。
questions.explanation: if 或 whether。

questions.prompt: 原话 “Let's take a break.”：She suggested ______ a break.
questions.answer: taking
questions.hint: suggest 接 -ing。
questions.explanation: suggested taking。that we take 是另一句，不是这个空的 -ing 形式。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: She asked me to send her the file.
questions.hint: 请求可以收成 ask someone to。
questions.explanation: asked me to send her the file。如果保留疑问，是 She asked me if I could send her the file，但关键词 TO 指向不定式。
questions.source: “Can you send me the file?” she asked me.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: She asked me where I lived and suggested that I move closer.
questions.hint: 疑问词序要改回来；suggest 不接 me to。
questions.explanation: where I lived。suggested moving closer 或 suggested that I move closer。
questions.stem: She asked me where did I live and suggested me to move closer.

task.prompt: 把三句原话转述进一段话：一个 wh- 问句，一个 don't 祈使句，一个 Let's 建议。
task.model: She asked where I had put the draft. She told me not to send it yet. She suggested taking another day.
rubric: 问句用了陈述词序。
否定祈使用 not to。
suggest 后面是 -ing 或 that，不是 me to。

modules.title: 关系从句
modules.description: 关系从句把一个名词说具体。限定从句决定“是哪一个”，非限定从句只是追加信息，并且要用逗号。

lessons.title: 限定与非限定，关系词怎么选
lessons.goal: 能选择 who、which、that、whose、where，并判断关系词能不能省。
lessons.exam: 阅读里的长句常常靠关系从句层层限定。写作里 which 指代整句、却没有逗号，是常见的失分。

notice.prompt: 有没有逗号，信息的地位就不一样。

examples.en: The students who arrived late sat at the back.
examples.zh: 只有迟到的那些坐在后面，who 从句是限定。

examples.en: The students, who arrived late, sat at the back.
examples.zh: 所有学生都迟到了，逗号里是追加说明。

notice.answer: 限定从句不用逗号，拿掉以后名词就不清楚。非限定从句用逗号，拿掉以后名词仍然清楚，只是少了一点背景。that 只用于限定从句。whose 表示“谁的”，人和物都能用。

rules.title: 人用 who，物用 which，限定从句里 that 常能代替两者
rules.body: The woman who called、the report which / that arrived。在限定从句里，that 比 which 更常见，尤其在口语里。非限定从句不能用 that：The report, which arrived today, is brief。介词留在句尾时，口语用 who / that；正式把介词提前时要用 which / whom。

examples.en: The tutor who marked my essay is away.
The essay that she marked is online.
examples.zh: 物，that 作宾语，也可以省。

examples.en: Her latest essay, which she wrote in a day, is online.

mistakes.wrong: My only brother who lives in Nanjing is a nurse.
mistakes.right: My only brother, who lives in Nanjing, is a nurse.
mistakes.why: 只有一个哥哥时，住处是追加信息，要用逗号。没有逗号像是在许多哥哥里挑选。

mistakes.wrong: The report, that arrived today, is short.
mistakes.right: The report, which arrived today, is short.
mistakes.why: 逗号后面不用 that。

rules.title: 主语关系词不能省，宾语关系词可以
rules.body: The book that explains this is out of print 里 that 是主语，不能省。The book that I borrowed 里 that 是宾语，可以省：The book I borrowed。不要因为中文没有关系词，就把做主语的 who / that 也省掉。

examples.en: The email that arrived this morning is urgent.
The email I forwarded is urgent.
People who live here know the shortcut.

rules.title: whose、where、when、why
rules.body: whose 后面紧接名词：the writer whose book we read、the city whose streets flood。where 修饰地点，when 修饰时间，why 常跟在 reason 后面。the reason why 可以，更干净的是 the reason。不要用 where 去修饰一个不是地点的抽象名词。

examples.en: I met the researcher whose paper we discussed.
examples.zh: whose 表示论文属于这位研究者。

examples.en: This is the library where I work.
I remember the year when the lab opened.

mistakes.wrong: The city where its streets flood.
mistakes.right: The city whose streets flood.
mistakes.why: “城市的街道”用 whose，不是 where its。

mistakes.wrong: The idea where I disagree is this.
mistakes.right: The idea which I disagree with is this.
mistakes.why: idea 不是地点。

rules.title: which 可以指前面整个句子
rules.body: The train was cancelled, which made us late。which 指的是“列车取消”这件事，必须有逗号。没有逗号时，which 应该有一个明确的名词做先行词。口语里有人用 which 松松地连接，正式写作要让先行词清楚。

examples.en: The file was corrupted, which set us back a day.
She offered a solution, which we accepted.
examples.zh: which 可以指 solution，也可以在语境里更宽。这里指 solution。

examples.en: He raised his voice, which was unnecessary.

questions.prompt: 你只有一个哥哥。哪一句对？
questions.answer: My brother, who lives in Chengdu, is a designer.
questions.hint: 追加信息用逗号，而且不用 that。
questions.explanation: 非限定从句：逗号 + who。that 不能用在逗号后面。没有逗号会暗示你还有别的哥哥。
options: My brother who lives in Chengdu is a designer.
My brother, who lives in Chengdu, is a designer.
My brother, that lives in Chengdu, is a designer.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的关系词省得合法？
questions.answer: The woman I called is my tutor.
questions.hint: 只有做宾语的限定关系词可以省。
questions.explanation: I called 的宾语是 woman，所以 who / that 可省。called me 里 woman 是主语，不能省。非限定从句也不能省得只剩逗号。
options: The woman called me is my tutor.
The woman I called is my tutor.
The report, I read yesterday, is useful.

questions.prompt: 论文属于这位作者：the author ______ paper we quoted.
questions.answer: whose
questions.hint: “……的”用 whose，后面直接接名词。
questions.explanation: whose paper。不要写成 who her paper 或 which paper of。

questions.prompt: 整句评论：The sample was tiny, ______ made the result unstable.
questions.answer: which
questions.hint: 逗号后面指整件事，用 which。
questions.explanation: which。that 不能担任这个角色。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I read a novel whose ending is abrupt.
questions.hint: whose 把 its 收进关系从句。
questions.explanation: a novel whose ending is abrupt。The novel I read last month has an abrupt ending 没有用上 whose。
questions.source: I read a novel last month. Its ending is abrupt.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: The students who arrived late sat at the back.
questions.hint: 人不用 which；主语不要再说一次 they。
questions.explanation: who arrived late 已经把主语接上，主句直接 sat。which 用于物。
questions.stem: The students which arrived late they sat at the back.

task.prompt: 写一句限定从句、一句非限定从句、一句 whose。都用你认识的人或你读过的东西。
task.model: The article that I saved explains the term. My tutor, who is away this week, left a note. I am reading a writer whose sentences are very short.
rubric: 限定从句没有乱加逗号。
非限定从句有逗号，而且用 who 或 which，不是 that。
whose 后面紧跟名词。

lessons.title: 介词提前，以及缩略关系从句
lessons.goal: 能把介词放在 which / whom 前面，并能用分词把关系从句缩短。
lessons.exam: 介词提前是语域升高，不是更正确。缩略从句让句子变短，但分词的语态不能反。

notice.prompt: 同一句，介词可以留在句尾，也可以提前。提前之后 that 就不能用了。

examples.en: The article that I referred to is online.
examples.zh: 介词在句尾，口语和书面都可以。

examples.en: The article to which I referred is online.
examples.zh: 介词提前，正式，which 不能换成 that。

notice.answer: 缩略是把 which is / who is 拿掉。The man who is standing there 变成 The man standing there。The report which was written yesterday 变成 The report written yesterday。主动用现在分词，被动用过去分词。

rules.title: 介词提前只用 which 或 whom
rules.body: the problem about which we argued、the person to whom I wrote。whom 在正式语体里做人的宾语。日常写作可以把介词留在句尾，用 who / that，或把关系词省掉：the person I wrote to。不要提前介词却留下 that：不说 the problem about that we argued。

examples.en: The theory on which the model rests is old.
The theory that the model rests on is old.
The colleague to whom I sent it has replied.
examples.zh: whom 和 to 在一起。

mistakes.wrong: The data to that I referred.
mistakes.right: The data to which I referred.
mistakes.why: 介词提前时用 which。

mistakes.wrong: The person to who I spoke.
mistakes.right: The person to whom I spoke.
mistakes.why: 介词后面的人用 whom。句尾则可以说 the person who I spoke to。

rules.title: 现在分词缩短主动的关系从句
rules.body: who is / that is + -ing 可以只留 -ing。The students who are waiting outside 变成 The students waiting outside。这个分词和名词是主动关系。不能用来缩短已经有情态或明确过去时间、而且你还需要那些信息的从句。

examples.en: Anyone wanting a copy should write to me.
The woman speaking now is the editor.
Passengers travelling without a ticket will be fined.

rules.title: 过去分词缩短被动的关系从句
rules.body: which was written → written。The names which are listed below → the names listed below。过去分词表示名词是承受者。不要用现在分词去缩短被动：不说 the names listing below 来表示“被列在下面”。

examples.en: The figures shown in the table are estimates.
A letter written in 1920 turned up in the archive.
The questions left unanswered will be discussed tomorrow.

mistakes.wrong: The report writing yesterday is too long.
mistakes.right: The report written yesterday is too long.
mistakes.why: 报告是被写的，用过去分词。

mistakes.wrong: The man stood by the door is my uncle.
mistakes.right: The man standing by the door is my uncle.
mistakes.why: 人正在站着，是主动，用 standing。stood 会变成谓语，句子就有了两个动词。

rules.title: 缩略不能改变“谁做了什么”
rules.body: 缩短之前先问：这个名词是动作的发出者还是承受者。The student confusing the terms 是学生在混淆。The terms confused by the student 是术语被混淆。写完读一遍，看看分词的逻辑主语是不是那个名词。

examples.en: A student confusing the two terms should look them up.
Terms confused by the student are listed here.
People living nearby heard the noise.

questions.prompt: 正式写法里，介词提前。哪一句对？
questions.answer: The issue about which we argued is minor.
questions.hint: 介词后面用 which，不用 that。
questions.explanation: about which。issue 是物。who 既不对，词序也不对。
options: The issue about that we argued is minor.
The issue about which we argued is minor.
The issue about who we argued is minor.

questions.prompt: 报告是昨天被写的。缩短哪一句对？
questions.answer: The report written yesterday has an error.
questions.hint: 被动的关系从句缩短为过去分词。
questions.explanation: written yesterday。writing 是主动。was written 如果留下 was，就不能再直接接 has。
options: The report writing yesterday has an error.
The report written yesterday has an error.
The report was written yesterday has an error.

questions.prompt: 站在门口的那个人：The man ______ by the door is waiting for you. 填一个分词。
questions.answer: standing
questions.hint: 人自己站着，用现在分词。
questions.explanation: standing。stood 不能放在这个位置当缩短的关系从句。

questions.prompt: 正式介词：the person to ______ I sent the draft.
questions.answer: whom
questions.hint: 介词 to 已经提前，人用 whom。
questions.explanation: to whom。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: The students sitting in the front row asked for a copy.
questions.hint: 拿掉 who are，留下现在分词。
questions.explanation: sitting 和 students 是主动关系。
questions.source: The students who are sitting in the front row asked for a copy.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: The article to which she referred and the data shown in Table 2 do not match.
questions.hint: 介词提前用 which；数据是被展示的。
questions.explanation: to which she referred。data shown in Table 2。showing 会变成数据自己在展示。
questions.stem: The article to that she referred and the data showing in Table 2 do not match.

task.prompt: 写一句介词提前的正式关系从句，再写一句分词缩短的关系从句。内容用你正在读的材料。
task.model: The chapter to which I keep returning is the introduction. The terms listed on the first page are not defined.
rubric: 介词在 which 或 whom 前面，没有 about that。
分词的主动或被动和名词匹配。
两句各自只有一个限定动词。

modules.title: 分词从句
modules.description: 分词从句让两件事共用一个主语，从而少写一个 and 或 because。共用的主语必须真的是同一个人。

lessons.title: 现在分词与过去分词作状语
lessons.goal: 能用 -ing 或过去分词把原因、时间和伴随写成句首的分词结构，并且主语一致。
lessons.exam: 阅读里的句首分词决定你找不找得到主语。写作里用对一次，句子会紧凑一档；用错一次，动作会安到错误的人或物身上。

notice.prompt: 两句的逻辑主语都是 I。分词只是把先行的动作提前。

examples.en: Walking home, I met Lee.
examples.zh: 走路的人是 I，不是别人。

examples.en: Written in haste, the email contained errors.
examples.zh: 被匆忙写下来的是 email。

notice.answer: 现在分词表示主语是动作的发出者。过去分词表示主语是承受者。分词没有自己的主语时，它借用主句的主语。这个借用关系对不上，就是垂悬分词。

rules.title: 现在分词：主语正在做或接着做
rules.body: Walking home, I met Lee 等于 While I was walking home, I met Lee。句首分词的主语必须是主句主语。它也可以放在句尾表示伴随：She sat by the window, reading the notes。

examples.en: Opening the file, she noticed the gap.
examples.zh: 她打开文件，然后看见缺口。

examples.en: Not knowing the word, I looked it up.
examples.zh: 否定是 not + -ing，不是 don't knowing。

examples.en: He left the room, closing the door quietly.

mistakes.wrong: Walking home, the rain started.
mistakes.right: Walking home, I got caught in the rain.
mistakes.why: rain 不会走路。分词的逻辑主语必须是主句主语。

mistakes.wrong: Don't knowing the term, I guessed.
mistakes.right: Not knowing the term, I guessed.
mistakes.why: 分词的否定用 not。

rules.title: 过去分词：主语是被做的一方
rules.body: Written in haste, the email contained errors 等于 The email had been written in haste。句首用过去分词，是因为 email 是被写的。如果主语自己做了这件事，就要用 -ing 或 Having written。

examples.en: Seen from the hill, the town looks small.
Rejected by the editor, the paper was revised.
Left overnight, the sample deteriorated.

table.caption: 看主语是发出者还是承受者
rows: Having written the email, she left.

rules.title: having done：先完成，再有主句的动作
rules.body: Having finished the report, she left 表示写完发生在离开之前，而且都是 she。它比 Finishing the report, she left 更清楚地排出先后。Having been invited, he attended 是被动的完成。

examples.en: Having checked the figures, I sent the file.
Having been warned, they took the later train.
Not having read the brief, I asked for a summary.

rules.title: with 可以带一个自己的主语
rules.body: 如果分词的主语和主句不同，不要硬用句首分词。改成 with + 名词 + 分词：She worked at the desk, with the window open。with her notes spread out 里，摊开的是 notes，不是 she。这能避免垂悬。

examples.en: He explained the chart with the lights dimmed.
examples.zh: 灯被调暗，不是他被调暗。

examples.en: She fell asleep with the book still open.
With the deadline moved, we had another week.
examples.zh: with 结构自己带主语 deadline。

questions.prompt: 哪一句的分词没有安错主语？
questions.answer: Walking home, I was soaked by the rain.
questions.hint: walking 的人必须是主句主语。
questions.explanation: I 在走路。rain 不能做 walking 的主语。第三句把被动和主动都安反了。
options: Walking home, the rain soaked my coat.
Walking home, I was soaked by the rain.
Soaked by the coat, the rain walked home.

questions.prompt: 邮件是被匆忙写出来的。哪一句对？
questions.answer: Written in haste, the email had several errors.
questions.hint: email 是承受者，用过去分词。
questions.explanation: Written in haste。writing 会把 email 说成写作者。Having writing 形式也不对，应是 Having written，而且主语得是人。
options: Writing in haste, the email had several errors.
Written in haste, the email had several errors.
Having writing in haste, the email was wrong.

questions.prompt: 先核对再发送：______ the figures, I sent the file.
questions.answer: Having checked
questions.hint: 完成的先后用 having + 过去分词。
questions.explanation: Having checked。Checking 更像同时发生。

questions.prompt: 分词的否定：______ knowing the word, I looked it up.
questions.answer: Not
questions.hint: not 放在 -ing 前面。
questions.explanation: Not knowing。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: Having finished the report, she left.
questions.hint: 两件事同一主语，先完成的用 having done。
questions.explanation: Having finished the report, she left。
questions.source: She finished the report and then she left.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: Opening the window, I made the room cold. Not knowing why the room stayed cold, I checked the heater.
questions.hint: 两个分词的逻辑主语都应该是人，不是 room 或 heater。
questions.explanation: Opening 的主语改成 I。Not knowing 的主语也是 I。不要用 don't knowing。
questions.stem: Opening the window, the room became cold and don't knowing why, the heater was checked by me.

task.prompt: 用 Walking / Having finished / written 各写一句。每句读一遍，确认分词的主语就是主句主语。
task.model: Walking to the library, I planned the paragraph. Having finished it, I sent it to my tutor. Written in a hurry, the first draft had no examples.
rubric: -ing 的主语是动作发出者。
having done 表示先完成。
过去分词的主语是承受者，没有出现 walking, the rain 这种错位。

lessons.title: 垂悬分词、独立主格和什么时候不要省略
lessons.goal: 能识别分词找不到正确主语的句子，并决定是补上主语，还是改回普通从句。
lessons.exam: 这一课是上一课的刹车。C1 不是分词越多越好。主语一对不上，就退回 because 或 when。

notice.prompt: 看起来紧凑的句子，主语可以是错的。

examples.en: Being late, the meeting started without me.
examples.zh: 会议不会“迟到”这个分词的真正主人。

examples.en: Because I was late, the meeting started without me.
examples.zh: 把主语写回来，句子就站住了。

notice.answer: 如果分词和主句主语对不上，优先改成完整从句，而不是为了好看硬缩。固定说法 strictly speaking、judging by、given 已经像介词，不按垂悬处理。

rules.title: 对不上就展开
rules.body: Being a native speaker of Chinese, English articles are hard 是错的，因为 articles 不是中文母语者。改成 Being a native speaker of Chinese, I find English articles hard。或者 As I am a native speaker of Chinese, I find articles hard。

examples.en: Having lived abroad, I notice the difference.
examples.zh: 主语 I 确实在国外生活过。

examples.en: As the sample was small, the result is tentative.
examples.zh: 主语不同，就不要用分词硬连。

examples.en: Tired after the trip, we went straight home.

mistakes.wrong: Born in 1998, the city has changed a lot around me.
mistakes.right: Born in 1998, I have seen the city change.
mistakes.why: 出生的是人，不是城市。

mistakes.wrong: After finishing the test, the bus was missed.
mistakes.right: After finishing the test, I missed the bus.
mistakes.why: finishing 的人要出现在主句里。

rules.title: 独立主格：分词自带主语
rules.body: The meeting over, we left 里 over 的主语是 meeting，不是 we。这叫独立主格，书面、略正式。Weather permitting, we will walk 同理。它和垂悬的差别是：分词前面真的有自己的名词。

examples.en: The report finished, she closed the laptop.
Time allowing, I will add an example.
Her notes spread across the desk, she began again.

rules.title: 有些固定分词不要求同一主语
rules.body: generally speaking、judging by the figures、given the constraints、considering the time 已经凝固，可以放在句首而不强迫主句主语去“说”或“判断”。不要把这个例外扩大到普通动词。

examples.en: Judging by the figures, the change is small.
Given the small sample, the claim is cautious.
Strictly speaking, this is a tendency, not a law.

table.caption: 三种处理
rows: 主语不同，但你写出了那个名词
主语不同，而且没有写出来

rules.title: 不要为了像 C1 而堆分词
rules.body: 一段话里一两处分词就够了。连续三句都以 -ing 开头，读起来像在躲正常的动词。能用一个清楚的 because 说完，就不必缩短。缩短的唯一理由是主语相同，而且先后或原因已经清楚。

examples.en: I checked the units and then sent the file.
Having checked the units, I sent the file.
Because the units were wrong, I stopped.

questions.prompt: 哪一句合法？
questions.answer: Being late, I found the door locked.
questions.hint: late 的人必须是主语。
questions.explanation: I 才是迟到的人。door 不能 being late。
options: Being late, the door was locked against me.
Being late, I found the door locked.
Being locked, I was late for the door.

questions.prompt: 哪一句是独立主格，而不是垂悬？
questions.answer: The lecture over, we asked our questions.
questions.hint: lecture 自己有 over 这个状态。
questions.explanation: The lecture over 自带主语。后面的 we 是另一个主语，这是允许的。
options: The lecture over, we asked our questions.
Over the lecture, questions were asked by being students.
The lecture over we, asked.

questions.prompt: 主语不同，改回从句：______ the sample was small, the claim stays cautious.
questions.answer: Because
questions.hint: 不要用 Being small, the claim… 来表示样本小。
questions.explanation: Because 或 As 或 Since。

questions.prompt: 固定表达，不按垂悬挑错：______ by the figures, demand has fallen.
questions.answer: Judging
questions.hint: judging by 是固定说法。
questions.explanation: Judging by the figures。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: Being a speaker of Chinese, I find articles difficult.
questions.hint: 主语必须仍是 I。
questions.explanation: Being a speaker of Chinese, I find articles difficult。不能让 articles 做主语。
questions.source: I am a speaker of Chinese, and I find articles difficult.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: After we had finished the test, the bus left without us. Tired, we were glad to get home.
questions.hint: bus 没有完成考试，home 也不会累。
questions.explanation: 考试的人是 we，所以不能用 Finished the test, the bus…。累的也是 we。
questions.stem: Finished the test, the bus left without us and being tired, home was welcome.

task.prompt: 故意写一句垂悬分词，然后在下一行改对。用你自己的一天当材料。
task.model: Wrong: Reading the timetable, the train had already left. Right: Reading the timetable, I saw that the train had already left.
rubric: 错句的分词主语和主句主语确实不是同一个。
改后的句子主语一致，或改成了完整从句。
你没有把 judging by 这类固定说法当成错误。

modules.title: 倒装与强调
modules.description: 把某个成分放到句首，是为了让它变成重点。倒装有语法代价：助动词要跟着提前。

lessons.title: 否定与限制词语前置
lessons.goal: 能在 never、rarely、not only、only then 开头时把助动词提前。
lessons.exam: 这种倒装是正式写作的强调手段。用一次就够。形式错了，会比不倒装更显眼。

notice.prompt: 同样的话，第二句把否定词放到句首，助动词也跟着出来了。

examples.en: I have never seen such a clear result.
Never have I seen such a clear result.
examples.zh: Never 提前，have 放在主语前面。

notice.answer: 当前置的是带否定或限制意义的状语时，句子用疑问句的词序，但句尾不用问号。能提前的是 never、rarely、seldom、hardly、little、not only、only then、under no circumstances。普通的 often 提前不必倒装。

rules.title: 助动词提前，实义动词留在后面
rules.body: Never have I seen、Rarely does she complain、Not until Monday did we understand。如果原来没有助动词，就请出 do / does / did。be 和 have 自己提前。

examples.en: Rarely does the editor accept a late file.
Not until the end did the pattern appear.
Little did we know that the file was damaged.
examples.zh: little 在这里有否定意味。

rules.title: not only 要和 but also 配对，而且只倒装前半
rules.body: Not only did she apologise, but she also rewrote the page。倒装停在逗号前。后半句回到普通词序。不要写成 Not only she did apologise。

examples.en: Not only did the sample fail, but the record was incomplete.
Not only is the room small, but it is also dark.
She not only apologised but also rewrote the page.
examples.zh: not only 不在句首时，不必倒装。

mistakes.wrong: Not only she apologised, but she rewrote it.
mistakes.right: Not only did she apologise, but she also rewrote it.
mistakes.why: 句首的 not only 需要助动词。

mistakes.wrong: Never I have seen this.
mistakes.right: Never have I seen this.
mistakes.why: have 要在 I 前面。

rules.title: only + 时间或条件，放在句首才倒装
rules.body: Only after the third trial did the method work。Only if you cite the source may you use the table。only 如果修饰主语，不倒装：Only a small group understood。倒装的是状语，不是主语。

examples.en: Only later did I notice the footnote.
Only by repeating the test can we be sure.
Only two people noticed.
examples.zh: only 修饰主语，词序不变。

rules.title: so / such … that 也可以倒装，但很重
rules.body: So tired was he that he stopped 是正式甚至文学的写法。普通写作用 He was so tired that he stopped 更干净。知道能认读即可，自己写时优先不倒装，除非你确实要强调 so 后面的形容词。

examples.en: So limited was the sample that the claim stayed cautious.
The sample was so limited that the claim stayed cautious.
Such was the noise that we moved rooms.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的倒装是对的？
questions.answer: Never have I read a clearer summary.
questions.hint: have 提前，不要再加 did。
questions.explanation: 完成时的助动词是 have，直接放到主语前。did I have read 叠了两个助动词。
options: Never I have read a clearer summary.
Never have I read a clearer summary.
Never did I have read a clearer summary.

questions.prompt: only 修饰主语时，哪一句对？
questions.answer: Only a specialist understood the note.
questions.hint: 主语不触发倒装。
questions.explanation: only 加在主语上，动词保持普通词序。只有 Only then / Only later 这种状语才倒装。
options: Only a specialist did understand the note.
Only a specialist understood the note.
Only did a specialist understand the note.

questions.prompt: Not only ______ she apologise, but she also corrected the chart.
questions.answer: did
questions.hint: 句首 not only，过去时请出 did。
questions.explanation: did she apologise。apologise 回到原形。

questions.prompt: Rarely ______ he arrive on time. 用 do 的适当形式。
questions.answer: does
questions.hint: he 是第三人称，rarely 在句首。
questions.explanation: Rarely does he arrive。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: Not until Friday did we understand the result.
questions.hint: Not until 放在句首，后面倒装。
questions.explanation: Not until Friday did we understand the result。
questions.source: We did not understand the result until Friday.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: Not only did she finish the draft, but she also sent it.
questions.hint: 倒装在前半句，also 的位置跟着动词。
questions.explanation: Not only did she finish。后半用 but she also sent it。
questions.stem: Not only she did finish the draft, but also she sent it.

task.prompt: 用 Never 和 Not only 各写一句正式的话，内容真实。再写一句意思相同但不倒装的普通词序，用来对照。
task.model: Never have I kept a notebook this consistently. Not only did I miss the deadline, but I also misread the question. I have never kept a notebook this consistently.
rubric: 句首的否定词后面有助动词。
not only 只倒装了逗号前的一半。
你能把同一句还原成普通词序。

lessons.title: 分裂句与前置
lessons.goal: 能用 It is … that 和 What … is 把一个成分标成焦点，并知道前置不等于倒装。
lessons.exam: 强调结构帮助读者看见你认为哪一个词最重要。它不增加新信息，所以事实必须先站得住。

notice.prompt: 普通句子里，Maya 只是主语。分裂句把她单独点出来。

examples.en: Maya wrote the report.
It was Maya who wrote the report.

notice.answer: It is / was + 焦点 + that / who。What I need is time 把需要的东西放到句尾，形成另一个焦点。前置是把宾语或补语挪到句首，但动词词序通常不变：This question we will return to。

rules.title: It is … that / who
rules.body: It was the method that failed，焦点是方法，不是人。It was in March that we noticed，焦点是时间。人用 who 或 that 都可以：It was Maya who wrote it。不要写成 It was Maya wrote it，中间的 who / that 不能省。时态跟被强调的事走：过去的事用 It was。

examples.en: It was the sample size that worried me.
examples.zh: 担心的是样本量，不是别的。

examples.en: It is tomorrow that we leave.
It was her argument that convinced the group.

mistakes.wrong: It was Maya wrote the report.
mistakes.right: It was Maya who wrote the report.
mistakes.why: who 或 that 不能省。

mistakes.wrong: It is tomorrow when we leave.
mistakes.right: It is tomorrow that we leave.
mistakes.why: 分裂句用 that。when 不承担这个强调结构。

rules.title: What 从句把焦点放到句尾
rules.body: What I need is another day。What surprised me was the silence。从句里用陈述词序。be 后面的焦点如果是复数，be 可以跟它一致：What we need are better examples，不过 What we need is better examples 也很常见。先求结构清楚。

examples.en: What the paper lacks is a limitation section.
examples.zh: 缺少的东西被放到句尾。

examples.en: What I did not expect was the delay.
What matters is the definition.

rules.title: 前置：先把成分拿出来，词序可以不变
rules.body: This question we will return to later 把宾语提前，we will 并不倒装。More important is the second result 把补语提前，动词常常跟着倒装，这是另一类。不要把所有前置都做成 Never have I。

examples.en: This limitation I accept.
examples.zh: 宾语提前，主语和动词仍按普通顺序。

examples.en: The second result we have not explained.
examples.zh: 否定留在动词里，句首不是 never。

examples.en: On the table sat a single notebook.
examples.zh: 地点前置，动词倒装，这是描述性的。

table.caption: 三种强调不要混
rows: X 后面必须有 that / who
主语和助动词通常不倒装

rules.title: 强调之前先问值不值得
rules.body: 如果全段每句都是 It is … that，强调就失效了。一段里用一次，用来纠正读者可能看错的焦点：不是数据错了，是定义错了。It was the definition, not the data, that failed。

examples.en: It was the definition, not the data, that failed.
The definition failed. The data did not.
examples.zh: 两句普通句子同样清楚。

examples.en: What failed was the definition.

questions.prompt: 哪一句是完整的分裂句？
questions.answer: It was the definition that failed.
questions.hint: 焦点和 that 从句都不能缺。
questions.explanation: It was the definition that failed。第一句少了 that。第三句多了一个 it。
options: It was the definition failed.
It was the definition that failed.
It was the definition, which failed it.

questions.prompt: 宾语前置但不是否定倒装。哪一句对？
questions.answer: This point we will discuss later.
questions.hint: 前置的宾语不要在后面再出现一次，也不必把 will 提前。
questions.explanation: we will 保持普通词序。句尾不要再加 it。
options: This point will we discuss later.
This point we will discuss later.
This point we will discuss it later.

questions.prompt: What the draft ______ is a clear conclusion. 用 lack 的第三人称。
questions.answer: lacks
questions.hint: What 从句里的动词按自己的主语变化。
questions.explanation: What the draft lacks。draft 是单数。

questions.prompt: 强调是周一发现的：It ______ on Monday that we noticed the gap.
questions.answer: was
questions.hint: 过去的事，分裂句用 was。
questions.explanation: It was on Monday that …

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: What surprised me was the silence.
questions.hint: 用 What 把令人惊讶的东西放到句尾。
questions.explanation: What surprised me was the silence。
questions.source: The silence surprised me. Nothing else did.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: It was the editor who wrote the note, and this note we will discuss tomorrow.
questions.hint: who 不能省；前置的宾语不要用 it 重复。
questions.explanation: who wrote the note。this note we will discuss tomorrow，不再加 it。
questions.stem: It was the editor wrote the note, and this note we will discuss it tomorrow.

task.prompt: 用 It was … that 强调你一个真实错误的原因，再用普通句子把同一意思写一遍。
task.model: It was the missing unit, not the formula, that made the result look huge. The missing unit made the result look huge. The formula was fine.
rubric: 分裂句有 that 或 who。
被强调的成分确实是你想让读者看见的那一个。
普通句子和分裂句的事实一致。

modules.title: 愿望、虚拟和“该是时候”
modules.description: wish、if only、it's time、would rather 都用过去形式表示“现在并非如此”。这和条件句第二类是同一套距离。

lessons.title: wish 和 if only 的三层时间
lessons.goal: 能按“与现在相反、与过去相反、希望别人改变”选择 wish 后面的形式。
lessons.exam: wish 后面的时态是这一课的全部难点。它不表示愿望发生的时间，而表示愿望离现实有多远。

notice.prompt: 两句都是愿望。一句抱怨现在，一句后悔过去。

examples.en: I wish I knew the answer.
examples.zh: 现在不知道。knew 是现在的不真实。

examples.en: I wish I had known the answer.
examples.zh: 当时不知道，已经来不及。

notice.answer: wish + 过去式谈现在或将来的不真实。wish + had done 谈过去的后悔。wish + would 通常指向别人或外界的习惯，带一点不耐烦：I wish you would listen。自己的意愿不用 I wish I would。

rules.title: 和现在相反：wish + 过去式
rules.body: I wish I had more time 意味着我现在时间不够。be 用 were：I wish I were more patient。不要用 wish + 一般现在时来表示一个你知道是假的情况。希望一个真实可能的将来，用 hope：I hope she arrives on time。

examples.en: I wish I understood this chart.
I wish the room were quieter.
I hope the room is quiet tomorrow.

table.caption: wish 的三层
rows: I wish you would slow down.

mistakes.wrong: I wish I know the answer.
mistakes.right: I wish I knew the answer.
mistakes.why: 现在的不真实用过去式。

mistakes.wrong: I wish I would have more time now.
mistakes.right: I wish I had more time.
mistakes.why: 说自己现在的状态，不用 would。

rules.title: 和过去相反：wish + had done
rules.body: I wish I had started earlier 等于 If only I had started earlier，都表示当时没早开始。它和 should have started 的不同是：should have 带义务，wish 带遗憾。两者可以同时为真。

examples.en: I wish I had kept a backup.
She wishes she had asked for help.
examples.zh: 主语是 she 时，wish 仍加 es，从句用 had。

examples.en: If only we had read the footnote.
examples.zh: if only 比 wish 更带感叹。

rules.title: wish + would：别人的行为令你不耐烦
rules.body: I wish you would listen、I wish it would stop raining。would 指向说话人控制不了的事。不说 I wish I would stop procrastinating，改成 I wish I stopped 或 I must stop。if only 也可以接 would：If only the bus would come。

examples.en: I wish you would put the phone away.
I wish the neighbours would turn the music down.
If only it would snow.

mistakes.wrong: I wish you listen.
mistakes.right: I wish you would listen.
mistakes.why: 希望对方做出动作，用 would。

mistakes.wrong: I wish I would be taller.
mistakes.right: I wish I were taller.
mistakes.why: 自己的状态用 were，不用 would。

rules.title: if only 和 wish 形式相同，语气更强
rules.body: If only I had checked 常常单独成句，像一声遗憾。它不是条件句的 if，后面不要再接 would have 的主句，除非你真的要写成完整条件句。单独用时，if only 自己就是整句。

examples.en: If only I had labelled the file.
If only the instructions were clearer.
If I had labelled the file, I would have found it.
examples.zh: 这才是完整的第三类条件句。

questions.prompt: 你现在不会用这个软件。哪一句对？
questions.answer: I wish I could use this software.
questions.hint: 现在的能力不足，用 could 或 knew how，不用 can，也不用对自己说 would。
questions.explanation: could 是 can 的过去形式，在 wish 后面表示现在并不能。
options: I wish I can use this software.
I wish I could use this software.
I wish I would use this software.

questions.prompt: 备份没做，你后悔。哪一句对？
questions.answer: I wish I had made a backup.
questions.hint: 过去的遗憾用 had done。
questions.explanation: had made。一般过去 made 不够远。would have 不是 wish 的常规形式。
options: I wish I made a backup yesterday.
I wish I had made a backup.
I wish I would made a backup.

questions.prompt: 希望对方把音乐关小：I wish you ______ turn it down.
questions.answer: would
questions.hint: 对方的行为用 would。
questions.explanation: would turn。

questions.prompt: 单独的遗憾：If ______ I had read the question twice.
questions.answer: only
questions.hint: if only 固定在一起。
questions.explanation: If only I had read …

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I wish I had a quiet room.
questions.hint: 现在的不真实用过去式 had，不是 have。
questions.explanation: I wish I had a quiet room。
questions.source: I do not have a quiet room, and I regret that.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: I wish I had known the answer yesterday.
questions.hint: 昨天的事用 had known，不要 would knew。
questions.explanation: wish 后面不把 would 和过去式叠在一起。过去的遗憾是 had known。
questions.stem: I wish I would knew the answer yesterday.

task.prompt: 写三句愿望：现在的不足、过去的后悔、希望别人改掉的一个习惯。
task.model: I wish I were more systematic. I wish I had started this notebook in January. I wish my phone would stay in the other room.
rubric: 现在用了过去式或 were。
过去用了 had done。
对别人用了 would，没有写 I wish I would。

lessons.title: it's time、would rather 和 suggest that
lessons.goal: 能在 it's time 和 would rather 后面用过去式表示现在，并在 suggest / essential 后面使用动词原形。
lessons.exam: 正式英语里 that 从句的动词原形，就是很多人说的虚拟式。它没有 -s，也没有过去式。

notice.prompt: 两句都是“现在就该走了”。it's time 后面却是过去式。

examples.en: It is time we left.
examples.zh: left 说的是现在该做的事。

examples.en: I would rather you did not smoke in here.

notice.answer: it's time + 主语 + 过去式，表示这件事早该发生。would rather + 别人 + 过去式，表示你希望对方现在怎样。suggest、recommend、insist、essential、vital 后面的 that 从句可以用动词原形：suggest that he be told。

rules.title: It is time + 过去式
rules.body: It is time we started、It is high time she spoke to him。high time 语气更强，表示已经晚了。后面不是不定式的主语结构时，才用过去式。It is time to start 是另一句，没有从句，也就没有过去式。

examples.en: It is time we reviewed the errors.
It is high time the city acted.
It is time to close the laptop.

mistakes.wrong: It is time we review the errors.
mistakes.right: It is time we reviewed the errors.
mistakes.why: 从句用过去式。

mistakes.wrong: It is time we to review.
mistakes.right: It is time we reviewed.
mistakes.why: 不要在主语后面直接加 to。

rules.title: would rather 看主语是不是同一个人
rules.body: I would rather stay 是自己的选择，后面原形。I would rather you stayed 是希望别人，后面过去式。否定：I would rather you did not tell her。rather than 是“而不是”，后面常接原形：stay rather than leave。

examples.en: I would rather walk.
I would rather we walked.
examples.zh: 希望“我们”这么做，用过去式。

examples.en: I would rather stay in than go out.

table.caption: rather 的两种
rows: 和 would rather 同一人
过去式：I would rather you went

rules.title: that 从句里的动词原形
rules.body: I suggest that he be informed、It is essential that she arrive on time、They insisted that the test be repeated。动词用原形，第三人称也不加 -s。英式英语也常说 should be informed，两种都对。不要说 suggest that he is informed 来表达“应该告知”，那会变成你在陈述已经告知。

examples.en: I recommend that the sample be larger.
It is vital that every participant sign the form.
She insisted that he should apologise.
examples.zh: should 是同等的正式说法。

mistakes.wrong: It is essential that she arrives on time.
mistakes.right: It is essential that she arrive on time.
mistakes.why: 表示“必须做到”时用原形，或 should arrive。arrives 更像在陈述她确实会准时。

mistakes.wrong: I suggest that he is told today.
mistakes.right: I suggest that he be told today.
mistakes.why: 提出建议时用 be told 或 should be told。is told 更像在说他已经被告知。

rules.title: suggest 的三条路不要混
rules.body: suggest doing、suggest that someone do、suggest that someone should do。没有 suggest someone to do。recommend 和 propose 走同一条路。demand、ask 在正式语体里也可以接 that + 原形：They asked that the hearing be postponed。

examples.en: She suggested leaving earlier.
She suggested that we leave earlier.
She suggested that we should leave earlier.

questions.prompt: 现在就该把草稿收起来。哪一句对？
questions.answer: It is time we closed the draft.
questions.hint: it is time 加从句时，动词用过去式。
questions.explanation: closed。It is time to close the draft 也对，但那不是从句。we to close 不成立。
options: It is time we close the draft.
It is time we closed the draft.
It is time we to close the draft.

questions.prompt: 希望对方今天不要打电话。哪一句对？
questions.answer: I would rather you did not call today.
questions.hint: rather 的主语和 you 不是同一个人，用过去式。
questions.explanation: did not call。原形只用于 I would rather not call，主语是自己。
options: I would rather you do not call today.
I would rather you did not call today.
I would rather you not to call today.

questions.prompt: 正式建议：I suggest that the test ______ (be) repeated.
questions.answer: be
questions.hint: that 从句里用原形。
questions.explanation: be repeated。should be repeated 也可以。

questions.prompt: 同一人的选择：I would rather ______ (walk) than wait for the bus.
questions.answer: walk
questions.hint: rather 后面没有另一个主语，用原形。
questions.explanation: walk。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: It is time we reviewed the errors.
questions.hint: it is time 加从句，用过去式。
questions.explanation: It is time we reviewed the errors。It is high time we reviewed the errors 语气更强。
questions.source: We should review the errors now. The moment has come.
accepted: It is high time we reviewed the errors.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: It is essential that she arrive on time, and I suggest that she leave now.
questions.hint: 义务用原形；suggest 不接 her to。
questions.explanation: arrive 不加 s。suggest that she leave 或 suggest leaving。
questions.stem: It is essential that she arrives on time and I suggest her to leave now.

task.prompt: 用 It is time we…、I would rather you…、It is essential that… 各写一句，都和你的学习习惯有关。
task.model: It is time we stopped guessing articles. I would rather you interrupted me than let the error pass. It is essential that every example be checked.
rubric: time 和 rather 的从句用了过去式。
essential 后面是原形或 should。
没有 suggest you to。

modules.title: 动名词与不定式
modules.description: 有的动词后面只接 -ing，有的只接 to，有的两种都接但意思不同。介词后面则一律是 -ing。

lessons.title: 哪些动词接 -ing，哪些接 to
lessons.goal: 能按动词的习惯选择动名词或不定式，并把介词后面的动词写成 -ing。
lessons.exam: 开放填空和写作都会在 enjoy、suggest、hope、avoid 后面设坎。这一课先记固定的那一列，下一课再处理意思会变的那几个。

notice.prompt: 同样是“开始做某事”的邻居，enjoy 和 hope 后面的形式相反。

examples.en: I enjoy reading footnotes.
I hope to finish the chapter.

notice.answer: 没有一条语义规则能完全预测形式，所以高频动词要分组记。介词后面没有选择：be good at reading、look forward to reading、insist on reading。这里的 to 如果是介词，也算在内。

rules.title: 常见的 -ing
rules.body: enjoy、avoid、mind、finish、suggest、consider、practise、keep、risk、imagine、give up、put off。I do not mind waiting。Would you mind opening the window? practise 在英式里是动词，后面同样接 -ing。

examples.en: I avoid checking my phone while I read.
Would you mind repeating that?
She kept making the same error.

mistakes.wrong: I enjoy to read aloud.
mistakes.right: I enjoy reading aloud.
mistakes.why: enjoy 不接 to。

mistakes.wrong: He suggested to leave.
mistakes.right: He suggested leaving.
mistakes.why: suggest 不接 to。

rules.title: 常见的 to
rules.body: decide、hope、promise、refuse、agree、offer、manage、afford、plan、expect、would like。I managed to finish。would like 后面是 to，不是 -ing：I would like to see the data。like 本身两种都可以，would like 不行。

examples.en: They agreed to extend the deadline.
I cannot afford to retake the course.
She would like to ask a question.

table.caption: 先记这些，不要临时类推

rules.title: 介词后面是 -ing，包括看起来像不定式的 to
rules.body: interested in reading、tired of waiting、before leaving、after finishing、without checking。look forward to、be used to、object to 的 to 是介词。be used to reading 是“习惯于读”。used to read 是“过去常常读”。

examples.en: She is interested in presenting the data.
I am used to reading on a screen.
I used to read on paper.

mistakes.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
mistakes.right: I look forward to hearing from you.
mistakes.why: 这个 to 是介词。

mistakes.wrong: I am used to wake up early.
mistakes.right: I am used to waking up early.
mistakes.why: be used to 接 -ing。

rules.title: stop / remember 先放一笔
rules.body: 下一课会展开。这里只建立警戒：I stopped to read 是停下别的事，为了去读。I stopped reading 是不再读。看见这两个动词，先问“停的是哪一件”。

examples.en: I stopped reading and made tea.
I stopped to read the footnote.
examples.zh: 停下手里的事，去读脚注。

examples.en: I remember posting the letter.

questions.prompt: 哪一句对？
questions.answer: I enjoy revising in the morning.
questions.hint: enjoy 后面是 -ing。
questions.explanation: revising。to revise 和原形都不接在 enjoy 后面。
options: I enjoy to revise in the morning.
I enjoy revising in the morning.
I enjoy revise in the morning.

questions.prompt: 哪一句表示“现在习惯早起”，不是“过去常常”？
questions.answer: I am used to getting up early.
questions.hint: be used to 接 -ing。
questions.explanation: am used to getting。used to get 是过去的习惯。
options: I used to get up early.
I am used to getting up early.
I am used to get up early.

questions.prompt: 她拒绝签字：She refused ______ (sign).
questions.answer: to sign
questions.hint: refuse 接 to。
questions.explanation: refused to sign。

questions.prompt: 不核对就发送：He sent the file without ______ (check) it.
questions.answer: checking
questions.hint: without 是介词。
questions.explanation: without checking。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I look forward to receiving your reply.
questions.hint: to 是介词，后面 -ing。
questions.explanation: look forward to receiving。I am looking forward to receiving your reply 也可以。
questions.source: I want to receive your reply. I am eager.
accepted: I am looking forward to receiving your reply.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: He suggested taking a break, and I am used to working late.
questions.hint: suggest 接 -ing；be used to 也接 -ing。
questions.explanation: suggested taking 或 suggested that we take。am used to working。如果想说过去常常，才是 I used to work late。
questions.stem: He suggested to take a break and I am used to work late.

task.prompt: 用 enjoy、managed to、look forward to 各写一句你的学习安排。
task.model: I enjoy reading the examples aloud. I managed to finish the set. I look forward to discussing it.
rubric: enjoy 后面是 -ing。
manage 后面是 to。
look forward to 后面是 -ing。

lessons.title: 意思会变的动词，以及别再按中文选
lessons.goal: 能区分 remember、forget、stop、try、regret 接 -ing 和接 to 的差别。
lessons.exam: 这几个动词是 Use of English 的常客，因为两个形式都“看起来像英语”，意思却相反。

notice.prompt: stop 后面换一种形式，停下的对象就变了。

examples.en: I stopped reading.
I stopped to read a message.
examples.zh: 我中断手里的事，目的是读一条消息。

notice.answer: -ing 多半指向已经发生或正在经历的那件事。to 多半指向还没做的目的、责任或尝试。remember doing 是记得做过。remember to do 是记得要去做。

rules.title: remember 和 forget
rules.body: I remember locking the door 门锁了，我记得这件事。Remember to lock the door 门还没锁，请你记住去做。forget 同样：I forgot to send it 没发出去。I will never forget meeting her 见过，而且忘不了。forget doing 较少用，通常用 will never forget doing。

examples.en: I remembered to save the file.
I remember saving the file.
Don't forget to cite the source.

mistakes.wrong: I remember to lock the door last night, and I did.
mistakes.right: I remember locking the door last night.
mistakes.why: 已经发生的记忆用 -ing。

mistakes.wrong: Remember locking the door when you leave.
mistakes.right: Remember to lock the door when you leave.
mistakes.why: 离开时还要做的动作用 to。

rules.title: stop 和 go on
rules.body: stop doing 是停止这个动作。stop to do 是停下来，以便做另一件。go on doing 是继续同一件事。go on to do 是接着做下一件不同的事。

examples.en: She stopped checking her phone.
She stopped to check the figure.
He went on to explain the second chart.

table.caption: 同一动词
rows: stop to do 停下以便去做
try to do 努力去做
regret to do 遗憾地通知

rules.title: try 和 regret
rules.body: try doing 是试一种方法，看看管不管用：Try restarting the program。try to do 是努力做成一件难事：I tried to restart it, but it failed。regret doing 是后悔做过。regret to say / to inform 是正式的“遗憾地告诉你”，事情还没说出口。

examples.en: Try reading the sentence aloud.
I tried to open the file, but it was corrupted.
I regret saying that.
We regret to inform you that the course is full.

rules.title: need doing 有被动的意思
rules.body: The draft needs checking 等于 The draft needs to be checked。东西做主语时，-ing 是被动意味。人做主语则用 need to：I need to check the draft。不要说 The draft needs to check。

examples.en: The battery needs replacing.
The battery needs to be replaced.
I need to replace the battery.

mistakes.wrong: The window needs to clean.
mistakes.right: The window needs cleaning.
mistakes.why: 物做主语，用 -ing 或 to be cleaned。

mistakes.wrong: I need checking the window.
mistakes.right: I need to check the window.
mistakes.why: 人要去做某事，用 need to。needs checking 的主语应该是物。

questions.prompt: 门昨晚锁了，你现在还记得。哪一句对？
questions.answer: I remember locking the door last night.
questions.hint: 已经发生的事用 -ing。
questions.explanation: remember locking。to lock 是还要去做，不能和 last night 的完成事实搭配。
options: I remember locking the door last night.
I remember to lock the door last night.
I remember lock the door last night.

questions.prompt: 程序卡住了，你建议对方把重启当作一种办法。你说：
questions.answer: Try restarting it.
questions.hint: 试一种方法用 try -ing。
questions.explanation: Try restarting。try to restart 是让对方努力去重启，语气更像任务而不是办法。
options: Try to restarting it.
Try restarting it.
Try restart it.

questions.prompt: 遗憾地通知：We regret ______ (inform) you that the session is cancelled.
questions.answer: to inform
questions.hint: regret to inform 是正式通知，不是后悔通知过。
questions.explanation: regret to inform。regret informing 会变成后悔曾经通知。

questions.prompt: 草稿需要被核对：The draft needs ______ (check).
questions.answer: checking
questions.hint: 物做主语，-ing 有被动意味。
questions.explanation: needs checking。needs to be checked 也对。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: I regretted interrupting her.
questions.hint: 后悔做过，用 regret + -ing。
questions.explanation: regretted interrupting。I regretted that I had interrupted her 没有用 -ing，但意思对；关键词是 REGRETTED，两种都能包含它。优先 -ing。
questions.source: I was sorry that I had interrupted her.
accepted: I regretted that I had interrupted her.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: I stopped smoking last year, and the window needs cleaning.
questions.hint: 戒烟是停止吸烟；窗户是被擦的对象。
questions.explanation: stopped smoking 才是戒烟。stopped to smoke 是停下来去抽一支。The window needs cleaning。
questions.stem: I stopped to smoke last year and the window needs to clean.

task.prompt: 用 remember doing、remember to do、stop doing 各写一句，内容要让读者看得出事情做了没有。
task.model: I remember sending the file. I must remember to attach the chart tomorrow. I stopped leaving the attachment until the last minute.
rubric: doing 指向已经发生的事。
to do 指向还没做的事。
stop doing 停止的是 -ing 那件事本身。

modules.title: 连接与篇章
modules.description: C1 的句子常常各自正确，却像一串珠子。连接词负责说明两句是转折、因果还是追加，标点则决定它们能不能连在一起。

lessons.title: 转折、让步和因果
lessons.goal: 能选择 however、although、despite、therefore 的词性和标点，不再把它们当成 and 的同义词。
lessons.exam: 写作的组织分看你能不能标出句与句的关系。however 被逗号当成连词来用，是这一档最常见的形式错误。

notice.prompt: 两句都是转折。一个是从属连词，一个是副词。

examples.en: Although the sample is small, the pattern is clear.
examples.zh: although 连接两个小句，逗号即可。

examples.en: The sample is small. However, the pattern is clear.
examples.zh: however 是副词，前面是句号或分号。

notice.answer: although、even though、while、whereas 是连词，可以待在同一个句子里。however、therefore、nevertheless 是副词，不能单靠一个逗号连接两个完整句子。despite 和 in spite of 后面是名词或 -ing，不是完整小句。

rules.title: 连词留在句内，副词另起一句
rules.body: Although the road was closed, we walked。The road was closed. However, we walked。The road was closed; however, we walked 也可以。The road was closed, however we walked 在正式写作里站不住，这叫逗号拼接。中文的“但是”感觉上两边都能用，英语要先问这个词是不是连词。

examples.en: The method is slow, but it is accurate.
The method is slow. However, it is accurate.
Whereas the first test failed, the second was stable.

mistakes.wrong: Although the sample is small, but the pattern is clear.
mistakes.right: Although the sample is small, the pattern is clear.
mistakes.why: although 和 but 只能留一个。

mistakes.wrong: The sample is small, however the pattern is clear.
mistakes.right: The sample is small. However, the pattern is clear.
mistakes.why: however 前面需要句号或分号。

rules.title: despite 后面不是句子
rules.body: despite the delay、despite being late、in spite of the noise。如果后面已经是一个完整小句，改用 although：Although we were late, we went in。despite of 不存在。in spite of 是三个词。

examples.en: Despite the small sample, the pattern held.
Despite being tired, she finished.
Although she was tired, she finished.

mistakes.wrong: Despite of the rain, we left.
mistakes.right: Despite the rain, we left.
mistakes.why: despite 后面直接接名词。

mistakes.wrong: Despite she was tired, she finished.
mistakes.right: Although she was tired, she finished.
mistakes.why: despite 不接主谓俱全的小句。

rules.title: 因果：because、so、therefore、as a result
rules.body: because 是连词。so 也是连词，二者不要叠用。therefore 和 consequently 是副词。as a result 和 for this reason 是短语，同样用句号或分号和前句分开。原因很长时，先写结果，再用 because 补原因，读者更容易跟上。

examples.en: Because the file was damaged, we started again.
The file was damaged, so we started again.
The file was damaged. Therefore, we started again.

mistakes.wrong: Because the file was damaged, so we started again.
mistakes.right: Because the file was damaged, we started again.
mistakes.why: because 和 so 二选一。

mistakes.wrong: The file was damaged, therefore we started again.
mistakes.right: The file was damaged. Therefore, we started again.
mistakes.why: therefore 不是连词。

rules.title: while 有时间，也有对比
rules.body: While I was reading, the phone rang 是时间。While the first method is cheap, it is unstable 是对比，接近 whereas。不要在正式写作里用 while 同时承担太多关系，让读者猜。对比明显时，whereas 更清楚。

examples.en: While the figures were being checked, we drafted the caption.
Whereas the city grew, the port declined.
The city grew. The port, however, declined.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的标点是对的？
questions.answer: The sample is small. However, the pattern is clear.
questions.hint: however 不能只靠逗号连接两个句子，也不能和 although 同用。
questions.explanation: 句号把两句分开，However 大写开头。although 句里不要再加 however。
options: The sample is small, however the pattern is clear.
The sample is small. However, the pattern is clear.
Although the sample is small, however the pattern is clear.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的 despite 用对了？
questions.answer: Despite the noise, she concentrated.
questions.hint: despite 接名词，不加 of。
questions.explanation: the noise 是名词。完整小句要用 although。despite of 不是英语。
options: Despite the room was noisy, she concentrated.
Despite the noise, she concentrated.
Despite of the noise, she concentrated.

questions.prompt: 结果副词：The units were inconsistent. ______, we repeated the trial.
questions.answer: Therefore
questions.hint: therefore、Consequently、As a result 都可以，标准答案用 Therefore。
questions.explanation: Therefore 前面已经有句号。不要写成 so，因为 so 通常不这样大写另起一句当唯一连接。

questions.prompt: 对比两个方法：The first test was cheap, ______ the second was accurate. 用一个连词，不要 however。
questions.answer: whereas
questions.hint: whereas 或 while 都可以表示对比。
questions.explanation: whereas。but 太弱，这里要的是明确对比。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: Despite the small sample, we still published the pattern.
questions.hint: despite 后面用名词短语，不要接 we were。
questions.explanation: Despite the small sample。Despite the sample being small 也可以。
questions.source: The sample was small. We still published the pattern.
accepted: Despite the sample being small, we still published the pattern.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: Although the data is limited, we can still see a pattern.
questions.hint: although、but、therefore 留一个就够。
questions.explanation: 让步已经由 although 完成。but 和 therefore 都删去，否则关系叠在一起。
questions.stem: Although the data is limited, but therefore we can still see a pattern.

task.prompt: 用 although、however 和 despite 各写一句，评论你最近读过的一个观点。三句意思可以相近，形式必须不同。
task.model: Although the study is small, its question is sharp. The study is small. However, its question is sharp. Despite its size, the study asks a sharp question.
rubric: although 没有和 but 同用。
however 前面是句号或分号。
despite 后面是名词或 -ing。

lessons.title: 补充、举例、换言和收束
lessons.goal: 能用 furthermore、for instance、in other words、to sum up 组织一段话，并让语域保持正式。
lessons.exam: 议论文不是把好句子排成列。读者需要知道这一句是在加证据、举例子，还是在换一种说法。

notice.prompt: 第二句并没有新事实，它只是把第一句说得更具体。

examples.en: The result is unstable. For instance, one outlier changes the average.
In other words, the average is too sensitive to publish alone.
examples.zh: in other words 是换言，不是新论据。

notice.answer: 追加用 furthermore、moreover、in addition。举例用 for example、for instance。换言用 in other words、that is。收束用 to sum up、overall。口语的 besides、anyway、plus 在正式文章里要换掉。

rules.title: 追加之前，先确认方向相同
rules.body: furthermore 要求下一句和上一句站在同一边。如果下一句其实是转折，用 however。in addition 后面是同类的下一条证据，不是让步。also 可以，但不要每句开头都是 Also。

examples.en: The sample is large. Furthermore, it covers three cities.
The sample is large. However, it covers only one age group.
In addition, the interviews were recorded.

mistakes.wrong: The food was excellent. Furthermore, the bill was a shock.
mistakes.right: The food was excellent. However, the bill was a shock.
mistakes.why: 账单是转折，不是追加。

mistakes.wrong: Also, also the second point is this.
mistakes.right: The second point is the cost.
mistakes.why: 不要用 Also 开头来代替真正的连接。

rules.title: 例子要短于论点
rules.body: 先写论点，再给例子。For instance 后面可以是一个名词短语或一个完整句。例子如果比论点还长，读者会忘记你在证明什么。such as 只能接名词，不能接完整句子。

examples.en: Several costs were ignored, such as maintenance and training.
Costs were ignored. For instance, nobody counted the training time.
One case is enough: the 2019 trial excluded weekends.

table.caption: 正式和口语
headers: 口语里常见、文章里要换

rules.title: in other words 不是新证据
rules.body: 换言是帮助读者，不是第二论据。In other words, the effect is too small to matter 只是把前一句再说清楚。如果你其实有了新数据，就不要用这个短语。namely 用来点名：one limitation, namely the sample size。

examples.en: The interval includes zero. In other words, the effect may be absent.
Two issues remain, namely cost and time.
That is, the model fits the past better than the future.

rules.title: 收束时不要引入新观点
rules.body: To sum up 后面只重复已经论证过的判断，可以带一个谨慎的限度。Overall, the pattern is consistent, though the sample is small。不要在最后一句突然 plus 一个从未出现的理由。

examples.en: Overall, the cheaper method is good enough for a first screen.
To sum up, we should publish the limitation with the result.
The evidence is limited, but it points the same way.
examples.zh: 限度和判断可以放在一句里。

questions.prompt: 下一句要转折。哪一个开头对？
questions.answer: However, the bill was unexpected.
questions.hint: 方向变了就用 however。
questions.explanation: furthermore 只能追加同一边的信息。for instance 必须真的在举例。
options: Furthermore, the bill was unexpected.
However, the bill was unexpected.
For instance, the bill was unexpected.

questions.prompt: such as 后面接什么？
questions.answer: such as training and maintenance
questions.hint: such as 接名词，不接完整句子。
questions.explanation: training and maintenance 是名词。完整句子要用 for instance。
options: such as nobody counted the time
such as training and maintenance
such as, we forgot training

questions.prompt: 换言：The difference is not significant. ______ other words, we cannot claim an effect.
questions.answer: In
questions.hint: 固定短语 in other words。
questions.explanation: In other words。

questions.prompt: 点出唯一的那个限制：one limitation, ______ the sample size.
questions.answer: namely
questions.hint: namely 后面点名。
questions.explanation: namely the sample size。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: In addition, the interviews were recorded.
questions.hint: 追加用 in addition，不要用 plus。
questions.explanation: In addition, the interviews were recorded。Furthermore, the interviews were recorded 也对，但关键词是 ADDITION。
questions.source: I will add one more similar point: the interviews were recorded.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: In addition, the sample is small. In other words, we cannot generalise. Overall, the question is still interesting.
questions.hint: plus、I mean、anyway 换成正式的连接，并拆开句子。
questions.explanation: In addition 追加，In other words 换言，Overall 收束。三件事不要挤在一个逗号句子里。
questions.stem: Plus, the sample is small, I mean we cannot generalise, anyway the question is interesting.

task.prompt: 写四句：论点、furthermore 的追加、for instance 的例子、overall 的收束。题目用“每天十分钟的语法练习值不值得”。
task.model: Short daily practice is worth keeping. Furthermore, it makes errors visible before a long writing session. For instance, I now notice a missing article on the same day. Overall, ten minutes is enough to maintain the habit, though it cannot replace a weekly draft.
rubric: furthermore 和前句同一方向。
例子短于论点，such as 没有接句子。
收束没有突然加入新理由。

modules.title: 名词短语、名词化、省略与替代
modules.description: 把动词句收成名词，文章会更紧，也更像书面语。省略和替代则避免同一句话里的名词反复出现。

lessons.title: 把动词句收成名词短语
lessons.goal: 能把一个小句改成名词短语，并正确使用 of、by 和所有格。
lessons.exam: 阅读里难的往往不是从句，而是一长串名词。写作里适当名词化，可以把原因放进主语，让动词留给真正的判断。

notice.prompt: 第一句用两个动词叙事。第二句把拒绝收成名词，判断动词只留一个。

examples.en: The committee refused to comment, and the decision was delayed.
The committee's refusal to comment delayed the decision.
examples.zh: refusal 成为主语，delayed 是唯一的谓语。

notice.answer: 名词化是把动词或形容词变成名词：refuse → refusal，decide → decision，important → importance。它不是把所有动词都换成名词。一句里留一个有力的动词，其余的动作可以收成名词短语。

rules.title: 动词变成名词之后，主语和宾语要重新安置
rules.body: The company expanded 可以变成 the company's expansion 或 the expansion of the company。人的所属常用 's，较长的事物用 of：the expansion of the public transport network。refuse to comment 变成 the refusal to comment，to comment 留在名词后面。

examples.en: her refusal to comment
the discovery of the error
a significant increase in prices

rules.title: 名词后面的介词是固定的
rules.body: a rise in prices、a reason for the delay、an effect on the result、a difference between the groups、an interest in the method、a solution to the problem。介词跟名词走，不跟原来的动词。中文“对结果的影响”容易写成 effect to。

examples.en: The effect on attendance was small.
There is no simple solution to the shortage.
The difference between the two groups is the age range.

mistakes.wrong: a solution of the problem
mistakes.right: a solution to the problem
mistakes.why: solution 接 to。

mistakes.wrong: the effect to the result
mistakes.right: the effect on the result
mistakes.why: effect 接 on。

rules.title: 不要把句子名词化到没有动词
rules.body: The implementation of the introduction of the policy 读起来像名词堆砌。留一个动词：Once the policy was introduced, implementing it took a year。名词化用来压缩已经清楚的动作，不是用来躲避动词。

examples.en: Prices rose sharply.
examples.zh: 动词本身已经有力，不必改。

examples.en: There was a sharp rise in prices.
examples.zh: 想把 rise 当成可以讨论的事物时再名词化。

examples.en: The sharp rise in prices surprised the board.
examples.zh: 名词短语做主语，动词留给 surprised。

rules.title: 冠词跟着新的名词走
rules.body: refusal、increase、arrival 是可数的：a refusal、the arrival。importance、information、growth 常常不可数：the importance of the result，不说 an importance。名词化之后重新检查冠词，不要把原来动词句的空冠词带过来。

examples.en: The arrival of the data changed the timetable.
Growth slowed in May.
There was a sudden increase in complaints.
examples.zh: 一次具体的上升，用 a。

questions.prompt: 哪一个名词短语是自然的？
questions.answer: the effect on attendance
questions.hint: effect 的介词是 on。
questions.explanation: on。to 和 for 都不是这个名词的搭配。
options: the effect to attendance
the effect on attendance
the effect for attendance

questions.prompt: 哪一句把拒绝收成了名词，而且仍然有一个清楚的谓语？
questions.answer: The committee's refusal to comment delayed the decision.
questions.hint: 名词短语做主语，delayed 做谓语。
questions.explanation: 第一句完整。第二句 delayed 没有宾语位置。第三句只是词的堆放。
options: The committee's refusal to comment delayed the decision.
The committee's refusal to comment the decision delayed.
Refusal comment committee delayed.

questions.prompt: 价格上升：a sharp increase ______ prices.
questions.answer: in
questions.hint: increase 接 in。
questions.explanation: an increase in prices。

questions.prompt: 两个组之间：the difference ______ the two groups.
questions.answer: between
questions.hint: 两者用 between。
questions.explanation: the difference between。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: The committee's refusal to comment delayed the decision.
questions.hint: 把 refuse 变成 refusal，让它做主语。
questions.explanation: refusal to comment 保留了 to。delayed 成为唯一谓语。
questions.source: The committee refused to comment. This delayed the decision.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: Introducing a solution to the problem took time.
questions.hint: 拆掉名词堆，solution 用 to。
questions.explanation: 一个动词 introducing 就够了。solution to the problem。不必把每个动作都变成名词。
questions.stem: The implementation of the introduction of a solution of the problem took time.

task.prompt: 把两句动词句收成一句，主语是一个名词短语。内容用你自己的一次延误或一次完成。
task.model: My failure to save the file cost me an hour. The arrival of the corrected data let me finish.
rubric: 名词来自动词，而且拼写是 refusal、failure、arrival 这一类，不是随便加 -ing。
名词后面的介词是 on、in、to 或 of 里正确的那一个。
句子仍然有一个限定动词。

lessons.title: so、not、do、one 和省略
lessons.goal: 能用 so / not 代替整个从句，用 do 代替动词短语，用 one 代替名词，避免重复。
lessons.exam: 替代是阅读速度的问题，也是写作干净与否的问题。C1 的句子不把同一个名词说三遍。

notice.prompt: 第二个人不必把整个判断再说一遍。

examples.en: I think the sample is too small. I think so too.
examples.zh: so 代替 the sample is too small。

examples.en: The red pen is dry. Take the blue one.

notice.answer: so 代替一个肯定的从句，not 代替一个否定的从句。do / does / did 代替已经出现的动词短语。one / ones 代替可数名词。不可数名词不能用 one。

rules.title: so 和 not 代替从句
rules.body: I think so、I hope so、I am afraid so。否定用 I hope not、I am afraid not。think 的否定更常说 I do not think so，不说 I think not，虽然后者能见到。so 指代的是整句，不是一个名词。

examples.en: Will it rain? I hope not.
Is the room free? I think so.
She may be right, but I doubt it.
examples.zh: doubt 后面常用 it，不是 so。

mistakes.wrong: I hope so not.
mistakes.right: I hope not.
mistakes.why: not 直接跟在 hope 后面。

mistakes.wrong: Do you think it will work? I think.
mistakes.right: I think so.
mistakes.why: think 不能光秃秃地代替从句。

rules.title: do so、do 和助动词省略
rules.body: She asked me to save the file, and I did so。I did 也可以。肯定的追加：She likes jazz, and he does too 或 so does he。否定的追加：She does not like jazz, and neither does he 或 nor does he。不要说 so does not he。

examples.en: I asked her to check, and she did.
The first group improved, and so did the second.
I cannot attend, and neither can my colleague.

table.caption: 追加
rows: so do I / I do too
neither do I / I do not either

rules.title: one 和 ones 只代可数名词
rules.body: I do not like this pen. I prefer the blue one。these reports and the earlier ones。不可数不能用 one：不说 this information and that one，说 this information and that。the former、the latter 用来回指两件已经点名的事，正式写作里很好用，但不要隔了五句还用。

examples.en: This chart is crowded. The simpler one is clearer.
The former approach is cheaper; the latter is more accurate.
I prefer tea to coffee. The former keeps me calmer.

rules.title: 省略是读者还能还原，才省
rules.body: I can attend the meeting, but my colleague cannot。cannot 后面省了 attend the meeting。如果后句的动词或宾语其实不同，就不能省。比较句里的省略同理：The second draft is clearer than the first 后面省了 draft is。拿不准时，把词写上。

examples.en: She has finished, but I have not.
The new version is shorter than the old one.
I brought a pen, and she brought one too.
examples.zh: one 是一支笔，不是同一支。

questions.prompt: 希望不要下雨。哪一句对？
questions.answer: I hope not.
questions.hint: hope 的否定替代是 hope not。
questions.explanation: I hope not。I don't think so 才是 think 的常见否定。
options: I hope so not.
I hope not.
I do not hope so, when you mean you hope it will not rain.

questions.prompt: 她不能参加，我也不能。哪一句对？
questions.answer: She cannot attend, and neither can I.
questions.hint: 否定追加用 neither + 助动词 + 主语。
questions.explanation: neither can I。so can I 是肯定。neither I can 词序错了。
options: She cannot attend, and so can I.
She cannot attend, and neither can I.
She cannot attend, and neither I can.

questions.prompt: 代替 pen：This pen is broken. Pass me the other ______.
questions.answer: one
questions.hint: 可数单数用 one。
questions.explanation: the other one。
