questions.prompt: 否定追加：I have never been there, and ______ has my brother.
questions.answer: neither
questions.hint: never 是否定，追加用 neither。
questions.explanation: neither has my brother。nor has my brother 也可以。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: The first method is cheap, and so is the second.
questions.hint: so + 助动词或 be + 主语。
questions.explanation: so is the second。The second is too 没有用 so 的倒装，但若要关键词 SO，用 and so is the second。
questions.source: The first method is cheap. The second method is also cheap.
accepted: The first method is cheap, and so is the second method.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: I think so. This information is better than that, and she likes the result, and so do I.
questions.hint: think 要接 so；information 不可数；肯定追加是 so do I。
questions.explanation: I think so。不可数名词不用 one。喜欢这个结果是肯定句，追加用 so do I，不是 so do not I。
questions.stem: I think. This information is better than that one, and she likes the result and so do not I.

task.prompt: 写一小段三句的对话：一个人提出判断，另一个用 I think so 或 I hope not 回答，再用 so do I 或 neither do I 追加。
task.model: “The draft is too long.” “I think so.” “I need another day, and so does Maya.”
rubric: so 或 not 代替了整句。
one 只出现在可数名词上。
neither 或 so 的词序是助动词在主语前。

modules.title: 搭配与短语动词
modules.description: C1 的用词错误常常不是选了一个不存在的词，而是选了一个存在、却不能跟旁边的词待在一起的词。

lessons.title: 搭配：动词和名词、形容词和名词
lessons.goal: 能选用 make、do、take、have 以及一组固定的形容词 + 名词，而不是按中文“做”字类推。
lessons.exam: 选择填空考的就是哪一个词能和空格旁边的名词共存。这一课的词都高频，不靠偏词。

notice.prompt: 中文都可以说“做”。英语把决定、研究和努力分给了不同的动词。

examples.en: make a decision, do research, take responsibility
heavy rain, strong tea, a strong accent
examples.zh: 形容词也是搭配，不是能大能小就行。

notice.answer: make 多和“产生出一样东西”有关：make a decision、make progress、make a mistake。do 多和工作、任务有关：do research、do someone a favour。没有完美的规则，分组记忆比临时推理可靠。

rules.title: make、do、take、have
rules.body: make a decision / an effort / progress / a mistake / an appointment。do research / homework / someone a favour / your best。take a break / responsibility / a look / place。have an effect / a look / a chance / difficulty。pay attention、meet a deadline、raise a question、reach a conclusion 也放进这一组。

examples.en: We made an appointment and did some research.
examples.zh: make 产生约定，do 做研究。

examples.en: The meeting took place on Monday.
She raised a question and then reached a conclusion.

mistakes.wrong: I did a mistake in the calculation.
mistakes.right: I made a mistake in the calculation.
mistakes.why: mistake 用 make。

mistakes.wrong: We made a research about the delay.
mistakes.right: We did some research on the delay.
mistakes.why: research 用 do，介词常用 on。

rules.title: 形容词不是能换就换
rules.body: heavy rain、heavy traffic、strong wind、strong tea、a strong accent、a high price、a high risk、a serious problem、a large number。powerful tea、big rain 能懂，但不是英语的搭配。副词也有搭配：strictly forbidden、warmly welcome、deeply concerned。

examples.en: There is heavy rain and heavy traffic.
She has a strong accent.
examples.zh: 口音常用 strong，而不是 heavy。

examples.en: They are deeply concerned about the cost.
examples.zh: concerned 用 deeply，很少用 strongly。

mistakes.wrong: a big rain
mistakes.right: heavy rain
mistakes.why: 雨用 heavy。

mistakes.wrong: powerful tea
mistakes.right: strong tea
mistakes.why: 茶用 strong。

rules.title: research、chance、difficulty 的介词
rules.body: research into / on a topic，不是 research about。a chance to do 或 a chance of doing。have difficulty doing 或 difficulty in doing，不是 difficulty to do。an increase in、a demand for、a reason for。

examples.en: Research on sleep has expanded.
There is a chance of delaying the trial.
I had difficulty hearing the recording.

rules.title: 把搭配放回你自己的句子
rules.body: 只看表格记不住。每学一个搭配，写一句和你的一周有关的话：I made an appointment with my tutor. I had difficulty hearing the last speaker。错题复习里如果搭配错了，把整个短语抄下来，不要只抄那个动词。

examples.en: I did my best to meet the deadline.
Please pay attention to the units.
The discussion had little effect on the decision.

questions.prompt: 哪一句的动词对？
questions.answer: We made a mistake and did some research.
questions.hint: mistake 用 make，research 用 do。
questions.explanation: make a mistake，do research。take a mistake 和 had a research 都不是搭配。
options: We did a mistake and made some research.
We made a mistake and did some research.
We took a mistake and had a research.

questions.prompt: 哪一个形容词是搭配？
questions.answer: heavy rain
questions.hint: 雨用 heavy，茶如果要说浓，用 strong。
questions.explanation: heavy rain。powerful 不修饰 tea，big 不修饰 rain。
options: powerful tea
heavy rain
big rain

questions.prompt: 我很难听清：I had difficulty ______ (hear) the last speaker.
questions.answer: hearing
questions.hint: difficulty 后面接 -ing，不接 to。
questions.explanation: difficulty hearing。difficulty in hearing 也可以。

questions.prompt: 发生：The meeting ______ place online.
questions.answer: took
questions.hint: take place 的过去式。
questions.explanation: took place。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: Please pay attention to the units.
questions.hint: pay attention to 是完整搭配。
questions.explanation: pay attention to the units。attention 后面的介词是 to。
questions.source: Please look carefully at the units.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: We did some research on the heavy rain and reached a conclusion.
questions.hint: research、rain、conclusion 三个搭配都要换。
questions.explanation: do research on，heavy rain，reach a conclusion。make a research、big rain、take a conclusion 都不是自然说法。
questions.stem: We made a research about the big rain and took a conclusion.

task.prompt: 用 make、do、have difficulty 和 heavy 或 strong 各写一句你这周的事。
task.model: I made an appointment for Friday. I did some research on the bus timetable. I had difficulty hearing the announcement. There was heavy traffic.
rubric: make 和 do 没有互换。
difficulty 后面是 -ing。
形容词是英语的搭配，不是 big 或 powerful 的直译。

lessons.title: 短语动词：及物、可分和语域
lessons.goal: 能判断一个短语动词能不能把宾语放在中间，并在正式写作里考虑是否换成单个动词。
lessons.exam: 短语动词是口语和新闻的骨架。正式报告里，一部分要换成 investigate、postpone、discover。知道两者，才知道何时用哪一个。

notice.prompt: 同一个动词，宾语能放在中间的，和不能放在中间的，不是一类。

examples.en: I looked up the word. I looked the word up.
examples.zh: look up 可分，名词宾语两种位置都可以。

examples.en: I looked after the children. 不能说 I looked the children after.

notice.answer: 代词宾语如果动词可分，必须放在中间：look it up，不说 look up it。正式语域里，put off 可写成 postpone，look into 可写成 investigate。不是每个短语动词都有同等的单词替换。

rules.title: 可分的，代词一定在中间
rules.body: turn the light off / turn off the light，但只能 turn it off。pick it up、point it out、give it up。名词宾语两种都可以，代词只有一种。这是形式，不是语体。

examples.en: Please turn it off.
She pointed out the error. She pointed the error out.
She pointed it out.

mistakes.wrong: I looked up it.
mistakes.right: I looked it up.
mistakes.why: 代词不能留在 up 后面。

mistakes.wrong: Turn off it before you leave.
mistakes.right: Turn it off before you leave.
mistakes.why: 同样是代词要在中间。

rules.title: 不可分的，宾语永远在后面
rules.body: look after someone、look into a problem、come up with an idea、run out of time、get over an illness、take after a parent。这些中间不能插入宾语。come up with it，不是 come up it with。

examples.en: We are looking into the delay.
She came up with a clearer title.
I am getting over a cold.

table.caption: 两组对照
rows: look up / turn off / put off / give up
look after / look into / look for
point out / pick up / take over
come up with / run out of / get over

rules.title: 正式写作里的替换
rules.body: put off → postpone，look into → investigate，find out → discover / establish，carry out → conduct，set up → establish，go on → continue。口语和叙事里短语动词更自然。一篇正式文章里如果满是 put off 和 find out，语域会突然变口语。

examples.en: The team carried out a survey.
The team conducted a survey.
We put the meeting off.
examples.zh: 口语。正式说 postponed the meeting。

rules.title: 意义不能靠每个小词去猜
rules.body: look up 不是“向上看”才是查词，也可以是向上看：look up at the ceiling。make up 可以是编造、和解或构成。要整块记忆，并看宾语。take off 可以是脱衣、起飞或突然成功。语境决定含义。

examples.en: Look up the term, then look up at the diagram.
She made up the story.
Students make up most of the audience.

questions.prompt: 代词 it 应该放在哪里？
questions.answer: look it up
questions.hint: look up 可分，代词必须在中间。look after 不可分。
questions.explanation: look it up。look up it 错。look it after 也错，因为 after 不分开。
options: look up it
look it up
look after it in the middle: look it after

questions.prompt: 正式报告里，哪一句语域最稳？
questions.answer: We postponed the trial and established the cause.
questions.hint: 正式动词替换 put off 和 find out。
questions.explanation: postponed 和 established。postponed off 把短语和单词叠在一起了。
options: We put off the trial and found out the cause.
We postponed the trial and established the cause.
We postponed off the trial.

questions.prompt: 想出了一个标题：She came up ______ a clearer title.
questions.answer: with
questions.hint: come up with 不可分。
questions.explanation: came up with。

questions.prompt: 把灯关掉，用代词：Please turn ______ off.
questions.answer: it
questions.hint: 可分动词的代词在中间。
questions.explanation: turn it off。them 如果是复数灯也可以，这里按单数。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: The committee will look into the complaint.
questions.hint: look into 不可分，宾语留在后面。
questions.explanation: look into the complaint。investigate 是它的正式对应，这里按关键词改成短语。
questions.source: The committee will investigate the complaint.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: I will look it up and then come up with a solution.
questions.hint: 代词放中间；with 的位置在 come up 之后、宾语之前。
questions.explanation: look it up。come up with a solution。notes 如果要留下，可以说 using my notes，但 with 不能跑到句尾去脱离 come up。
questions.stem: I will look up it and then come up a solution with my notes.

task.prompt: 选两个短语动词，各写一句口语。再把它们改成适合短报告的单个动词。
task.model: We put the meeting off. We looked into the noise. In the report: We postponed the meeting and investigated the noise.
rubric: 可分动词的代词在中间。
不可分动词没有被拆开。
正式句子的语域一致，没有 postponed off。

modules.title: 构词与关键词转换
modules.description: 这两类练习对应阅读与运用里最机械、也最容易稳定得分的部分。题目全部是本站写的，不是任何一年的试卷。

lessons.title: 先判断词性，再加词缀
lessons.goal: 能根据空格在句中的位置决定要名词、动词、形容词还是副词，然后选择前后缀，包括否定。
lessons.exam: 构词空格不考你认不认识那个词根，而考你看不看得出句子需要哪种词。先遮住词根，读句子。

notice.prompt: 空格两边已经告诉你要什么词性。

examples.en: Her ______ to comment delayed the decision. 词根 refuse。
examples.zh: 冠词和 to comment 之间要一个名词：refusal。

examples.en: She answered ______ . 词根 patient。

notice.answer: 步骤固定：看空格是主语、动词、定语还是状语；决定词性；再看要不要否定。-tion、-ment、-ness、-ity 常构成名词。-ful、-less、-ive、-ous、-able 常构成形容词。-ly 常构成副词，但不是所有副词都加 -ly，也不是所有 -ly 都是副词。

rules.title: 位置决定词性
rules.body: 冠词和形容词后面、介词前面，多半是名词：the rapid expansion。系动词后面、名词前面，多半是形容词：is significant、a significant rise。动词后面如果在修饰方式，多半是副词：rose significantly。情态动词和 to 后面是动词。

examples.en: The expansion of the network was rapid.
The network expanded rapidly.
It is essential to check the units.

table.caption: 先看邻居
rows: 动词 + 空格 + 标点

rules.title: 否定前缀不是随便挑
rules.body: un- 最广：unclear、unable。in- 常见于形容词：inaccurate、independent。m、p 前常变成 im-：impossible、impatient。il- 在 l 前：illegal。ir- 在 r 前：irrelevant。dis- 常在动词和一部分名词上：disagree、disappear。不是每个词都有否定形式，incomfortable 不存在，要用 uncomfortable。

examples.en: The result is inaccurate, not unaccurate.
It is impossible to be certain.
I disagree with the conclusion.

mistakes.wrong: unpossible
mistakes.right: impossible
mistakes.why: possible 的否定是 im-。

mistakes.wrong: unlegal
mistakes.right: illegal
mistakes.why: legal 的否定是 il-。

mistakes.wrong: incomfortable
mistakes.right: uncomfortable
mistakes.why: comfortable 用 un-。

rules.title: 名词后缀要和词根一起记
rules.body: decide → decision，不是 decidion。explain → explanation，refuse → refusal，arrive → arrival，grow → growth。-ness 多接在形容词上：aware → awareness，weak → weakness。-ity 也接形容词：possible → possibility，responsible → responsibility。拼写变化是词的一部分。

examples.en: Her decision was quick, but her explanation was clear.
The possibility of error remains.
examples.zh: possible → possibility，去掉 e 再加 -ity 这类变化要整词记。

examples.en: Awareness of the limit matters.

rules.title: 做题时写出词性再写词
rules.body: 在空格旁边先标 n. / v. / adj. / adv.，再写形式。如果句子已经有谓语动词，空格就不要再写一个限定动词。否定只在意思要求时加。不要因为选项看起来高级就加前缀。

examples.en: There is no ______ (necessary) to continue. → necessity
She spoke ______ (confident). → confidently
The figures are ______ (mislead). → misleading
examples.zh: 现在分词作形容词，表示“会误导的”。

questions.prompt: The rapid ______ of the city surprised us. 词根 expand。
questions.answer: expansion
questions.hint: rapid 后面、of 前面，要名词。
questions.explanation: expansion。expand 是动词，句子里已经有 surprised。expansively 是副词。
options: expand
expansion
expansively

questions.prompt: It is ______ to check every unit. 词根 possible 的否定。
questions.answer: impossible
questions.hint: possible 的否定前缀是 im-。
questions.explanation: impossible。un- 和 dis- 都不接在 possible 上。
options: unpossible
impossible
dispossible

questions.prompt: 修饰动词：She explained the limit ______ (patient).
questions.answer: patiently
questions.hint: 方式状语用副词。
questions.explanation: patiently。patience 是名词，patient 是形容词。

questions.prompt: no 后面：There is no ______ (necessary) for a longer test.
questions.answer: necessity
questions.hint: no 后面接名词。
questions.explanation: necessity。necessary 是形容词。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: The accuracy of the result is doubtful.
questions.hint: 把 accurate 变成名词 accuracy，重新安排句子。
questions.explanation: 也可以说 I doubt the accuracy of the result。关键词 ACCURACY 必须出现。
questions.source: The result does not seem accurate.
accepted: I doubt the accuracy of the result.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: Her refusal to comment was impossible to understand, and she spoke confidently.
questions.hint: 名词是 refusal，否定是 impossible，动词旁边是副词。
questions.explanation: refusal、impossible、confidently。refuse 不能加冠词，unpossible 不存在，confident 不能修饰 spoke。
questions.stem: Her refuse to comment was unpossible to understand, and she spoke confident.

task.prompt: 用 decide、possible、patient 三个词根各造一句，分别用到名词、否定形容词和副词。
task.model: The decision took a week. An error is still possible, but an impossible claim should be cut. She waited patiently.
rubric: 名词后缀拼写正确，如 decision 不是 decidion。
否定前缀是这个词真正使用的那一个。
副词确实在修饰动词。

lessons.title: 关键词转换：只改必须改的部分
lessons.goal: 能用给出的关键词改写句子，保持意思，并控制在关键词所要求的结构里。
lessons.exam: 转换看的是你能不能识别结构：被动、比较、情态、条件、倒装、名词化。它不要求你把句子写得更华丽。

notice.prompt: 关键词决定你必须走哪一条结构。意思保持不变。

examples.en: People believe that the file was deleted. → The file is believed to have been deleted.
I have never read a clearer page. → Never have I read a clearer page.

notice.answer: 做法：先标出原句的时态和谁做了什么；再看关键词属于哪一类结构；只改那一类；最后检查冠词、介词和代词有没有被带丢。本课的句子都是原创的。正式考试常限制词数，这里用结构正确作为标准，不模仿任何一份试卷的题干。

rules.title: 先认出关键词要的结构
rules.body: BEEN 常要完成或被动。HAVE 可能是使役 have something done，也可能是 must have。WERE 可能是虚拟或被动。DESPITE 要名词。HAD 在句首是倒装条件。不要看见一个词就开始自由发挥。

examples.en: Someone is checking the file. → The file is being checked.
It is not necessary to print it. → You do not have to print it.
examples.zh: HAVE 指向 don't have to。

examples.en: The rain was heavy, but we left. → Despite the heavy rain, we left.

table.caption: 看见关键词，先想到
rows: have something done 或 have to
过去式表示不真实或早该

rules.title: 意思不变，包括谁做了、做了没有
rules.body: should have 表示没做。needn't have 表示做了。must have 是推测，不是义务。转换时这些细微差别比词面更重要。代词要换人称：直接引语的 I 在 she said 之后变成 she。

examples.en: I printed it, but it was unnecessary. → I needn't have printed it.
It was a mistake not to save it. → I should have saved it.
“I am ready,” she said. → She said she was ready.

rules.title: 比较和 so / such 是另一条常见的路
rules.body: The box is too heavy for me to lift → The box is so heavy that I cannot lift it。too … to 和 so … that 经常互改。比较级可以变成 not as … as：The second draft is better → The first draft is not as good as the second。

examples.en: The text is too dense to read quickly.
The text is so dense that I cannot read it quickly.
This chart is not as clear as that one.

mistakes.wrong: The text is so dense to read.
mistakes.right: The text is too dense to read.
mistakes.why: so 不和 to 组成这个结构，要用 too … to 或 so … that。

mistakes.wrong: This chart is not as clear than that one.
mistakes.right: This chart is not as clear as that one.
mistakes.why: as … as，不是 than。

rules.title: 写完做三次核对
rules.body: 关键词是否原样出现，没有被你改成派生词。时态是否还表示原来的时间。句子是否还有一个主语和一个限定动词。多出来的 although … but、a information 这种基础错误，会把一个结构正确的转换重新判掉。

examples.en: Despite the delay, we finished.
Never have I seen a smaller sample.
It was Maya who noticed the gap.

questions.prompt: 原句：I sent the laptop to the shop. 关键词 HAD。哪一句对？
questions.answer: I had the laptop sent to the shop.
questions.hint: HAD 在这里是使役，不是过去完成。
questions.explanation: had the laptop sent 表示别人送的。had sent 是过去完成，意思变成你自己送了，而且还暗示有另一个过去。send 要用过去分词 sent。
options: I had sent the laptop to the shop.
I had the laptop sent to the shop.
I had the laptop send to the shop.

questions.prompt: 原句：The first draft is better than the second. 哪一句意思相同？
questions.answer: The second draft is not as good as the first.
questions.hint: 比较级改成 not as … as 时，两边的事物要对调。
questions.explanation: 第二稿不如第一稿好。as … as 中间是形容词，not 在 as 前面。
options: The second draft is not as good as the first.
The second draft is not as good than the first.
The second draft is as not good as the first.

questions.prompt: 原句：It is too late to change the figure. 用 SO 开头的后半：It is so late ______ we cannot change the figure.
questions.answer: that
questions.hint: so … that。
questions.explanation: so late that。

questions.prompt: 原句：People say that the map is unreliable. 完成被动式的开头：The map is said ______ be unreliable.
questions.answer: to
questions.hint: is said to be。
questions.explanation: to。is said to have been 会把时间推到更早，这里原句是现在。

questions.prompt: 改写下面的句子，使意思基本不变。必须使用给出的关键词，不要改变关键词本身。
questions.answer: We finished on time despite the late arrival of the data.
questions.hint: despite 后面用名词短语，可以把 arrived 名词化成 arrival。
questions.explanation: despite the late arrival of the data。Despite the data arriving late 也可以。
questions.source: We finished on time even though the data arrived late.
accepted: Despite the late arrival of the data, we finished on time.
We finished on time despite the data arriving late.

questions.prompt: 下面的句子是中文母语者常写出的样子。先改成自然的英语，需要时再显示参考答案。
questions.answer: Never have I seen such a clear chart. It is too clear to misread.
questions.hint: 倒装要把 have 提前；too … to 后面直接接动词，不要再加 cannot。
questions.explanation: Never have I seen such a clear chart。such a 后面接可数单数。too clear to misread 已经含有“不能”的意思。
questions.stem: Never I have seen so clear chart, and it is too clear to cannot misread.

task.prompt: 自己出三道转换并写出答案：一道 despite，一道 have something done，一道 never 倒装。题干用你自己的生活，不要抄任何试卷。
task.model: Prompt: I asked a friend to check the draft. Key word: HAD. Answer: I had the draft checked. Prompt: The room was noisy, but I finished. Key word: DESPITE. Answer: Despite the noise, I finished. Prompt: I had never kept a streak this long. Key word: NEVER. Answer: Never had I kept a streak this long.
rubric: 关键词原样出现。
意思没有从“做了”变成“没做”。
倒装、介词和冠词经得起模块 0 的清单。
